        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_3;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_3;
      end
      3'b100 : begin
        _zz_io_sdramRd = io_clientRd_4;
        _zz_io_sdramWr = io_clientWr_4;
        _zz_io_sdramAddr = io_clientAddr_4;
        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_4;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_4;
      end
      default : begin
        _zz_io_sdramRd = io_clientRd_5;
        _zz_io_sdramWr = io_clientWr_5;
        _zz_io_sdramAddr = io_clientAddr_5;
        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_5;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_5;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_SdramArbiter_l86 = (_zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 == 10'h250);
  assign io_refreshDue = _zz_io_refreshDue;
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_0 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b000);
  assign io_clientGrant_0 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_0);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_0 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_0);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_1 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b001);
  assign io_clientGrant_1 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_1);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_1 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_1);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_2 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b010);
  assign io_clientGrant_2 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_2);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_2 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_2);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_3 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b011);
  assign io_clientGrant_3 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_3);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_3 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_3);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_4 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b100);
  assign io_clientGrant_4 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_4);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_4 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_4);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_5 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b101);
  assign io_clientGrant_5 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_5);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_5 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_5);
  assign io_sdramRd = _zz_io_sdramRd;
  assign io_sdramWr = _zz_io_sdramWr;
  assign io_sdramAddr = _zz_io_sdramAddr;
  assign io_sdramDin = _zz_io_sdramDin;
  assign io_sdramBurstLen = _zz_io_sdramBurstLen;
  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge sdram_reset) begin
    if(sdram_reset) begin
      _zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 <= 10'h0;
      _zz_io_refreshDue <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      _zz_io_refreshDue <= 1'b0;
      if(when_SdramArbiter_l86) begin
        _zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 <= 10'h0;
        _zz_io_refreshDue <= 1'b1;
      end else begin
        _zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 <= (_zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 + 10'h001);
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module FetchSlotScheduler (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_hCounter,
  input  wire          io_lineStart,
  input  wire          io_schedule_0_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_0_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_0_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_0_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_1_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_1_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_1_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_1_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_2_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_2_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_2_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_2_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_3_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_3_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_3_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_3_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_4_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_4_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_4_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_4_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_5_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_5_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_5_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_5_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_6_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_6_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_6_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_6_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_7_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_7_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_7_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_7_endH,
  output wire [2:0]    io_currentSlot,
  output wire          io_slotValid,
  output wire          io_preAnnounce,
  output wire          io_grant,
  output wire [1:0]    io_grantClientId,
  output wire [3:0]    io_lineGrantCount,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_0;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_1;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_2;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_3;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_4;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_5;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_6;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_7;
  reg        [1:0]    _zz_io_grantClientId;
  wire                inWindow_0;
  wire                inWindow_1;
  wire                inWindow_2;
  wire                inWindow_3;
  wire                inWindow_4;
  wire                inWindow_5;
  wire                inWindow_6;
  wire                inWindow_7;
  wire                entering_0;
  wire                entering_1;
  wire                entering_2;
  wire                entering_3;
  wire                entering_4;
  wire                entering_5;
  wire                entering_6;
  wire                entering_7;
  wire                preEnter_0;
  wire                preEnter_1;
  wire                preEnter_2;
  wire                preEnter_3;
  wire                preEnter_4;
  wire                preEnter_5;
  wire                preEnter_6;
  wire                preEnter_7;
  reg        [2:0]    curSlot;
  reg        [2:0]    grantSlot;
  reg        [2:0]    grantSlotHeld;
  reg        [2:0]    grantSlotNow;
  reg        [3:0]    count;

  assign _zz_preEnter_0 = (io_schedule_0_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_1 = (io_schedule_1_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_2 = (io_schedule_2_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_3 = (io_schedule_3_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_4 = (io_schedule_4_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_5 = (io_schedule_5_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_6 = (io_schedule_6_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_7 = (io_schedule_7_startH - 10'h001);
  always @(*) begin
    case(grantSlotNow)
      3'b000 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_0_clientId;
      3'b001 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_1_clientId;
      3'b010 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_2_clientId;
      3'b011 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_3_clientId;
      3'b100 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_4_clientId;
      3'b101 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_5_clientId;
      3'b110 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_6_clientId;
      default : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_7_clientId;
    endcase
  end

  assign inWindow_0 = ((io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_schedule_0_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_0_endH));
  assign entering_0 = (io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_0_startH));
  assign preEnter_0 = ((io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_schedule_0_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_0));
  assign inWindow_1 = ((io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_schedule_1_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_1_endH));
  assign entering_1 = (io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_1_startH));
  assign preEnter_1 = ((io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_schedule_1_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_1));
  assign inWindow_2 = ((io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_schedule_2_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_2_endH));
  assign entering_2 = (io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_2_startH));
  assign preEnter_2 = ((io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_schedule_2_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_2));
  assign inWindow_3 = ((io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_schedule_3_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_3_endH));
  assign entering_3 = (io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_3_startH));
  assign preEnter_3 = ((io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_schedule_3_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_3));
  assign inWindow_4 = ((io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_schedule_4_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_4_endH));
  assign entering_4 = (io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_4_startH));
  assign preEnter_4 = ((io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_schedule_4_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_4));
  assign inWindow_5 = ((io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_schedule_5_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_5_endH));
  assign entering_5 = (io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_5_startH));
  assign preEnter_5 = ((io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_schedule_5_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_5));
  assign inWindow_6 = ((io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_schedule_6_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_6_endH));
  assign entering_6 = (io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_6_startH));
  assign preEnter_6 = ((io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_schedule_6_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_6));
  assign inWindow_7 = ((io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_schedule_7_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_7_endH));
  assign entering_7 = (io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_7_startH));
  assign preEnter_7 = ((io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_schedule_7_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_7));
  always @(*) begin
    curSlot = 3'b000;
    if(inWindow_7) begin
      curSlot = 3'b111;
    end
    if(inWindow_6) begin
      curSlot = 3'b110;
    end
    if(inWindow_5) begin
      curSlot = 3'b101;
    end
    if(inWindow_4) begin
      curSlot = 3'b100;
    end
    if(inWindow_3) begin
      curSlot = 3'b011;
    end
    if(inWindow_2) begin
      curSlot = 3'b010;
    end
    if(inWindow_1) begin
      curSlot = 3'b001;
    end
    if(inWindow_0) begin
      curSlot = 3'b000;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    grantSlot = 3'b000;
    if(entering_7) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b111;
    end
    if(entering_6) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b110;
    end
    if(entering_5) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b101;
    end
    if(entering_4) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b100;
    end
    if(entering_3) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b011;
    end
    if(entering_2) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b010;
    end
    if(entering_1) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b001;
    end
    if(entering_0) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b000;
    end
  end

  assign io_currentSlot = curSlot;
  assign io_slotValid = (|{inWindow_7,{inWindow_6,{inWindow_5,{inWindow_4,{inWindow_3,{inWindow_2,{inWindow_1,inWindow_0}}}}}}});
  assign io_grant = (|{entering_7,{entering_6,{entering_5,{entering_4,{entering_3,{entering_2,{entering_1,entering_0}}}}}}});
  assign io_preAnnounce = (|{preEnter_7,{preEnter_6,{preEnter_5,{preEnter_4,{preEnter_3,{preEnter_2,{preEnter_1,preEnter_0}}}}}}});
  always @(*) begin
    grantSlotNow = grantSlotHeld;
    if(entering_0) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b000;
    end
    if(entering_1) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b001;
    end
    if(entering_2) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b010;
    end
    if(entering_3) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b011;
    end
    if(entering_4) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b100;
    end
    if(entering_5) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b101;
    end
    if(entering_6) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b110;
    end
    if(entering_7) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b111;
    end
  end

  assign io_grantClientId = _zz_io_grantClientId;
  assign io_lineGrantCount = count;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      grantSlotHeld <= 3'b000;
      count <= 4'b0000;
    end else begin
      grantSlotHeld <= grantSlotNow;
      if(io_lineStart) begin
        count <= 4'b0000;
      end else begin
        if(io_grant) begin
          count <= (count + 4'b0001);
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_2 = ((3'b011 <= rawScaleX) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_2 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_2_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_3 = ((3'b100 <= rawScaleX) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_3 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_3_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_4 = ((3'b101 <= rawScaleX) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_4 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_4_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_5 = ((3'b110 <= rawScaleX) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_5 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_5_1));
  always @(*) begin
    scaleYEff = 3'b001;
    if(when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_6) begin
      scaleYEff = 3'b001;
    end
    if(when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_7) begin
      scaleYEff = 3'b010;
    end
    if(when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_8) begin
      scaleYEff = 3'b011;

    if(when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_9) begin

      scaleYEff = 3'b101;
    end
    if(when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_11) begin

    end
  end

  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_6 = ((3'b001 <= rawScaleY) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_6 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_6_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_7 = ((3'b010 <= rawScaleY) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_7 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_7_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_8 = ((3'b011 <= rawScaleY) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_8 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_8_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_9 = ((3'b100 <= rawScaleY) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_9 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_9_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_10 = ((3'b101 <= rawScaleY) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_10 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_10_1));
  assign when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_11 = ((3'b110 <= rawScaleY) && (_zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_11 <= _zz_when_ScaleCoordGen_l71_11_1));
  assign visibleW = _zz_visibleW[10:0];
  assign visibleH = _zz_visibleH[10:0];
  assign offX = (io_autoCenter ? _zz_offX : 10'h0);
  assign offY = (io_autoCenter ? _zz_offY : 10'h0);
  assign borderX1c = (offX + _zz_borderX1c);
  assign borderY1c = (offY + _zz_borderY1c);
  always @(*) begin
    _zz_recipXR = 18'h20000;
    case(scaleXEff)
      3'b010 : begin
        _zz_recipXR = 18'h20000;
      end
      3'b011 : begin
        _zz_recipXR = 18'h15556;

      3'b100 : begin
        _zz_recipXR = 18'h10000;
      end

      end
      3'b110 : begin
        _zz_recipXR = 18'h0aaab;
      end
      default : begin
        _zz_recipXR = 18'h20000;
      end
    endcase
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_recipYR = 18'h20000;
    case(scaleYEff)
      3'b010 : begin
        _zz_recipYR = 18'h20000;
      end
      3'b011 : begin
        _zz_recipYR = 18'h15556;
      end
      3'b100 : begin
        _zz_recipYR = 18'h10000;
      end
      3'b101 : begin
        _zz_recipYR = 18'h0cccd;
      end
      3'b110 : begin
        _zz_recipYR = 18'h0aaab;
      end
      default : begin
        _zz_recipYR = 18'h20000;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign io_scaleXEffOut = scaleXEffR;
  assign io_scaleYEffOut = scaleYEffR;
  assign io_borderX0 = borderX0R;
  assign io_borderX1 = borderX1R;
  assign io_borderY0 = borderY0R;

  assign io_sourceY = sourceYc_regNext;

      recipYR <= 18'h20000;
      logicWR <= 10'h280;
      logicHR <= 10'h1e0;

      borderX1R <= 10'h280;

      sourceYc_regNext <= 10'h0;

      scaleYEffR <= scaleYEff;

      recipYR <= _zz_recipYR;

      logicHR <= io_logicHeight[9:0];

module ColorMath (
  input  wire [23:0]   io_rgbIn,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_op,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_constant,
  input  wire          io_enable,
  output reg  [23:0]   io_rgbOut
);

  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_1;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_1_1;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_1_2;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_2;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_2_1;
  wire       [7:0]    r;
  wire       [7:0]    g;
  wire       [7:0]    b;
  wire       [6:0]    rShadow;
  wire       [6:0]    gShadow;
  wire       [6:0]    bShadow;
  wire       [23:0]   shadowRgb;
  wire       [23:0]   highlightRgb;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_addRgb;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_addRgb_1;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_addRgb_2;
  wire       [23:0]   addRgb;

  assign _zz__zz_addRgb = {1'd0, r};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_1 = {1'd0, io_constant};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_1_1 = {1'd0, g};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_1_2 = {1'd0, io_constant};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_2 = {1'd0, b};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_2_1 = {1'd0, io_constant};
  assign r = io_rgbIn[23 : 16];
  assign g = io_rgbIn[15 : 8];
  assign b = io_rgbIn[7 : 0];
  assign rShadow = io_rgbIn[23 : 17];
  assign gShadow = io_rgbIn[15 : 9];
  assign bShadow = io_rgbIn[7 : 1];
  assign shadowRgb = {{{{{1'b0,rShadow},1'b0},gShadow},1'b0},bShadow};
  assign highlightRgb = {{(r[7] ? 8'hff : {r[6 : 0],1'b0}),(g[7] ? 8'hff : {g[6 : 0],1'b0})},(b[7] ? 8'hff : {b[6 : 0],1'b0})};
  assign _zz_addRgb = (_zz__zz_addRgb + _zz__zz_addRgb_1);
  assign _zz_addRgb_1 = (_zz__zz_addRgb_1_1 + _zz__zz_addRgb_1_2);
  assign _zz_addRgb_2 = (_zz__zz_addRgb_2 + _zz__zz_addRgb_2_1);
  assign addRgb = {{(_zz_addRgb[8] ? 8'hff : _zz_addRgb[7 : 0]),(_zz_addRgb_1[8] ? 8'hff : _zz_addRgb_1[7 : 0])},(_zz_addRgb_2[8] ? 8'hff : _zz_addRgb_2[7 : 0])};
  always @(*) begin
    io_rgbOut = io_rgbIn;
    if(io_enable) begin
      case(io_op)
        2'b01 : begin
          io_rgbOut = shadowRgb;
        end
        2'b10 : begin
          io_rgbOut = highlightRgb;
        end
        2'b11 : begin
          io_rgbOut = addRgb;
        end
        default : begin
          io_rgbOut = io_rgbIn;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module WindowUnit (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_hCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_vCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winX0,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winX1,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winY0,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winY1,
  input  wire          io_invert,
  output wire          io_inside,
  output wire          io_effect
);


  assign io_inside = ((((io_winX0 <= io_hCounter) && (io_hCounter < io_winX1)) && (io_winY0 <= io_vCounter)) && (io_vCounter < io_winY1));
  assign io_effect = (io_inside ^ io_invert);

endmodule

module RasterTriggerUnit (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_vCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_hCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_triggerLine,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_triggerPixel,
  input  wire          io_pixelCmpEnable,
  input  wire          io_enable,
  input  wire          io_clear,
  output wire          io_triggerPulse,
  output wire          io_pending,
  output wire          io_irq,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  wire                lineMatch;
  wire                pixelMatch;
  wire                match_;
  reg                 matchPrev;
  wire                matchRise;
  reg                 pendingReg;

  assign lineMatch = (io_vCounter == io_triggerLine);
  assign pixelMatch = (io_pixelCmpEnable ? (io_hCounter == io_triggerPixel) : (io_hCounter == 10'h0));
  assign match_ = ((io_enable && lineMatch) && pixelMatch);
  assign matchRise = (match_ && (! matchPrev));
  assign io_triggerPulse = matchRise;
  assign io_pending = pendingReg;
  assign io_irq = pendingReg;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      matchPrev <= 1'b0;
      pendingReg <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      matchPrev <= match_;
      if(matchRise) begin
        pendingReg <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(io_clear) begin
        pendingReg <= 1'b0;
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

  assign _zz_slotIdx = (io_activeCount - 4'b0001);
  assign _zz_existingFromA = 1'b1;

  assign _zz_slbB_port_2 = (clearEnB ? clearZero : wrData);
  assign _zz_slbB_port_3 = (clearEnB || wrEnB);
  assign _zz_drainDataB = 1'b1;
  initial begin

          end else begin

              sfState <= SF_DONE;
            end else begin

                sfState <= SF_LOAD;
              end
            end

          slotIdx <= 3'b000;
        end else begin

        end
      end
    end
  end

module BitmapFetch (
  input  wire [7:0]    io_bitmapByte,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_attrByte,
  input  wire [2:0]    io_pixelWithinByte,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_bpp,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_directPixel,
  output wire [3:0]    io_pixelIndex,
  output wire [2:0]    io_paletteBank,
  output wire [23:0]   io_directRgb,
  output wire          io_directColorActive
);

  wire       [2:0]    _zz_when_BitmapFetch_l83;
  wire       [1:0]    _zz__zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105;
  wire       [2:0]    _zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105_1;
  reg        [3:0]    pi;
  reg        [2:0]    bank;
  wire       [4:0]    r5;
  wire       [5:0]    g6;
  wire       [4:0]    b5;
  wire       [7:0]    r8;
  wire       [7:0]    g8;
  wire       [7:0]    b8;
  reg                 dcActive;
  wire                when_BitmapFetch_l83;
  wire       [2:0]    _zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105;
  reg        [1:0]    _zz_pi;
  wire       [1:0]    switch_BitmapFetch_l105;

  assign _zz_when_BitmapFetch_l83 = (3'b111 - io_pixelWithinByte);
  assign _zz__zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105 = (2'b11 - io_pixelWithinByte[2 : 1]);
  assign _zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105_1 = (_zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105 + 3'b001);
  always @(*) begin
    pi = 4'b0000;
    case(io_bpp)
      2'b00 : begin
        if(when_BitmapFetch_l83) begin
          pi = {1'b0,io_attrByte[2 : 0]};
        end else begin
          pi = {1'b0,io_attrByte[5 : 3]};
        end
      end
      2'b01 : begin
        pi = {2'b00,_zz_pi};
      end
      2'b10 : begin
        pi = 4'b0000;
      end
      default : begin
        pi = 4'b0000;
      end
    endcase
  end

  always @(*) begin
    bank = 3'b000;
    case(io_bpp)
      2'b00 : begin
        bank = {2'b00,io_attrByte[6]};
      end
      2'b01 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      2'b10 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      default : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign r5 = io_directPixel[15 : 11];
  assign g6 = io_directPixel[10 : 5];
  assign b5 = io_directPixel[4 : 0];
  assign r8 = {r5,r5[4 : 2]};
  assign g8 = {g6,g6[5 : 4]};
  assign b8 = {b5,b5[4 : 2]};
  assign io_directRgb = {{r8,g8},b8};
  always @(*) begin
    dcActive = 1'b0;
    case(io_bpp)
      2'b00 : begin
      end
      2'b01 : begin
      end
      2'b10 : begin
        dcActive = 1'b1;
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign io_directColorActive = dcActive;
  assign when_BitmapFetch_l83 = io_bitmapByte[_zz_when_BitmapFetch_l83];
  assign _zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105 = ({1'd0,_zz__zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105} <<< 1'd1);
  always @(*) begin
    _zz_pi = 2'b00;
    case(switch_BitmapFetch_l105)
      2'b00 : begin
        _zz_pi = io_attrByte[1 : 0];
      end
      2'b01 : begin
        _zz_pi = io_attrByte[3 : 2];
      end
      2'b10 : begin
        _zz_pi = io_attrByte[5 : 4];
      end
      default : begin
        _zz_pi = io_attrByte[7 : 6];
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign switch_BitmapFetch_l105 = {io_bitmapByte[_zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105_1],io_bitmapByte[_zz_switch_BitmapFetch_l105]};
  assign io_pixelIndex = pi;
  assign io_paletteBank = bank;

endmodule

  assign inWindow_0 = ((io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_schedule_0_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_0_endH));
  assign entering_0 = (io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_0_startH));
  assign preEnter_0 = ((io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_schedule_0_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_0));
  assign inWindow_1 = ((io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_schedule_1_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_1_endH));
  assign entering_1 = (io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_1_startH));
  assign preEnter_1 = ((io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_schedule_1_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_1));
  assign inWindow_2 = ((io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_schedule_2_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_2_endH));
  assign entering_2 = (io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_2_startH));
  assign preEnter_2 = ((io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_schedule_2_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_2));
  assign inWindow_3 = ((io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_schedule_3_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_3_endH));
  assign entering_3 = (io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_3_startH));
  assign preEnter_3 = ((io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_schedule_3_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_3));
  assign inWindow_4 = ((io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_schedule_4_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_4_endH));
  assign entering_4 = (io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_4_startH));
  assign preEnter_4 = ((io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_schedule_4_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_4));
  assign inWindow_5 = ((io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_schedule_5_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_5_endH));
  assign entering_5 = (io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_5_startH));
  assign preEnter_5 = ((io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_schedule_5_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_5));
  assign inWindow_6 = ((io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_schedule_6_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_6_endH));
  assign entering_6 = (io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_6_startH));
  assign preEnter_6 = ((io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_schedule_6_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_6));
  assign inWindow_7 = ((io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_schedule_7_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_7_endH));
  assign entering_7 = (io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_7_startH));
  assign preEnter_7 = ((io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_schedule_7_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_7));
  always @(*) begin
    curSlot = 3'b000;
    if(inWindow_7) begin
      curSlot = 3'b111;
    end
    if(inWindow_6) begin
      curSlot = 3'b110;
    end
    if(inWindow_5) begin
      curSlot = 3'b101;
    end
    if(inWindow_4) begin
      curSlot = 3'b100;
    end
    if(inWindow_3) begin
      curSlot = 3'b011;
    end
    if(inWindow_2) begin
      curSlot = 3'b010;
    end
    if(inWindow_1) begin
      curSlot = 3'b001;
    end
    if(inWindow_0) begin
      curSlot = 3'b000;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    grantSlot = 3'b000;
    if(entering_7) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b111;
    end
    if(entering_6) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b110;
    end
    if(entering_5) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b101;
    end
    if(entering_4) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b100;
    end
    if(entering_3) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b011;
    end
    if(entering_2) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b010;
    end
    if(entering_1) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b001;
    end
    if(entering_0) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b000;
    end
  end

  assign io_currentSlot = curSlot;
  assign io_slotValid = (|{inWindow_7,{inWindow_6,{inWindow_5,{inWindow_4,{inWindow_3,{inWindow_2,{inWindow_1,inWindow_0}}}}}}});
  assign io_grant = (|{entering_7,{entering_6,{entering_5,{entering_4,{entering_3,{entering_2,{entering_1,entering_0}}}}}}});
  assign io_preAnnounce = (|{preEnter_7,{preEnter_6,{preEnter_5,{preEnter_4,{preEnter_3,{preEnter_2,{preEnter_1,preEnter_0}}}}}}});
  always @(*) begin
    grantSlotNow = grantSlotHeld;
    if(entering_0) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b000;
    end
    if(entering_1) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b001;
    end
    if(entering_2) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b010;
    end
    if(entering_3) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b011;
    end
    if(entering_4) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b100;
    end
    if(entering_5) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b101;
    end
    if(entering_6) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b110;
    end
    if(entering_7) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b111;
    end
  end

  assign io_grantClientId = _zz_io_grantClientId;
  assign io_lineGrantCount = count;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      grantSlotHeld <= 3'b000;
      count <= 4'b0000;
    end else begin
      grantSlotHeld <= grantSlotNow;
      if(io_lineStart) begin
        count <= 4'b0000;
      end else begin
        if(io_grant) begin
          count <= (count + 4'b0001);
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module PlanarLineFetch (
  input  wire          io_start,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_0,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_1,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_2,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_3,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_4,
  output wire          io_sdramRd,
  output wire [22:0]   io_sdramAddr,
  input  wire          io_sdramBusy,
  input  wire          io_sdramDataReady,
  input  wire [31:0]   io_sdramDout32,
  input  wire [8:0]    io_pixelIdx,
  output wire [4:0]    io_pixel,
  output wire          io_rowReady,
  output wire          io_busy,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  wire                rowFetch_io_sdramRd;
  wire       [22:0]   rowFetch_io_sdramAddr;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_0;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_1;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_2;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_3;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_4;
  wire                rowFetch_io_rowReady;
  wire                rowFetch_io_busy;
  wire       [4:0]    recon_io_pixel;
  wire       [3:0]    slot;
  wire       [4:0]    subIdx;
  reg                 hasRow;

  BitplaneRowFetch rowFetch (
    .io_start           (io_start                    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_0 (io_planeBaseAddr_0[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_1 (io_planeBaseAddr_1[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_2 (io_planeBaseAddr_2[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_3 (io_planeBaseAddr_3[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_4 (io_planeBaseAddr_4[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_sdramRd         (rowFetch_io_sdramRd         ), //o
    .io_sdramAddr       (rowFetch_io_sdramAddr[22:0] ), //o
    .io_sdramBusy       (io_sdramBusy                ), //i
    .io_sdramDataReady  (io_sdramDataReady           ), //i
    .io_sdramDout32     (io_sdramDout32[31:0]        ), //i
    .io_slotIdx         (slot[3:0]                   ), //i
    .io_slotWord_0      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_0[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_1      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_1[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_2      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_2[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_3      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_3[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_4      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_4[31:0]), //o
    .io_rowReady        (rowFetch_io_rowReady        ), //o
    .io_busy            (rowFetch_io_busy            ), //o
    .clk                (clk                         ), //i
    .reset              (reset                       )  //i
  );
  BitplaneReconstruct recon (
    .io_planes_0 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_0[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_1 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_1[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_2 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_2[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_3 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_3[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_4 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_4[31:0]), //i
    .io_bitIdx   (subIdx[4:0]                 ), //i
    .io_pixel    (recon_io_pixel[4:0]         )  //o
  );
  assign io_sdramRd = rowFetch_io_sdramRd;
  assign io_sdramAddr = rowFetch_io_sdramAddr;
  assign io_rowReady = rowFetch_io_rowReady;
  assign io_busy = rowFetch_io_busy;
  assign slot = io_pixelIdx[8 : 5];
  assign subIdx = io_pixelIdx[4 : 0];
  assign io_pixel = (hasRow ? recon_io_pixel : 5'h0);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      hasRow <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(rowFetch_io_rowReady) begin
        hasRow <= 1'b1;
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module TestPatternSource (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_x,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_y,
  input  wire [2:0]    io_patternSelect,
  output wire [3:0]    io_pixelIndex,
  output wire [2:0]    io_paletteBank
);

  wire       [2:0]    _zz_idx;
  wire       [2:0]    _zz_idx_1;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_idx_2;
  wire       [0:0]    _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76;
  wire       [0:0]    _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76_1;
  reg        [3:0]    idx;
  reg        [2:0]    bank;
  wire                when_TestPatternSource_l76;
  wire                when_TestPatternSource_l88;
  wire                when_TestPatternSource_l98;

  assign _zz_idx = _zz_idx_1;
  assign _zz_idx_2 = (io_x / 10'h050);
  assign _zz_idx_1 = _zz_idx_2[2:0];
  assign _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76 = io_x[4 : 4];
  assign _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76_1 = io_y[4 : 4];
  always @(*) begin
    idx = 4'b0000;
    case(io_patternSelect)
      3'b000 : begin
        idx = {1'd0, _zz_idx};
      end
      3'b001 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b010 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b011 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b100 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b101 : begin
        if(when_TestPatternSource_l76) begin
          idx = 4'b1111;
        end else begin
          idx = 4'b0000;
        end
      end
      3'b110 : begin
        if(when_TestPatternSource_l88) begin
          idx = 4'b1111;
        end else begin
          idx = 4'b0000;
        end
      end
      default : begin
        if(when_TestPatternSource_l98) begin
          idx = 4'b1111;
        end else begin
          idx = 4'b0000;
        end
      end
    endcase
  end

  always @(*) begin
    bank = 3'b000;
    case(io_patternSelect)
      3'b000 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      3'b001 : begin
        bank = 3'b001;
      end
      3'b010 : begin
        bank = 3'b010;
      end
      3'b011 : begin
        bank = 3'b011;
      end
      3'b100 : begin
        bank = 3'b100;
      end
      3'b101 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      3'b110 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      default : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_TestPatternSource_l76 = (_zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76[0] ^ _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76_1[0]);
  assign when_TestPatternSource_l88 = ((io_x[5 : 0] == 6'h0) || (io_y[5 : 0] == 6'h0));
  assign when_TestPatternSource_l98 = (io_x[0 : 0] == 1'b1);
  assign io_pixelIndex = idx;
  assign io_paletteBank = bank;

endmodule

module BasicPatternSource (

  wire       [8:0]    yWrap_io_result;

  end

    .io_coord  (io_x[9:0]           ), //i

  );

    .io_result (yWrap_io_result[8:0])  //o
  );

    case(pixelX)
      4'b0000 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[2 : 0];
      4'b0001 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[5 : 3];
      4'b0010 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[8 : 6];

module BlitterEngine (
  input  wire [14:0]   io_busAddr,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_busData,
  input  wire          io_busWr,
  input  wire          io_busBusy,
  output wire [14:0]   io_blitAddr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_blitData,
  output reg           io_blitWr,
  output wire          io_busy,
  output reg           io_done,
  input  wire          io_softClear,
  input  wire [13:0]   io_softClearAddr,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);
  localparam State_IDLE = 2'd0;
  localparam State_RUN = 2'd1;
  localparam State_DONE = 2'd2;

  reg        [15:0]   srcRam_spinal_port1;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_ctrlIdx;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_srcRamWrAddr;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_srcRam_port;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_srcRam_port_1;
  wire       [15:0]   _zz_srcRam_port_2;
  wire                _zz_srcRam_port_3;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_fsm_dstCur;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_fsm_srcCur;
  wire                _zz_srcRam_port_4;
  wire                _zz_fsm_srcRead;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr_1;
  wire       [1:0]    MODE_RECT_FILL;
  wire       [1:0]    MODE_RECT_COPY;
  wire       [1:0]    MODE_LINE_FILL;
  reg        [9:0]    widthReg;
  reg        [9:0]    heightReg;
  reg        [14:0]   dstAddrReg;
  reg        [14:0]   dstStrideReg;
  reg        [8:0]    srcAddrReg;
  reg        [8:0]    srcStrideReg;
  reg        [15:0]   fillReg;
  reg                 goReg;
  reg        [1:0]    modeReg;
  wire                ctrlHit;
  wire                srcRamHit;
  wire       [2:0]    ctrlIdx;
  wire       [8:0]    srcRamWrAddr;
  wire                srcRamClearWr;
  reg        [1:0]    fsm_state;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_colCounter;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_rowCounter;
  reg        [14:0]   fsm_dstRowBase;
  reg        [8:0]    fsm_srcRowBase;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_effHeight;
  reg                 fsm_isCopy;
  wire       [14:0]   fsm_dstCur;
  wire       [8:0]    fsm_srcCur;
  reg        [8:0]    fsm_srcReadAddr;
  wire       [15:0]   fsm_srcRead;
  wire                when_BlitterEngine_l198;
  wire                when_BlitterEngine_l200;
  wire                when_BlitterEngine_l203;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [31:0] fsm_state_string;
  `endif

  (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [15:0] srcRam [0:511];

  assign _zz_ctrlIdx = (io_busAddr - 15'h0c00);
  assign _zz_srcRamWrAddr = (io_busAddr - 15'h0c10);
  assign _zz_srcRam_port_1 = io_softClearAddr[8:0];
  assign _zz_fsm_dstCur = {5'd0, fsm_colCounter};
  assign _zz_fsm_srcCur = fsm_colCounter[8:0];
  assign _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr_1 = (fsm_colCounter + 10'h001);
  assign _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr = _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr_1[8:0];
  assign _zz_srcRam_port = (io_softClear ? _zz_srcRam_port_1 : srcRamWrAddr);
  assign _zz_srcRam_port_2 = (io_softClear ? 16'h0 : io_busData);
  assign _zz_srcRam_port_3 = (srcRamHit || srcRamClearWr);
  assign _zz_fsm_srcRead = 1'b1;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_srcRam_port_3) begin
      srcRam[_zz_srcRam_port] <= _zz_srcRam_port_2;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_fsm_srcRead) begin
      srcRam_spinal_port1 <= srcRam[fsm_srcReadAddr];
    end
  end

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : fsm_state_string = "IDLE";
      State_RUN : fsm_state_string = "RUN ";
      State_DONE : fsm_state_string = "DONE";
      default : fsm_state_string = "????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign MODE_RECT_FILL = 2'b00;
  assign MODE_RECT_COPY = 2'b01;
  assign MODE_LINE_FILL = 2'b10;
  assign ctrlHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0c00 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0c08));
  assign srcRamHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0c10 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0e10));
  assign ctrlIdx = _zz_ctrlIdx[2 : 0];
  assign srcRamWrAddr = _zz_srcRamWrAddr[8 : 0];
  assign srcRamClearWr = (io_softClear && (io_softClearAddr < 14'h0200));
  assign fsm_dstCur = (fsm_dstRowBase + _zz_fsm_dstCur);
  assign fsm_srcCur = (fsm_srcRowBase + _zz_fsm_srcCur);
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_srcReadAddr = fsm_srcCur;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
        if(goReg) begin
          fsm_srcReadAddr = srcAddrReg;
        end
      end
      State_RUN : begin
        if(when_BlitterEngine_l198) begin
          if(when_BlitterEngine_l200) begin
            if(!when_BlitterEngine_l203) begin
              fsm_srcReadAddr = (fsm_srcRowBase + srcStrideReg);
            end
          end else begin
            fsm_srcReadAddr = (fsm_srcRowBase + _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr);
          end
        end
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_srcRead = srcRam_spinal_port1;
  always @(*) begin
    io_blitWr = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
        if(when_BlitterEngine_l198) begin
          io_blitWr = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign io_blitAddr = fsm_dstCur;
  assign io_blitData = (fsm_isCopy ? fsm_srcRead : fillReg);
  assign io_busy = (fsm_state == State_RUN);
  always @(*) begin
    io_done = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
      end
      default : begin
        io_done = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_BlitterEngine_l198 = (! io_busBusy);
  assign when_BlitterEngine_l200 = (fsm_colCounter == widthReg);
  assign when_BlitterEngine_l203 = (fsm_rowCounter == fsm_effHeight);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      widthReg <= 10'h0;
      heightReg <= 10'h0;
      dstAddrReg <= 15'h0;
      dstStrideReg <= 15'h0;
      srcAddrReg <= 9'h0;
      srcStrideReg <= 9'h0;
      fillReg <= 16'h0;
      goReg <= 1'b0;
      modeReg <= 2'b00;
      fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
      fsm_colCounter <= 10'h0;
      fsm_rowCounter <= 10'h0;
      fsm_dstRowBase <= 15'h0;
      fsm_srcRowBase <= 9'h0;
      fsm_effHeight <= 10'h0;
      fsm_isCopy <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(ctrlHit) begin
        case(ctrlIdx)
          3'b000 : begin
            goReg <= io_busData[0];
            modeReg <= io_busData[2 : 1];
          end
          3'b001 : begin
            widthReg <= io_busData[9 : 0];
          end
          3'b010 : begin
            heightReg <= io_busData[9 : 0];
          end
          3'b011 : begin
            dstAddrReg <= io_busData[14 : 0];
          end
          3'b100 : begin
            dstStrideReg <= io_busData[14 : 0];
          end
          3'b101 : begin
            srcAddrReg <= io_busData[8 : 0];
          end
          3'b110 : begin
            srcStrideReg <= io_busData[8 : 0];
          end
          default : begin
            fillReg <= io_busData;
          end
        endcase
      end
      case(fsm_state)
        State_IDLE : begin
          fsm_colCounter <= 10'h0;
          fsm_rowCounter <= 10'h0;
          if(goReg) begin
            goReg <= 1'b0;
            fsm_state <= State_RUN;
            fsm_dstRowBase <= dstAddrReg;
            fsm_srcRowBase <= srcAddrReg;
            fsm_effHeight <= ((modeReg == MODE_LINE_FILL) ? 10'h0 : heightReg);
            fsm_isCopy <= (modeReg == MODE_RECT_COPY);
          end
        end
        State_RUN : begin
          if(when_BlitterEngine_l198) begin
            if(when_BlitterEngine_l200) begin
              fsm_colCounter <= 10'h0;
              if(when_BlitterEngine_l203) begin
                fsm_state <= State_DONE;
              end else begin
                fsm_rowCounter <= (fsm_rowCounter + 10'h001);
                fsm_dstRowBase <= (fsm_dstRowBase + dstStrideReg);
                fsm_srcRowBase <= (fsm_srcRowBase + srcStrideReg);
              end
            end else begin
              fsm_colCounter <= (fsm_colCounter + 10'h001);
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
          fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module DmaEngine (
  input  wire [14:0]   io_busAddr,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_busData,
  input  wire          io_busWr,
  input  wire          io_busBusy,
  output wire [14:0]   io_dmaAddr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_dmaData,
  output reg           io_dmaWr,
  output wire          io_busy,
  output reg           io_done,
  input  wire          io_softClear,
  input  wire [13:0]   io_softClearAddr,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);
  localparam State_IDLE = 2'd0;
  localparam State_RUN = 2'd1;
  localparam State_DONE = 2'd2;

  wire       [15:0]   staging_spinal_port1;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_ctrlIdx;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_stagingWrAddr;
  wire       [5:0]    _zz_staging_port;
  wire       [5:0]    _zz_staging_port_1;
  wire       [15:0]   _zz_staging_port_2;
  wire                _zz_staging_port_3;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_io_dmaAddr;
  reg        [14:0]   dstReg;
  reg        [9:0]    lenReg;
  reg        [15:0]   fillReg;
  reg                 goReg;
  reg                 modeReg;
  wire                ctrlHit;
  wire                stagingHit;
  wire       [1:0]    ctrlIdx;
  wire       [5:0]    stagingWrAddr;
  wire                stagingClearWr;
  reg        [1:0]    fsm_state;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_counter;
  wire       [5:0]    _zz_fsm_stagingRead;
  wire       [15:0]   fsm_stagingRead;
  wire                when_DmaEngine_l156;
  wire                when_DmaEngine_l158;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [31:0] fsm_state_string;
  `endif

  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [15:0] staging [0:63];

  assign _zz_ctrlIdx = (io_busAddr - 15'h0b00);
  assign _zz_stagingWrAddr = (io_busAddr - 15'h0b10);
  assign _zz_staging_port_1 = io_softClearAddr[5:0];
  assign _zz_io_dmaAddr = {5'd0, fsm_counter};
  assign _zz_staging_port = (io_softClear ? _zz_staging_port_1 : stagingWrAddr);
  assign _zz_staging_port_2 = (io_softClear ? 16'h0 : io_busData);
  assign _zz_staging_port_3 = (stagingHit || stagingClearWr);
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_staging_port_3) begin
      staging[_zz_staging_port] <= _zz_staging_port_2;
    end
  end

  assign staging_spinal_port1 = staging[_zz_fsm_stagingRead];
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : fsm_state_string = "IDLE";
      State_RUN : fsm_state_string = "RUN ";
      State_DONE : fsm_state_string = "DONE";
      default : fsm_state_string = "????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign ctrlHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0b00 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0b04));
  assign stagingHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0b10 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0b50));
  assign ctrlIdx = _zz_ctrlIdx[1 : 0];
  assign stagingWrAddr = _zz_stagingWrAddr[5 : 0];
  assign stagingClearWr = (io_softClear && (io_softClearAddr < 14'h0040));
  assign _zz_fsm_stagingRead = fsm_counter[5 : 0];
  assign fsm_stagingRead = staging_spinal_port1;
  always @(*) begin
    io_dmaWr = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
        if(when_DmaEngine_l156) begin
          io_dmaWr = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign io_dmaAddr = (dstReg + _zz_io_dmaAddr);
  assign io_dmaData = (modeReg ? fsm_stagingRead : fillReg);
  assign io_busy = (fsm_state == State_RUN);
  always @(*) begin
    io_done = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
      end
      default : begin
        io_done = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_DmaEngine_l156 = (! io_busBusy);
  assign when_DmaEngine_l158 = (fsm_counter == lenReg);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      dstReg <= 15'h0;
      lenReg <= 10'h0;
      fillReg <= 16'h0;
      goReg <= 1'b0;
      modeReg <= 1'b0;
      fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
      fsm_counter <= 10'h0;
    end else begin
      if(ctrlHit) begin
        case(ctrlIdx)
          2'b00 : begin
            dstReg <= io_busData[14 : 0];
          end
          2'b01 : begin
            lenReg <= io_busData[9 : 0];
          end
          2'b10 : begin
            fillReg <= io_busData;
          end
          default : begin
            goReg <= io_busData[0];
            modeReg <= io_busData[1];
          end
        endcase
      end
      case(fsm_state)
        State_IDLE : begin
          fsm_counter <= 10'h0;
          if(goReg) begin
            goReg <= 1'b0;
            fsm_state <= State_RUN;
          end
        end
        State_RUN : begin
          if(when_DmaEngine_l156) begin
            if(when_DmaEngine_l158) begin
              fsm_state <= State_DONE;
            end else begin
              fsm_counter <= (fsm_counter + 10'h001);
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
          fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module StreamFifo (
  input  wire          io_push_valid,
  output wire          io_push_ready,
  input  wire [30:0]   io_push_payload,
  output wire          io_pop_valid,
  input  wire          io_pop_ready,
  output wire [30:0]   io_pop_payload,
  input  wire          io_flush,
  output wire [6:0]    io_occupancy,
  output wire [6:0]    io_availability,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  reg        [30:0]   logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPush;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPop;
  wire                logic_ptr_full;
  wire                logic_ptr_empty;
  reg        [6:0]    logic_ptr_push;
  reg        [6:0]    logic_ptr_pop;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_ptr_occupancy;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_ptr_popOnIo;
  wire                when_Stream_l1455;
  reg                 logic_ptr_wentUp;
  wire                io_push_fire;
  wire                logic_push_onRam_write_valid;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address;
  wire       [30:0]   logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_ready;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  reg        [5:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  wire                when_Stream_l477;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload;
  wire       [30:0]   logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  wire       [30:0]   logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire;
  reg        [6:0]    logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  reg [30:0] logic_ram [0:63];

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      logic_ram[logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address] <= logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid) begin
      logic_ram_spinal_port1 <= logic_ram[logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload];
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(logic_push_onRam_write_valid) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l1455 = (logic_ptr_doPush != logic_ptr_doPop);
  assign logic_ptr_full = (((logic_ptr_push ^ logic_ptr_popOnIo) ^ 7'h40) == 7'h0);
  assign logic_ptr_empty = (logic_ptr_push == logic_ptr_pop);
  assign logic_ptr_occupancy = (logic_ptr_push - logic_ptr_popOnIo);
  assign io_push_ready = (! logic_ptr_full);
  assign io_push_fire = (io_push_valid && io_push_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPush = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_valid = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address = logic_ptr_push[5:0];
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data = io_push_payload;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_valid = (! logic_ptr_empty);
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_payload = logic_ptr_pop[5:0];
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_fire = (logic_pop_addressGen_valid && logic_pop_addressGen_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPop = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  always @(*) begin
    logic_pop_addressGen_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
    if(when_Stream_l477) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_ready = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l477 = (! logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid);
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp = logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload = logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  assign io_pop_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready = io_pop_ready;
  assign io_pop_payload = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire = (logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid && logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_popOnIo = logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  assign io_occupancy = logic_ptr_occupancy;
  assign io_availability = (7'h40 - logic_ptr_occupancy);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      logic_ptr_push <= 7'h0;
      logic_ptr_pop <= 7'h0;
      logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 7'h0;
    end else begin
      if(when_Stream_l1455) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= logic_ptr_doPush;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= (logic_ptr_push + 7'h01);
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPop) begin
        logic_ptr_pop <= (logic_ptr_pop + 7'h01);
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= 7'h0;
        logic_ptr_pop <= 7'h0;
      end
      if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= logic_ptr_pop;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 7'h0;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_rData <= logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
    end
  end


endmodule

module LinestateStore (
  input  wire [8:0]    io_writeAddr,
  input  wire [11:0]   io_writeData,
  input  wire          io_writeEnable,
  input  wire [8:0]    io_commitLine,
  input  wire          io_commitStrobe,
  input  wire [8:0]    io_readAddr,
  output wire          io_layer0Enable,
  output wire          io_layer1Enable,
  output wire [9:0]    io_layer0ScrollX,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset

  reg        [11:0]   prepare_spinal_port1;
  wire       [11:0]   commit_spinal_port1;
  wire                _zz_prepare_port;
  wire                _zz_prepareSync;

  reg        [8:0]    commitLineD1;
  reg                 commitCollideD1;
  reg        [11:0]   commitWriteDataD1;
  wire       [11:0]   prepareSync;
  wire       [11:0]   commitData;
  wire       [11:0]   record_1;
  (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [11:0] prepare [0:511];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [11:0] commit [0:511];

  assign _zz_prepareSync = 1'b1;
  initial begin
    $readmemb("/home/itadmin/github/spinalhdlVDP/./simWorkspace/tmp/job_1/Dut.v_toplevel_video_linestate_prepare.bin",prepare);
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_2) begin
      prepare[io_writeAddr] <= io_writeData;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_prepareSync) begin
      prepare_spinal_port1 <= prepare[io_commitLine];
    end
  end

  initial begin
    $readmemb("/home/itadmin/github/spinalhdlVDP/./simWorkspace/tmp/job_1/Dut.v_toplevel_video_linestate_commit.bin",commit);
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin

      commit[commitLineD1] <= commitData;
    end
  end

  assign commit_spinal_port1 = commit[io_readAddr];
  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(commitStrobeD1) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_2 = 1'b0;
    if(io_writeEnable) begin
      _zz_2 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign commitCollide = ((io_commitStrobe && io_writeEnable) && (io_writeAddr == io_commitLine));
  assign prepareSync = prepare_spinal_port1;
  assign commitData = (commitCollideD1 ? commitWriteDataD1 : prepareSync);
  assign record_1 = commit_spinal_port1;
  assign io_layer0Enable = record_1[11];
  assign io_layer1Enable = record_1[10];
  assign io_layer0ScrollX = record_1[9 : 0];
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      commitStrobeD1 <= 1'b0;
      commitLineD1 <= 9'h0;
      commitCollideD1 <= 1'b0;
      commitWriteDataD1 <= 12'h0;
    end else begin
      commitStrobeD1 <= io_commitStrobe;
      commitLineD1 <= io_commitLine;
      commitCollideD1 <= commitCollide;
      commitWriteDataD1 <= io_writeData;
    end
  end


endmodule

  wire       [22:0]   sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_4;
  reg        [2:0]    sdramArea_planeIdx;
  reg        [3:0]    sdramArea_readIdx;
  reg        [1:0]    sdramArea_state;

  reg        [22:0]   sdramArea_addrReg;

  wire                when_BitplaneRowFetch_l171;
  wire                when_BitplaneRowFetch_l173;

  wire       [2:0]    popPlaneIdx;
  wire       [3:0]    popReadIdx;
  wire       [31:0]   popDout32;

  reg        [5:0]    popCounter;

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS

  `endif

  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_0 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_1 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_2 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_3 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_4 [0:9];

  assign _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_1 = (_zz_sdramArea_addrReg_2 <<< 2);
  assign _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_2 = {19'd0, sdramArea_readIdx};
  assign _zz_planeMems_0_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b000));
  assign _zz_planeMems_1_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b001));
  assign _zz_planeMems_2_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b010));
  assign _zz_planeMems_3_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b011));
  assign _zz_planeMems_4_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b100));
  assign planeMems_0_spinal_port0 = planeMems_0[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_0_port) begin
      planeMems_0[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_1_spinal_port0 = planeMems_1[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_1_port) begin
      planeMems_1[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_2_spinal_port0 = planeMems_2[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_2_port) begin
      planeMems_2[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_3_spinal_port0 = planeMems_3[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_3_port) begin
      planeMems_3[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_4_spinal_port0 = planeMems_4[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_4_port) begin
      planeMems_4[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  StreamFifoCC rowFifo (
    .io_push_valid    (sdramArea_pushValid          ), //i
    .io_push_ready    (rowFifo_io_push_ready        ), //o
    .io_push_payload  (sdramArea_pushPayload[38:0]  ), //i
    .io_pop_valid     (rowFifo_io_pop_valid         ), //o
    .io_pop_ready     (rowFifo_io_pop_ready         ), //i
    .io_pop_payload   (rowFifo_io_pop_payload[38:0] ), //o
    .io_pushOccupancy (rowFifo_io_pushOccupancy[7:0]), //o
    .io_popOccupancy  (rowFifo_io_popOccupancy[7:0] ), //o
    .clk              (clk                          ), //i
    .reset            (reset                        )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 startToggle_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (startToggle                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (startToggle_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .clk        (clk                            ), //i
    .reset      (reset                          )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_0_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_planeBaseAddr_0[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_planeBaseAddr_0_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .clk        (clk                                         ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                       )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_1_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_planeBaseAddr_1[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_planeBaseAddr_1_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .clk        (clk                                         ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                       )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_2_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_planeBaseAddr_2[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_planeBaseAddr_2_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .clk        (clk                                         ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                       )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_3_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_planeBaseAddr_3[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_planeBaseAddr_3_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .clk        (clk                                         ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                       )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_4_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_planeBaseAddr_4[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_planeBaseAddr_4_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .clk        (clk                                         ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                       )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 sdramArea_busyLevel_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (sdramArea_busyLevel                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (sdramArea_busyLevel_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .clk        (clk                                    ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                  )  //i
  );
  always @(*) begin
    case(sdramArea_planeIdx)
      3'b000 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_0;
      3'b001 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_1;
      3'b010 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_2;
      3'b011 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_3;
      default : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_4;
    endcase
  end

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(sdramArea_state)
      State_1_Idle : sdramArea_state_string = "Idle    ";
      State_1_Issue : sdramArea_state_string = "Issue   ";
      State_1_WaitData : sdramArea_state_string = "WaitData";
      State_1_Done : sdramArea_state_string = "Done    ";
      default : sdramArea_state_string = "????????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign io_slotWord_0 = planeMems_0_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_1 = planeMems_1_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_2 = planeMems_2_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_3 = planeMems_3_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_4 = planeMems_4_spinal_port0;
  assign sdramArea_startToggleSync = startToggle_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign sdramArea_startEdge = (sdramArea_startToggleSync != sdramArea_startTogglePrev);
  assign sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_0 = io_planeBaseAddr_0_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_1 = io_planeBaseAddr_1_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_2 = io_planeBaseAddr_2_buffercc_io_dataOut;

  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l158 = (! io_sdramBusy);
  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l171 = (sdramArea_readIdx == 4'b1001);
  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l173 = (sdramArea_planeIdx == 3'b100);
  assign sdramArea_busyLevel = (sdramArea_state != State_1_Idle);
  assign io_sdramRd = sdramArea_rdReg;
  assign io_sdramAddr = sdramArea_addrReg;
  assign popPlaneIdx = rowFifo_io_pop_payload[38 : 36];
  assign popReadIdx = rowFifo_io_pop_payload[35 : 32];
  assign popDout32 = rowFifo_io_pop_payload[31 : 0];
  assign rowFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b1;
  assign popFire = (rowFifo_io_pop_valid && rowFifo_io_pop_ready);
  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l243 = (popCounter == 6'h31);
  assign io_rowReady = rowReadyR;
  assign busySdramSync = sdramArea_busyLevel_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign io_busy = ((busySdramSync || rowFifo_io_pop_valid) || (popCounter != 6'h0));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      startToggle <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_startTogglePrev <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
      sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
      sdramArea_state <= State_1_Idle;
      sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_addrReg <= 23'h0;
      sdramArea_rowDoneToggle <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_pushPayload <= 39'h0;
      sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
      popCounter <= 6'h0;
      rowReadyR <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(io_start) begin
        startToggle <= (! startToggle);
      end
      sdramArea_startTogglePrev <= sdramArea_startToggleSync;
      sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
      case(sdramArea_state)
        State_1_Idle : begin
          if(sdramArea_startEdge) begin
            sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
            sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
            sdramArea_state <= State_1_Issue;
          end
        end
        State_1_Issue : begin
          if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l158) begin
            sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramArea_addrReg <= (_zz_sdramArea_addrReg + _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_1);
            sdramArea_state <= State_1_WaitData;
          end
        end
        State_1_WaitData : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_pushPayload <= {{sdramArea_planeIdx,sdramArea_readIdx},io_sdramDout32};
            sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b1;
            if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l171) begin
              sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
              if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l173) begin
                sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
                sdramArea_state <= State_1_Done;
              end else begin
                sdramArea_planeIdx <= (sdramArea_planeIdx + 3'b001);
                sdramArea_state <= State_1_Issue;
              end
            end else begin
              sdramArea_readIdx <= (sdramArea_readIdx + 4'b0001);
              sdramArea_state <= State_1_Issue;
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
          sdramArea_rowDoneToggle <= (! sdramArea_rowDoneToggle);
          sdramArea_state <= State_1_Idle;
        end
      endcase
      `ifndef SYNTHESIS
        `ifdef FORMAL
          assert(((! popFire) || (popPlaneIdx < 3'b101))); // BitplaneRowFetch.scala:L221
        `else
          if(!((! popFire) || (popPlaneIdx < 3'b101)) && $realtime != 0) begin
            $display("ERROR P3 Risk #2: popPlaneIdx >= planeCount (non-pow2 planeCount silent-drop)"); // BitplaneRowFetch.scala:L221
          end
        `endif
      `endif
      rowReadyR <= 1'b0;
      if(io_start) begin
        popCounter <= 6'h0;
      end
      if(popFire) begin
        if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l243) begin
          popCounter <= 6'h0;
          rowReadyR <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
          popCounter <= (popCounter + 6'h01);
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module ScrollWrap_1 (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_coord,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_scroll,
  output wire [8:0]    io_result
);

  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_1;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_2;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_3;
  wire       [10:0]   sum;
  wire       [10:0]   wrapped;

  assign _zz_wrapped = (sum - 11'h780);
  assign _zz_wrapped_1 = (sum - 11'h5a0);
  assign _zz_wrapped_2 = (sum - 11'h3c0);
  assign _zz_wrapped_3 = (sum - 11'h1e0);
  assign sum = ({1'b0,io_coord} + {1'b0,io_scroll});
  assign wrapped = ((11'h780 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped : ((11'h5a0 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_1 : ((11'h3c0 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_2 : ((11'h1e0 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_3 : sum))));
  assign io_result = wrapped[8:0];

endmodule

module ScrollWrap (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_coord,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_scroll,
  output wire [9:0]    io_result
);

  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_1;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_2;
  wire       [10:0]   sum;
  wire       [10:0]   wrapped;

  assign _zz_wrapped = (sum - 11'h780);
  assign _zz_wrapped_1 = (sum - 11'h500);
  assign _zz_wrapped_2 = (sum - 11'h280);
  assign sum = ({1'b0,io_coord} + {1'b0,io_scroll});
  assign wrapped = ((11'h780 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped : ((11'h500 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_1 : ((11'h280 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_2 : sum)));
  assign io_result = wrapped[9:0];

endmodule

// Generator : SpinalHDL v1.12.3    git head : 591e64062329e5e2e2b81f4d52422948053edb97
// Component : HamDecoder
// Git hash  : 4fc130ea8b68a1fa38bcf7c43b0ae5d4bfcae0ed

`timescale 1ns/1ps

module HamDecoder (
  input  wire          io_lineStart,
  input  wire          io_step,
  input  wire [5:0]    io_code,
  input  wire [11:0]   io_baseColor,
  input  wire [11:0]   io_seedColor,
  output wire [11:0]   io_rgb444,
  output wire [23:0]   io_rgb888,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  reg        [11:0]   acc;
  wire       [3:0]    rHold;
  wire       [3:0]    gHold;
  wire       [3:0]    bHold;
  wire       [1:0]    ctrl;
  wire       [3:0]    data;
  reg        [11:0]   nextColor;
  wire       [3:0]    nr;
  wire       [3:0]    ng;
  wire       [3:0]    nb;

  assign rHold = acc[11 : 8];
  assign gHold = acc[7 : 4];
  assign bHold = acc[3 : 0];
  assign ctrl = io_code[5 : 4];
  assign data = io_code[3 : 0];
  always @(*) begin
    case(ctrl)
      2'b00 : begin
        nextColor = io_baseColor;
      end
      2'b01 : begin
        nextColor = {{rHold,gHold},data};
      end
      2'b10 : begin
        nextColor = {{data,gHold},bHold};
      end
      default : begin
        nextColor = {{rHold,data},bHold};
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign io_rgb444 = nextColor;
  assign nr = nextColor[11 : 8];
  assign ng = nextColor[7 : 4];
  assign nb = nextColor[3 : 0];
  assign io_rgb888 = {{{nr,nr},{ng,ng}},{nb,nb}};
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      acc <= 12'h0;
    end else begin
      if(io_lineStart) begin
        acc <= io_seedColor;
      end else begin
        if(io_step) begin
          acc <= nextColor;
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule
