        if(when_QspiUploadCollisionSim_l106) begin
          popArea_refreshTimer <= 10'h0;
          popArea_refreshNow <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
          popArea_refreshTimer <= (popArea_refreshTimer + 10'h001);
        end
      end
      popArea_busyPrev <= bb_busy;
      if(popArea_refreshNow) begin
        popArea_cooldownCnt <= 4'b1000;
      end else begin
        if(when_QspiUploadCollisionSim_l125) begin
          popArea_cooldownCnt <= (popArea_cooldownCnt - 4'b0001);
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module StreamFifoCC_1 (
  input  wire          io_push_valid,
  output wire          io_push_ready,
  input  wire [30:0]   io_push_payload,
  output wire          io_pop_valid,
  input  wire          io_pop_ready,
  output wire [30:0]   io_pop_payload,
  output wire [7:0]    io_pushOccupancy,
  output wire [7:0]    io_popOccupancy,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset,
  input  wire          sdram_clk
);

  reg        [30:0]   ram_spinal_port1;
  wire       [7:0]    popToPushGray_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                reset_asyncAssertSyncDeassert_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [7:0]    pushToPopGray_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [7:0]    _zz_pushCC_pushPtrGray;
  wire       [6:0]    _zz_ram_port;
  wire       [7:0]    _zz_popCC_popPtrGray;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  wire       [7:0]    popToPushGray;
  wire       [7:0]    pushToPopGray;
  reg        [7:0]    pushCC_pushPtr;
  wire       [7:0]    pushCC_pushPtrPlus;
  wire                io_push_fire;
  (* altera_attribute = "-name ADV_NETLIST_OPT_ALLOWED NEVER_ALLOW" *) reg        [7:0]    pushCC_pushPtrGray;
  wire       [7:0]    pushCC_popPtrGray;
  wire                pushCC_full;
  wire                _zz_io_pushOccupancy;
  wire                _zz_io_pushOccupancy_1;
  wire                _zz_io_pushOccupancy_2;
  wire                _zz_io_pushOccupancy_3;
  wire                _zz_io_pushOccupancy_4;
  wire                _zz_io_pushOccupancy_5;
  wire                _zz_io_pushOccupancy_6;
  wire                reset_asyncAssertSyncDeassert;
  wire                reset_synchronized;
  reg        [7:0]    popCC_popPtr;
  (* keep , syn_keep *) wire       [7:0]    popCC_popPtrPlus /* synthesis syn_keep = 1 */ ;
  wire       [7:0]    popCC_popPtrGray;
  wire       [7:0]    popCC_pushPtrGray;
  wire                popCC_addressGen_valid;
  reg                 popCC_addressGen_ready;
  wire       [6:0]    popCC_addressGen_payload;
  wire                popCC_empty;
  wire                popCC_addressGen_fire;
  wire                popCC_readArbitation_valid;
  wire                popCC_readArbitation_ready;
  wire       [6:0]    popCC_readArbitation_payload;
  reg                 popCC_addressGen_rValid;
  reg        [6:0]    popCC_addressGen_rData;
  wire                when_Stream_l477;
  wire                popCC_readPort_cmd_valid;
  wire       [6:0]    popCC_readPort_cmd_payload;
  wire       [30:0]   popCC_readPort_rsp;
  wire                popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  wire       [6:0]    popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  wire                popCC_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  wire                popCC_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  wire       [30:0]   popCC_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  wire                popCC_readArbitation_fire;
  (* altera_attribute = "-name ADV_NETLIST_OPT_ALLOWED NEVER_ALLOW" *) reg        [7:0]    popCC_ptrToPush;
  reg        [7:0]    popCC_ptrToOccupancy;
  wire                _zz_io_popOccupancy;
  wire                _zz_io_popOccupancy_1;
  wire                _zz_io_popOccupancy_2;
  wire                _zz_io_popOccupancy_3;
  wire                _zz_io_popOccupancy_4;
  wire                _zz_io_popOccupancy_5;
  wire                _zz_io_popOccupancy_6;
  reg [30:0] ram [0:127];

  assign _zz_pushCC_pushPtrGray = (pushCC_pushPtrPlus >>> 1'b1);
  assign _zz_ram_port = pushCC_pushPtr[6:0];
  assign _zz_popCC_popPtrGray = (popCC_popPtr >>> 1'b1);
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      ram[_zz_ram_port] <= io_push_payload;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge sdram_clk) begin
    if(popCC_readPort_cmd_valid) begin
      ram_spinal_port1 <= ram[popCC_readPort_cmd_payload];
    end
  end

  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_10 popToPushGray_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (popToPushGray[7:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (popToPushGray_buffercc_io_dataOut[7:0]), //o
    .clk        (clk                                   ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                 )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_11 reset_asyncAssertSyncDeassert_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (reset_asyncAssertSyncDeassert                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (reset_asyncAssertSyncDeassert_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .sdram_clk  (sdram_clk                                        ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                            )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_12 pushToPopGray_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn          (pushToPopGray[7:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut         (pushToPopGray_buffercc_io_dataOut[7:0]), //o
    .sdram_clk          (sdram_clk                             ), //i
    .reset_synchronized (reset_synchronized                    )  //i
  );
  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(io_push_fire) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign pushCC_pushPtrPlus = (pushCC_pushPtr + 8'h01);
  assign io_push_fire = (io_push_valid && io_push_ready);
  assign pushCC_popPtrGray = popToPushGray_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign pushCC_full = ((pushCC_pushPtrGray[7 : 6] == (~ pushCC_popPtrGray[7 : 6])) && (pushCC_pushPtrGray[5 : 0] == pushCC_popPtrGray[5 : 0]));
  assign io_push_ready = (! pushCC_full);
  assign _zz_io_pushOccupancy = (pushCC_popPtrGray[1] ^ _zz_io_pushOccupancy_1);
  assign _zz_io_pushOccupancy_1 = (pushCC_popPtrGray[2] ^ _zz_io_pushOccupancy_2);
  assign _zz_io_pushOccupancy_2 = (pushCC_popPtrGray[3] ^ _zz_io_pushOccupancy_3);
  assign _zz_io_pushOccupancy_3 = (pushCC_popPtrGray[4] ^ _zz_io_pushOccupancy_4);
  assign _zz_io_pushOccupancy_4 = (pushCC_popPtrGray[5] ^ _zz_io_pushOccupancy_5);
  assign _zz_io_pushOccupancy_5 = (pushCC_popPtrGray[6] ^ _zz_io_pushOccupancy_6);
  assign _zz_io_pushOccupancy_6 = pushCC_popPtrGray[7];
  assign io_pushOccupancy = (pushCC_pushPtr - {_zz_io_pushOccupancy_6,{_zz_io_pushOccupancy_5,{_zz_io_pushOccupancy_4,{_zz_io_pushOccupancy_3,{_zz_io_pushOccupancy_2,{_zz_io_pushOccupancy_1,{_zz_io_pushOccupancy,(pushCC_popPtrGray[0] ^ _zz_io_pushOccupancy)}}}}}}});
  assign reset_asyncAssertSyncDeassert = (1'b0 ^ 1'b0);
  assign reset_synchronized = reset_asyncAssertSyncDeassert_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign popCC_popPtrPlus = (popCC_popPtr + 8'h01);
  assign popCC_popPtrGray = (_zz_popCC_popPtrGray ^ popCC_popPtr);
  assign popCC_pushPtrGray = pushToPopGray_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign popCC_empty = (popCC_popPtrGray == popCC_pushPtrGray);
  assign popCC_addressGen_valid = (! popCC_empty);
  assign popCC_addressGen_payload = popCC_popPtr[6:0];
  assign popCC_addressGen_fire = (popCC_addressGen_valid && popCC_addressGen_ready);
  always @(*) begin
    popCC_addressGen_ready = popCC_readArbitation_ready;
    if(when_Stream_l477) begin
      popCC_addressGen_ready = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l477 = (! popCC_readArbitation_valid);
  assign popCC_readArbitation_valid = popCC_addressGen_rValid;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_payload = popCC_addressGen_rData;
  assign popCC_readPort_rsp = ram_spinal_port1;
  assign popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid = popCC_addressGen_fire;
  assign popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload = popCC_addressGen_payload;
  assign popCC_readPort_cmd_valid = popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  assign popCC_readPort_cmd_payload = popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_translated_valid = popCC_readArbitation_valid;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_ready = popCC_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_translated_payload = popCC_readPort_rsp;
  assign io_pop_valid = popCC_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_translated_ready = io_pop_ready;
  assign io_pop_payload = popCC_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_fire = (popCC_readArbitation_valid && popCC_readArbitation_ready);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy = (popCC_pushPtrGray[1] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_1);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_1 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[2] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_2);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_2 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[3] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_3);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_3 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[4] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_4);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_4 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[5] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_5);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_5 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[6] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_6);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_6 = popCC_pushPtrGray[7];
  assign io_popOccupancy = ({_zz_io_popOccupancy_6,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_5,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_4,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_3,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_2,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_1,{_zz_io_popOccupancy,(popCC_pushPtrGray[0] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy)}}}}}}} - popCC_ptrToOccupancy);
  assign pushToPopGray = pushCC_pushPtrGray;
  assign popToPushGray = popCC_ptrToPush;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      pushCC_pushPtr <= 8'h0;
      pushCC_pushPtrGray <= 8'h0;
    end else begin
      if(io_push_fire) begin
        pushCC_pushPtrGray <= (_zz_pushCC_pushPtrGray ^ pushCC_pushPtrPlus);
      end
      if(io_push_fire) begin
        pushCC_pushPtr <= pushCC_pushPtrPlus;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge reset_synchronized) begin
    if(reset_synchronized) begin
      popCC_popPtr <= 8'h0;
      popCC_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      popCC_ptrToPush <= 8'h0;
      popCC_ptrToOccupancy <= 8'h0;
    end else begin
      if(popCC_addressGen_fire) begin
        popCC_popPtr <= popCC_popPtrPlus;
      end
      if(popCC_addressGen_ready) begin
        popCC_addressGen_rValid <= popCC_addressGen_valid;
      end
      if(popCC_readArbitation_fire) begin
        popCC_ptrToPush <= popCC_popPtrGray;
      end
      if(popCC_readArbitation_fire) begin
        popCC_ptrToOccupancy <= popCC_popPtr;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge sdram_clk) begin
    if(popCC_addressGen_ready) begin
      popCC_addressGen_rData <= popCC_addressGen_payload;
    end
  end


endmodule

module QspiSdramBridge (
  input  wire          io_headerValid,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_addrInit,
  input  wire [16:0]   io_lenBytes,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_byteIn,
  input  wire          io_byteValid,
  input  wire          io_allowUpload,
  output wire          io_wrCmd_valid,
  input  wire          io_wrCmd_ready,
  output wire [30:0]   io_wrCmd_payload,
  output wire          io_uploadBusy,
  output wire          io_uploadDone,
  output wire          io_uploadError,
  output wire          io_fifoOverflow,
  output wire          io_dbgHdrPushed,
  output wire          io_dbgBytePushed,
  output wire [2:0]    io_dbgFsmState,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);
  localparam fsm_BOOT = 3'd0;
  localparam fsm_sIdle = 3'd1;
  localparam fsm_sActive = 3'd2;
  localparam fsm_sFlush = 3'd3;
  localparam fsm_sDone = 3'd4;

  wire                byteFifo_io_pop_ready;
  wire       [39:0]   hdrFifo_io_push_payload;
  reg                 hdrFifo_io_pop_ready;
  wire                byteFifo_io_push_ready;
  wire                byteFifo_io_pop_valid;
  wire       [7:0]    byteFifo_io_pop_payload;
  wire       [7:0]    byteFifo_io_occupancy;
  wire       [7:0]    byteFifo_io_availability;
  wire                hdrFifo_io_push_ready;
  wire                hdrFifo_io_pop_valid;
  wire       [39:0]   hdrFifo_io_pop_payload;
  wire       [3:0]    hdrFifo_io_occupancy;
  wire       [3:0]    hdrFifo_io_availability;
  reg        [22:0]   addrReg;
  reg        [16:0]   bytesLeft;
  reg                 fifoOverflow;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l97;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l101;
  reg                 donePulse;
  reg        [15:0]   stallCnt;
  reg                 uploadError;
  wire                fsm_wantExit;
  reg                 fsm_wantStart;
  wire                fsm_wantKill;
  wire                io_wrCmd_fire;
  reg                 _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed;
  reg                 _zz_io_dbgBytePushed;
  reg        [2:0]    fsm_stateReg;
  reg        [2:0]    fsm_stateNext;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l152;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l160;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l171;
  wire                fsm_onExit_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sIdle;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sActive;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sFlush;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sDone;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sIdle;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sActive;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sFlush;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sDone;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateReg_string;
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateNext_string;
  `endif


  StreamFifo byteFifo (
    .io_push_valid   (io_byteValid                 ), //i
    .io_push_ready   (byteFifo_io_push_ready       ), //o
    .io_push_payload (io_byteIn[7:0]               ), //i
    .io_pop_valid    (byteFifo_io_pop_valid        ), //o
    .io_pop_ready    (byteFifo_io_pop_ready        ), //i
    .io_pop_payload  (byteFifo_io_pop_payload[7:0] ), //o
    .io_flush        (1'b0                         ), //i
    .io_occupancy    (byteFifo_io_occupancy[7:0]   ), //o
    .io_availability (byteFifo_io_availability[7:0]), //o
    .clk             (clk                          ), //i
    .reset           (reset                        )  //i
  );
  StreamFifo_1 hdrFifo (
    .io_push_valid   (io_headerValid               ), //i
    .io_push_ready   (hdrFifo_io_push_ready        ), //o
    .io_push_payload (hdrFifo_io_push_payload[39:0]), //i
    .io_pop_valid    (hdrFifo_io_pop_valid         ), //o
    .io_pop_ready    (hdrFifo_io_pop_ready         ), //i
    .io_pop_payload  (hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[39:0] ), //o
    .io_flush        (1'b0                         ), //i
    .io_occupancy    (hdrFifo_io_occupancy[3:0]    ), //o
    .io_availability (hdrFifo_io_availability[3:0] ), //o
    .clk             (clk                          ), //i
    .reset           (reset                        )  //i
  );
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateReg_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sIdle : fsm_stateReg_string = "sIdle  ";
      fsm_sActive : fsm_stateReg_string = "sActive";
      fsm_sFlush : fsm_stateReg_string = "sFlush ";
      fsm_sDone : fsm_stateReg_string = "sDone  ";
      default : fsm_stateReg_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateNext)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateNext_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sIdle : fsm_stateNext_string = "sIdle  ";
      fsm_sActive : fsm_stateNext_string = "sActive";
      fsm_sFlush : fsm_stateNext_string = "sFlush ";
      fsm_sDone : fsm_stateNext_string = "sDone  ";
      default : fsm_stateNext_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l97 = (io_byteValid && (! byteFifo_io_push_ready));
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l101 = (io_wrCmd_valid && (! io_wrCmd_ready));
  assign hdrFifo_io_push_payload = {io_addrInit,io_lenBytes};
  always @(*) begin
    hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantExit = 1'b0;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_wantStart = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
        fsm_wantStart = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantKill = 1'b0;
  assign io_wrCmd_valid = (((fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive) && byteFifo_io_pop_valid) && io_allowUpload);
  assign io_wrCmd_payload = {addrReg,byteFifo_io_pop_payload};
  assign io_wrCmd_fire = (io_wrCmd_valid && io_wrCmd_ready);
  assign byteFifo_io_pop_ready = (io_wrCmd_fire || (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sFlush));
  assign io_uploadBusy = ((! (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle)) || hdrFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign io_uploadDone = donePulse;
  assign io_uploadError = uploadError;
  assign io_fifoOverflow = fifoOverflow;
  assign io_dbgHdrPushed = _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed;
  assign io_dbgBytePushed = _zz_io_dbgBytePushed;
  assign io_dbgFsmState = {(fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle),{(fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive),(fsm_stateReg == fsm_sDone)}};
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_stateNext = fsm_stateReg;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sActive;
        end
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
        if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l152) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sDone;
          end
        end else begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l160) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sFlush;
          end
        end
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
        if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l171) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
        end
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
        fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
    if(fsm_wantStart) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
    end
    if(fsm_wantKill) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_BOOT;
    end
  end

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l152 = (bytesLeft == 17'h00001);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l160 = (stallCnt == 16'hffff);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l171 = (! byteFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign fsm_onExit_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onExit_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onExit_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive));
  assign fsm_onExit_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onExit_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sDone));
  assign fsm_onEntry_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sActive));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sDone));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      addrReg <= 23'h0;
      bytesLeft <= 17'h0;
      fifoOverflow <= 1'b0;
      donePulse <= 1'b0;
      stallCnt <= 16'h0;
      uploadError <= 1'b0;
      _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed <= 1'b0;
      _zz_io_dbgBytePushed <= 1'b0;
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_BOOT;
    end else begin
      if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l97) begin
        fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l101) begin
        fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
      end
      donePulse <= 1'b0;
      _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed <= (io_headerValid && hdrFifo_io_push_ready);
      _zz_io_dbgBytePushed <= (io_byteValid && byteFifo_io_push_ready);
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_stateNext;
      case(fsm_stateReg)
        fsm_sIdle : begin
          stallCnt <= 16'h0;
          if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
            addrReg <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[39 : 17];
            bytesLeft <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[16 : 0];
          end
        end
        fsm_sActive : begin
          if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
            addrReg <= (addrReg + 23'h000001);
            bytesLeft <= (bytesLeft - 17'h00001);
            stallCnt <= 16'h0;
          end else begin
            stallCnt <= (stallCnt + 16'h0001);
            if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l160) begin
              uploadError <= 1'b1;
            end
          end
        end
        fsm_sFlush : begin
        end
        fsm_sDone : begin
          donePulse <= 1'b1;
        end
        default : begin
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module QspiTransportCore (
  input  wire          io_clk,
  input  wire          io_sclk,
  input  wire          io_csn,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_ioIn,
  output wire [3:0]    io_ioOut,
  output wire          io_ioOe,
  output wire [14:0]   io_regBus_addr,

  QspiSlaveSync slave (
    .io_sclk         (io_sclk                  ), //i
    .io_csn          (io_csn                   ), //i

    .io_cmdLen       (slave_io_cmdLen[15:0]    ), //o
    .io_cmdValid     (slave_io_cmdValid        ), //o
    .io_payloadByte  (slave_io_payloadByte[7:0]), //o
    .io_payloadValid (slave_io_payloadValid    ), //o
    .io_rxWord       (rxWordSel[31:0]          ), //i
    .io_active       (slave_io_active          ), //o
    .io_hdrErr       (slave_io_hdrErr          ), //o
    .io_crcBad       (slave_io_crcBad          )  //o
  );
  QspiDecoder sys_dec (
    .io_cmd_opcode         (fifo_io_pop_payload_opcode[7:0]), //i
    .io_cmd_addr           (fifo_io_pop_payload_addr[23:0] ), //i
    .io_cmd_len            (fifo_io_pop_payload_len[15:0]  ), //i
    .io_cmd_valid          (sys_dec_io_cmd_valid           ), //i
    .io_payload_byte       (sys_dec_io_payload_byte[7:0]   ), //i
    .io_payload_valid      (pop_isPayload                  ), //i
    .io_payload_word       (16'h0                          ), //i
    .io_payload_word_valid (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_tx_byte            (sys_dec_io_tx_byte[7:0]        ), //o
    .io_tx_load            (sys_dec_io_tx_load             ), //o
    .io_tx_byte_sent       (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_active             (                               ), //i

    .io_sdramLenBytes      (sys_dec_io_sdramLenBytes[16:0] ), //o
    .io_sdramByteOut       (sys_dec_io_sdramByteOut[7:0]   ), //o
    .io_sdramByteValid     (sys_dec_io_sdramByteValid      ), //o
    .io_sdramWordOut       (sys_dec_io_sdramWordOut[15:0]  ), //o
    .io_sdramWordValid     (sys_dec_io_sdramWordValid      ), //o
    .io_upload_busy        (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_upload_done        (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_upload_error       (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_upload_overflow    (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_rx_word            (sys_dec_io_rx_word[31:0]       ), //o
    .io_rx_word_valid      (sys_dec_io_rx_word_valid       ), //o
    .io_clk                (io_clk                         )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_2 slave_io_crcBad_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (slave_io_crcBad                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (slave_io_crcBad_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_clk     (io_clk                             )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 sys_lastRegData_buffercc (

    .io_dataOut (sys_lastRegData_buffercc_io_dataOut[15:0]), //o

  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 sys_lastRegAddr_buffercc (

    .io_dataOut (sys_lastRegAddr_buffercc_io_dataOut[15:0]), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                                  )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_5 io_debug_sdram_data_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_debug_sdram_data[31:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_debug_sdram_data_buffercc_io_dataOut[31:0]), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                                      )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_6 crcCap_errSticky_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (crcCap_errSticky                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (crcCap_errSticky_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                             )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 crcCap_errCount_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (crcCap_errCount[15:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (crcCap_errCount_buffercc_io_dataOut[15:0]), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                                  )  //i
  );
  StreamFifoCC fifo (
    .io_push_valid            (fifo_io_push_valid             ), //i
    .io_push_ready            (fifo_io_push_ready             ), //o
    .io_push_payload_isHeader (push_tok_isHeader              ), //i
    .io_push_payload_opcode   (push_tok_opcode[7:0]           ), //i
    .io_push_payload_addr     (push_tok_addr[23:0]            ), //i

    .io_push_payload_word     (push_tok_word[15:0]            ), //i
    .io_pop_valid             (fifo_io_pop_valid              ), //o
    .io_pop_ready             (fifo_io_pop_ready              ), //i
    .io_pop_payload_isHeader  (fifo_io_pop_payload_isHeader   ), //o
    .io_pop_payload_opcode    (fifo_io_pop_payload_opcode[7:0]), //o
    .io_pop_payload_addr      (fifo_io_pop_payload_addr[23:0] ), //o
    .io_pop_payload_len       (fifo_io_pop_payload_len[15:0]  ), //o
    .io_pop_payload_word      (fifo_io_pop_payload_word[15:0] ), //o
    .io_pushOccupancy         (fifo_io_pushOccupancy[9:0]     ), //o
    .io_popOccupancy          (fifo_io_popOccupancy[9:0]      ), //o
    .io_sclk                  (io_sclk                        ), //i
    .io_clk                   (io_clk                         )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_2 push_overflow_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (push_overflow                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (push_overflow_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_clk     (io_clk                           )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_2 push_malformed_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (push_malformed                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (push_malformed_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_clk     (io_clk                            )  //i
  );
  initial begin
    sys_lastRegAddr = 16'h0;
    sys_lastRegData = 16'h0;
    crcCap_badPrev = 1'b0;
    crcCap_errSticky = 1'b0;
    crcCap_errCount = 16'h0;
    loop_hdrErrSticky = 1'b0;
    loop_hdrErrCount = 16'h0;
    push_loByte = 8'h0;
    push_haveLo = 1'b0;
    push_malformed = 1'b0;
    push_overflow = 1'b0;
    pop_hiPhase = 1'b0;
  end

  assign io_ioOut = slave_io_ioOut;
  assign io_ioOe = slave_io_ioOe;
  assign crcCap_badSync = slave_io_crcBad_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign when_QspiTransportCore_l106 = (crcCap_badSync && (! crcCap_badPrev));
  assign loop_lastDataCC = sys_lastRegData_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_lastAddrCC = sys_lastRegAddr_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_dbgSdramCC = io_debug_sdram_data_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_crcErrSticky = crcCap_errSticky_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_crcErrCount = crcCap_errCount_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign push_wordComplete = (slave_io_payloadValid && push_haveLo);
  assign push_assembled = {slave_io_payloadByte,push_loByte};
  assign push_tok_isHeader = slave_io_cmdValid;
  assign push_tok_opcode = slave_io_cmdOpcode;
  assign push_tok_addr = slave_io_cmdAddr;
  assign push_tok_len = slave_io_cmdLen;
  assign push_tok_word = push_assembled;
  assign fifo_io_push_valid = (slave_io_cmdValid || push_wordComplete);
  assign when_QspiTransportCore_l171 = (fifo_io_push_valid && (! fifo_io_push_ready));
  assign sel = slave_io_cmdAddr[7 : 0];
  always @(*) begin
    rxWordSel = 32'h0;
    case(sel)
      8'h0 : begin
        rxWordSel = 32'h51560002;
      end
      8'h07 : begin
        rxWordSel = {{15'h0,loop_hdrErrSticky},loop_hdrErrCount};
      end
      8'h08 : begin
        rxWordSel = loop_dbgSdramCC;
      end
      8'h09 : begin
        rxWordSel = {loop_lastDataCC,loop_lastAddrCC};
      end
      8'h0a : begin
        rxWordSel = {{30'h0,push_malformed},push_overflow};
      end
      8'h0b : begin
        rxWordSel = {{15'h0,loop_crcErrSticky},loop_crcErrCount};
      end
      default : begin
        rxWordSel = 32'h0;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign pop_isPayload = (fifo_io_pop_valid && (! fifo_io_pop_payload_isHeader));
  assign fifo_io_pop_ready = (pop_isPayload ? pop_hiPhase : fifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign sys_dec_io_cmd_valid = (fifo_io_pop_valid && fifo_io_pop_payload_isHeader);
  assign sys_dec_io_payload_byte = (pop_hiPhase ? fifo_io_pop_payload_word[15 : 8] : fifo_io_pop_payload_word[7 : 0]);
  assign pop_overflowCC = push_overflow_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign pop_malformedCC = push_malformed_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign io_regBus_addr = sys_dec_io_regBus_addr;
  assign io_regBus_data = sys_dec_io_regBus_data;
  assign io_regBus_enable = sys_dec_io_regBus_enable;
  assign io_sdramByteOut = sys_dec_io_sdramByteOut;
  assign io_sdramByteValid = sys_dec_io_sdramByteValid;
  assign io_sdramWordOut = sys_dec_io_sdramWordOut;
  assign io_sdramWordValid = sys_dec_io_sdramWordValid;
  assign io_sdramHeaderValid = sys_dec_io_sdramHeaderValid;
  assign io_sdramAddrInit = sys_dec_io_sdramAddrInit;
  assign io_sdramLenBytes = sys_dec_io_sdramLenBytes;
  assign io_overflow = pop_overflowCC;
  assign io_malformed = pop_malformedCC;
  assign io_hdrErr = loop_hdrErrSticky;
  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    if(sys_dec_io_regBus_enable) begin
      sys_lastRegAddr <= {1'd0, sys_dec_io_regBus_addr};
      sys_lastRegData <= sys_dec_io_regBus_data;
    end
    crcCap_badPrev <= crcCap_badSync;
    if(when_QspiTransportCore_l106) begin
      crcCap_errSticky <= 1'b1;
      crcCap_errCount <= (crcCap_errCount + 16'h0001);
    end
    if(pop_isPayload) begin
      pop_hiPhase <= (! pop_hiPhase);
    end
  end

  always @(posedge io_sclk) begin
    if(slave_io_hdrErr) begin
      loop_hdrErrSticky <= 1'b1;
      loop_hdrErrCount <= (loop_hdrErrCount + 16'h0001);
    end
    if(slave_io_cmdValid) begin
      if(push_haveLo) begin
        push_malformed <= 1'b1;
      end
      push_haveLo <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(slave_io_payloadValid) begin
        if(push_haveLo) begin
          push_haveLo <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
          push_loByte <= slave_io_payloadByte;
          push_haveLo <= 1'b1;
        end
      end
    end
    if(when_QspiTransportCore_l171) begin
      push_overflow <= 1'b1;
    end
  end


endmodule

module BufferCC_12 (
  input  wire [7:0]    io_dataIn,
  output wire [7:0]    io_dataOut,
  input  wire          sdram_clk,
  input  wire          reset_synchronized
);

  (* async_reg = "true" , altera_attribute = "-name ADV_NETLIST_OPT_ALLOWED NEVER_ALLOW" *) reg        [7:0]    buffers_0;
  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg        [7:0]    buffers_1;

  assign io_dataOut = buffers_1;
  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge reset_synchronized) begin
    if(reset_synchronized) begin
      buffers_0 <= 8'h0;
      buffers_1 <= 8'h0;
    end else begin
      buffers_0 <= io_dataIn;
      buffers_1 <= buffers_0;
    end
  end


endmodule

module BufferCC_11 (
  input  wire          io_dataIn,
  output wire          io_dataOut,
  input  wire          sdram_clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg                 buffers_0;
  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg                 buffers_1;

  assign io_dataOut = buffers_1;
  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      buffers_0 <= 1'b1;
      buffers_1 <= 1'b1;
    end else begin
      buffers_0 <= io_dataIn;
      buffers_1 <= buffers_0;
    end
  end


endmodule

module BufferCC_10 (

  output wire [7:0]    io_dataOut,

  input  wire          reset

  (* async_reg = "true" , altera_attribute = "-name ADV_NETLIST_OPT_ALLOWED NEVER_ALLOW" *) reg        [7:0]    buffers_0;
  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg        [7:0]    buffers_1;

  assign io_dataOut = buffers_1;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      buffers_0 <= 8'h0;
      buffers_1 <= 8'h0;
    end else begin
      buffers_0 <= io_dataIn;
      buffers_1 <= buffers_0;
    end
  end


endmodule

module StreamFifo_1 (
  input  wire          io_push_valid,
  output wire          io_push_ready,
  input  wire [39:0]   io_push_payload,
  output wire          io_pop_valid,
  input  wire          io_pop_ready,
  output wire [39:0]   io_pop_payload,
  input  wire          io_flush,
  output wire [3:0]    io_occupancy,
  output wire [3:0]    io_availability,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  reg        [39:0]   logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPush;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPop;
  wire                logic_ptr_full;
  wire                logic_ptr_empty;
  reg        [3:0]    logic_ptr_push;
  reg        [3:0]    logic_ptr_pop;
  wire       [3:0]    logic_ptr_occupancy;
  wire       [3:0]    logic_ptr_popOnIo;
  wire                when_Stream_l1455;
  reg                 logic_ptr_wentUp;
  wire                io_push_fire;
  wire                logic_push_onRam_write_valid;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address;
  wire       [39:0]   logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_ready;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  reg        [2:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  wire                when_Stream_l477;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload;
  wire       [39:0]   logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  wire       [39:0]   logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire;
  reg        [3:0]    logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  reg [39:0] logic_ram [0:7];

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      logic_ram[logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address] <= logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid) begin
      logic_ram_spinal_port1 <= logic_ram[logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload];
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(logic_push_onRam_write_valid) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l1455 = (logic_ptr_doPush != logic_ptr_doPop);
  assign logic_ptr_full = (((logic_ptr_push ^ logic_ptr_popOnIo) ^ 4'b1000) == 4'b0000);
  assign logic_ptr_empty = (logic_ptr_push == logic_ptr_pop);
  assign logic_ptr_occupancy = (logic_ptr_push - logic_ptr_popOnIo);
  assign io_push_ready = (! logic_ptr_full);
  assign io_push_fire = (io_push_valid && io_push_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPush = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_valid = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address = logic_ptr_push[2:0];
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data = io_push_payload;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_valid = (! logic_ptr_empty);
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_payload = logic_ptr_pop[2:0];
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_fire = (logic_pop_addressGen_valid && logic_pop_addressGen_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPop = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  always @(*) begin
    logic_pop_addressGen_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
    if(when_Stream_l477) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_ready = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l477 = (! logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid);
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp = logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload = logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  assign io_pop_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready = io_pop_ready;
  assign io_pop_payload = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire = (logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid && logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_popOnIo = logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  assign io_occupancy = logic_ptr_occupancy;
  assign io_availability = (4'b1000 - logic_ptr_occupancy);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      logic_ptr_push <= 4'b0000;
      logic_ptr_pop <= 4'b0000;
      logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 4'b0000;
    end else begin
      if(when_Stream_l1455) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= logic_ptr_doPush;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= (logic_ptr_push + 4'b0001);
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPop) begin
        logic_ptr_pop <= (logic_ptr_pop + 4'b0001);
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= 4'b0000;
        logic_ptr_pop <= 4'b0000;
      end
      if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= logic_ptr_pop;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 4'b0000;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_rData <= logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
    end
  end


endmodule

module StreamFifo (
  input  wire          io_push_valid,
  output wire          io_push_ready,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_push_payload,
  output wire          io_pop_valid,
  input  wire          io_pop_ready,
  output wire [7:0]    io_pop_payload,
  input  wire          io_flush,
  output wire [7:0]    io_occupancy,
  output wire [7:0]    io_availability,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  reg        [7:0]    logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPush;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPop;
  wire                logic_ptr_full;
  wire                logic_ptr_empty;
  reg        [7:0]    logic_ptr_push;
  reg        [7:0]    logic_ptr_pop;
  wire       [7:0]    logic_ptr_occupancy;
  wire       [7:0]    logic_ptr_popOnIo;
  wire                when_Stream_l1455;
  reg                 logic_ptr_wentUp;
  wire                io_push_fire;
  wire                logic_push_onRam_write_valid;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address;
  wire       [7:0]    logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_ready;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  reg        [6:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  wire                when_Stream_l477;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload;
  wire       [7:0]    logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  wire       [7:0]    logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire;
  reg        [7:0]    logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  reg [7:0] logic_ram [0:127];

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      logic_ram[logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address] <= logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid) begin
      logic_ram_spinal_port1 <= logic_ram[logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload];
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(logic_push_onRam_write_valid) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l1455 = (logic_ptr_doPush != logic_ptr_doPop);
  assign logic_ptr_full = (((logic_ptr_push ^ logic_ptr_popOnIo) ^ 8'h80) == 8'h0);
  assign logic_ptr_empty = (logic_ptr_push == logic_ptr_pop);
  assign logic_ptr_occupancy = (logic_ptr_push - logic_ptr_popOnIo);
  assign io_push_ready = (! logic_ptr_full);
  assign io_push_fire = (io_push_valid && io_push_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPush = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_valid = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address = logic_ptr_push[6:0];
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data = io_push_payload;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_valid = (! logic_ptr_empty);
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_payload = logic_ptr_pop[6:0];
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_fire = (logic_pop_addressGen_valid && logic_pop_addressGen_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPop = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  always @(*) begin
    logic_pop_addressGen_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
    if(when_Stream_l477) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_ready = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l477 = (! logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid);
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp = logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload = logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  assign io_pop_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready = io_pop_ready;
  assign io_pop_payload = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire = (logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid && logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_popOnIo = logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  assign io_occupancy = logic_ptr_occupancy;
  assign io_availability = (8'h80 - logic_ptr_occupancy);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      logic_ptr_push <= 8'h0;
      logic_ptr_pop <= 8'h0;
      logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 8'h0;
    end else begin
      if(when_Stream_l1455) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= logic_ptr_doPush;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= (logic_ptr_push + 8'h01);
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPop) begin
        logic_ptr_pop <= (logic_ptr_pop + 8'h01);
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= 8'h0;
        logic_ptr_pop <= 8'h0;
      end
      if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= logic_ptr_pop;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 8'h0;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_rData <= logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
    end
  end


endmodule

  output wire [31:0]   io_dataOut,
  input  wire          io_sclk
);

  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg        [31:0]   buffers_0;
  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg        [31:0]   buffers_1;

  initial begin
    buffers_0 = 32'h0;
    buffers_1 = 32'h0;
  end

  assign io_dataOut = buffers_1;
  always @(posedge io_sclk) begin
    buffers_0 <= io_dataIn;
    buffers_1 <= buffers_0;
  end


endmodule

module QspiDecoder (
  input  wire [7:0]    io_cmd_opcode,
  input  wire [23:0]   io_cmd_addr,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_cmd_len,
  input  wire          io_cmd_valid,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_payload_byte,
  input  wire          io_payload_valid,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_payload_word,
  input  wire          io_payload_word_valid,
  output wire [7:0]    io_tx_byte,
  output wire          io_tx_load,
  input  wire          io_tx_byte_sent,
  input  wire          io_active,
  output wire [14:0]   io_regBus_addr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_regBus_data,
  output wire          io_regBus_enable,
  output wire [7:0]    io_last_error,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_status_sticky,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_live_mode,
  input  wire [31:0]   io_debug_sdram_data,
  output wire          io_sdramHeaderValid,
  output wire [22:0]   io_sdramAddrInit,
  output wire [16:0]   io_sdramLenBytes,
  output wire [7:0]    io_sdramByteOut,
  output wire          io_sdramByteValid,
  output wire [15:0]   io_sdramWordOut,
  output wire          io_sdramWordValid,
  input  wire          io_upload_busy,
  input  wire          io_upload_done,
  input  wire          io_upload_error,
  input  wire          io_upload_overflow,
  output wire [31:0]   io_rx_word,
  output wire          io_rx_word_valid,
  input  wire          io_clk
);
  localparam RxState_Idle = 2'd0;
  localparam RxState_Load = 2'd1;
  localparam RxState_Wait_1 = 2'd2;

  reg        [7:0]    _zz_rxTxByte;
  reg        [7:0]    dataLo;
  reg                 haveLo;
  reg        [14:0]   writeAddr;
  reg        [15:0]   writeData;
  reg                 writePulse;
  reg        [7:0]    opcodeReg;
  reg        [15:0]   lenReg;
  reg        [15:0]   wordsLeft;
  reg                 activeWrite;
  reg                 activeSdramWrite;
  reg                 sdramHeaderValidReg;
  reg        [22:0]   sdramAddrInitReg;
  reg        [16:0]   sdramLenBytesReg;
  reg        [7:0]    sdramByteOutReg;
  reg                 sdramByteValidReg;
  reg        [15:0]   sdramWordOutReg;
  reg                 sdramWordValidReg;
  reg        [16:0]   sdramBytesLeft;
  reg        [7:0]    last_error;
  wire       [7:0]    _zz_activeSdramWrite;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l146;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l164;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l165;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l181;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l200;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l209;
  reg        [1:0]    rxState_1;
  reg        [1:0]    rxByteIdx;
  reg        [31:0]   rxWord;
  reg                 rxLoad;
  reg        [7:0]    rxTxByte;
  reg                 rxWordValid;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l265;
  wire       [7:0]    switch_QspiDecoder_l267;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l309;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [47:0] rxState_1_string;
  `endif


  initial begin
    dataLo = 8'h0;
    haveLo = 1'b0;
    writeAddr = 15'h0;
    writeData = 16'h0;
    writePulse = 1'b0;
    opcodeReg = 8'h0;
    lenReg = 16'h0;
    wordsLeft = 16'h0;
    activeWrite = 1'b0;
    activeSdramWrite = 1'b0;
    sdramHeaderValidReg = 1'b0;
    sdramAddrInitReg = 23'h0;
    sdramLenBytesReg = 17'h0;
    sdramByteOutReg = 8'h0;
    sdramByteValidReg = 1'b0;
    sdramWordOutReg = 16'h0;
    sdramWordValidReg = 1'b0;
    sdramBytesLeft = 17'h0;
    last_error = 8'h0;
    rxState_1 = RxState_Idle;
    rxByteIdx = 2'b00;
    rxWord = 32'h0;
    rxLoad = 1'b0;
    rxTxByte = 8'h0;
    rxWordValid = 1'b0;
  end

  always @(*) begin
    case(rxByteIdx)
      2'b00 : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[7 : 0];
      2'b01 : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[15 : 8];
      2'b10 : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[23 : 16];
      default : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[31 : 24];
    endcase
  end

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(rxState_1)
      RxState_Idle : rxState_1_string = "Idle  ";
      RxState_Load : rxState_1_string = "Load  ";
      RxState_Wait_1 : rxState_1_string = "Wait_1";
      default : rxState_1_string = "??????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign _zz_activeSdramWrite = 8'h02;
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l146 = (io_cmd_opcode == _zz_activeSdramWrite);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l164 = (16'h0 < wordsLeft);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l165 = (! haveLo);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l181 = (17'h0 < sdramBytesLeft);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l200 = (16'h0 < wordsLeft);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l209 = (17'h00002 <= sdramBytesLeft);
  assign io_regBus_addr = writeAddr;
  assign io_regBus_data = writeData;
  assign io_regBus_enable = writePulse;
  assign io_last_error = last_error;
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l265 = ((io_cmd_valid && (io_cmd_opcode == 8'h04)) && (io_cmd_len == 16'h0));
  assign switch_QspiDecoder_l267 = io_cmd_addr[7 : 0];
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l309 = (rxByteIdx == 2'b11);
  assign io_tx_byte = rxTxByte;
  assign io_tx_load = rxLoad;
  assign io_rx_word = rxWord;
  assign io_rx_word_valid = rxWordValid;
  assign io_sdramHeaderValid = sdramHeaderValidReg;
  assign io_sdramAddrInit = sdramAddrInitReg;
  assign io_sdramLenBytes = sdramLenBytesReg;
  assign io_sdramByteOut = sdramByteOutReg;
  assign io_sdramByteValid = sdramByteValidReg;
  assign io_sdramWordOut = sdramWordOutReg;
  assign io_sdramWordValid = sdramWordValidReg;
  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    writePulse <= 1'b0;
    sdramHeaderValidReg <= 1'b0;
    sdramByteValidReg <= 1'b0;
    sdramWordValidReg <= 1'b0;
    if(io_cmd_valid) begin
      opcodeReg <= io_cmd_opcode;
      lenReg <= io_cmd_len;
      wordsLeft <= io_cmd_len;
      writeAddr <= io_cmd_addr[14 : 0];
      haveLo <= 1'b0;
      activeWrite <= (io_cmd_opcode == 8'h01);
      activeSdramWrite <= (io_cmd_opcode == _zz_activeSdramWrite);
      if(when_QspiDecoder_l146) begin
        sdramAddrInitReg <= io_cmd_addr[22 : 0];
        sdramLenBytesReg <= ({1'd0,io_cmd_len} <<< 1'd1);
        sdramBytesLeft <= ({1'd0,io_cmd_len} <<< 1'd1);
        sdramHeaderValidReg <= 1'b1;
      end
    end
    if(io_payload_valid) begin
      if(activeWrite) begin
        if(when_QspiDecoder_l164) begin
          if(when_QspiDecoder_l165) begin
            dataLo <= io_payload_byte;
            haveLo <= 1'b1;
          end else begin
            writeData <= {io_payload_byte,dataLo};
            writePulse <= 1'b1;
            haveLo <= 1'b0;
            wordsLeft <= (wordsLeft - 16'h0001);
          end
        end
      end else begin
        if(activeSdramWrite) begin
          if(when_QspiDecoder_l181) begin
            sdramByteOutReg <= io_payload_byte;
            sdramByteValidReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramBytesLeft <= (sdramBytesLeft - 17'h00001);
          end
        end else begin
          last_error <= opcodeReg;
        end
      end
    end
    if(io_payload_word_valid) begin
      if(activeWrite) begin
        if(when_QspiDecoder_l200) begin
          writeData <= io_payload_word;
          writePulse <= 1'b1;
          wordsLeft <= (wordsLeft - 16'h0001);
        end
      end else begin
        if(activeSdramWrite) begin
          if(when_QspiDecoder_l209) begin
            sdramWordOutReg <= io_payload_word;
            sdramWordValidReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramBytesLeft <= (sdramBytesLeft - 17'h00002);
          end
        end else begin
          last_error <= opcodeReg;
        end
      end
    end
    if(writePulse) begin
      writeAddr <= (writeAddr + 15'h0001);
    end
    rxLoad <= 1'b0;
    rxWordValid <= 1'b0;
    if(when_QspiDecoder_l265) begin
      case(switch_QspiDecoder_l267)
        8'h0 : begin
          rxWord <= 32'h51560002;
        end
        8'h04 : begin
          rxWord <= {24'h0,last_error};
        end
        8'h05 : begin
          rxWord <= {16'h0,io_status_sticky};
        end
        8'h06 : begin
          rxWord <= {24'h0,{{{{4'b0000,io_upload_overflow},io_upload_error},io_upload_done},io_upload_busy}};
        end
        8'h07 : begin
          rxWord <= {28'h0,io_live_mode};
        end
        8'h08 : begin
          rxWord <= io_debug_sdram_data;
        end
        default : begin
          rxWord <= 32'h0;
        end
      endcase
      rxByteIdx <= 2'b00;
      rxState_1 <= RxState_Load;
      rxWordValid <= 1'b1;
    end
    case(rxState_1)
      RxState_Idle : begin
      end
      RxState_Load : begin
        rxTxByte <= _zz_rxTxByte;
        rxLoad <= 1'b1;
        rxState_1 <= RxState_Wait_1;
      end
      default : begin
        if(io_tx_byte_sent) begin
          if(when_QspiDecoder_l309) begin
            rxState_1 <= RxState_Idle;
          end else begin
            rxByteIdx <= (rxByteIdx + 2'b01);
            rxState_1 <= RxState_Load;
          end
        end
      end
    endcase
  end


endmodule

module QspiSlaveSync (

  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg        [31:0]   area_rdWord;

  wire       [7:0]    _zz_area_rxCrcR;
  wire                when_QspiSlaveSync_l203;
  wire       [7:0]    _zz_area_crcReg_40;
  wire       [7:0]    _zz_area_crcReg_41;

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS

  assign _zz_when_QspiSlaveSync_l203 = ({1'd0,area_lenR} <<< 1'd1);
  assign _zz_io_payloadValid = ({1'd0,area_lenR} <<< 1'd1);
  assign _zz__zz_outArea_ioOutF_2 = (area_rdNib >>> 1'd1);
  assign _zz__zz_outArea_ioOutF_1 = _zz__zz_outArea_ioOutF_2[1:0];

      2'b00 : _zz__zz_outArea_ioOutF = area_rdWord[7 : 0];

      Phase_RDATA : area_phase_string = "RDATA ";
      default : area_phase_string = "??????";

  assign when_QspiSlaveSync_l158 = (area_bitc == 6'h17);
  assign when_QspiSlaveSync_l164 = (area_cmdSh == 8'h04);
  assign _zz_area_crcReg = (8'h0 ^ area_cmdSh);
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_1 = (_zz_area_crcReg[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg[6 : 0],1'b0});
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_2 = (_zz_area_crcReg_1[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_1[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_1[6 : 0],1'b0});
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_3 = (_zz_area_crcReg_2[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_2[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_2[6 : 0],1'b0});
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_4 = (_zz_area_crcReg_3[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_3[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_3[6 : 0],1'b0});
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_5 = (_zz_area_crcReg_4[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_4[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_4[6 : 0],1'b0});
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_6 = (_zz_area_crcReg_5[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_5[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_5[6 : 0],1'b0});
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_7 = (_zz_area_crcReg_6[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_6[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_6[6 : 0],1'b0});
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_8 = ((_zz_area_crcReg_7[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_7[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_7[6 : 0],1'b0}) ^ _zz_area_addrSh[23 : 16]);
  assign _zz_area_crcReg_9 = (_zz_area_crcReg_8[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_8[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_8[6 : 0],1'b0});

  assign _zz_area_crcReg_11 = (_zz_area_crcReg_10[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_10[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_10[6 : 0],1'b0});

  assign _zz_area_crcReg_13 = (_zz_area_crcReg_12[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_12[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_12[6 : 0],1'b0});

  assign _zz_area_crcReg_17 = (_zz_area_crcReg_16[7] ? ({_zz_area_crcReg_16[6 : 0],1'b0} ^ 8'h07) : {_zz_area_crcReg_16[6 : 0],1'b0});

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l93 = (io_byteValid && (! byteFifo_io_push_ready));
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l97 = (io_wrCmd_valid && (! io_wrCmd_ready));
  assign hdrFifo_io_push_payload = {io_addrInit,io_lenBytes};
  always @(*) begin
    hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_1_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      fsm_1_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_1_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_1_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantExit = 1'b0;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_wantStart = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_1_sIdle : begin
      end
      fsm_1_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_1_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_1_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
        fsm_wantStart = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantKill = 1'b0;
  assign io_wrCmd_valid = (((fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_sActive) && byteFifo_io_pop_valid) && io_allowUpload);
  assign io_wrCmd_payload = {addrReg,byteFifo_io_pop_payload};
  assign io_wrCmd_fire = (io_wrCmd_valid && io_wrCmd_ready);
  assign byteFifo_io_pop_ready = (io_wrCmd_fire || (fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_sFlush));
  assign io_uploadBusy = ((! (fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_sIdle)) || hdrFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign io_uploadDone = donePulse;
  assign io_uploadError = uploadError;
  assign io_fifoOverflow = fifoOverflow;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_stateNext = fsm_stateReg;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_1_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_1_sActive;
        end
      end
      fsm_1_sActive : begin
        if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l148) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_1_sDone;
          end
        end else begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l156) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_1_sFlush;
          end
        end
      end
      fsm_1_sFlush : begin
        if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l167) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_1_sIdle;
        end
      end
      fsm_1_sDone : begin
        fsm_stateNext = fsm_1_sIdle;
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
    if(fsm_wantStart) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_1_sIdle;
    end
    if(fsm_wantKill) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_1_BOOT;
    end
  end

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l148 = (bytesLeft == 17'h00001);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l156 = (stallCnt == 16'hffff);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l167 = (! byteFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign fsm_onExit_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_1_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onExit_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_1_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onExit_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_1_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_sActive));
  assign fsm_onExit_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_1_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onExit_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_1_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_1_sDone));
  assign fsm_onEntry_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_1_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_1_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_1_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_1_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_1_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_1_sActive));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_1_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_1_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_1_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_1_sDone));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      addrReg <= 23'h0;
      bytesLeft <= 17'h0;
      fifoOverflow <= 1'b0;
      donePulse <= 1'b0;
      stallCnt <= 16'h0;
      uploadError <= 1'b0;
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_1_BOOT;
    end else begin
      if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l93) begin
        fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l97) begin
        fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
      end
      donePulse <= 1'b0;
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_stateNext;
      case(fsm_stateReg)
        fsm_1_sIdle : begin
          stallCnt <= 16'h0;
          if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
            addrReg <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[39 : 17];
            bytesLeft <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[16 : 0];
          end
        end
        fsm_1_sActive : begin
          if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
            addrReg <= (addrReg + 23'h000001);
            bytesLeft <= (bytesLeft - 17'h00001);
            stallCnt <= 16'h0;
          end else begin
            stallCnt <= (stallCnt + 16'h0001);
            if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l156) begin
              uploadError <= 1'b1;
            end
          end
        end
        fsm_1_sFlush : begin
        end
        fsm_1_sDone : begin
          donePulse <= 1'b1;
        end
        default : begin
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module I80HostInterface (
  input  wire [7:0]    io_dIn,
  output wire [7:0]    io_dOut,
  output wire          io_dOutEn,
  input  wire          io_cs,
  input  wire          io_wr,
  input  wire          io_rd,
  input  wire          io_dc,
  output wire [14:0]   io_regBus_addr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_regBus_data,
  output wire          io_regBus_enable,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_readData,
  output wire [14:0]   io_readAddr,
  output wire          io_readReq,
  output wire          io_blockWr_valid,
  input  wire          io_blockWr_ready,
  output wire [7:0]    io_blockWr_payload,
  output wire [22:0]   io_blockAddr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_blockLen,
  output wire          io_blockHeaderValid,
  output wire          io_blockActive,
  output wire          io_blockOverflow,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);
  localparam fsm_BOOT = 4'd0;
  localparam fsm_sOpcode = 4'd1;
  localparam fsm_sAddrLo = 4'd2;
  localparam fsm_sAddrHi = 4'd3;
  localparam fsm_sDataLo = 4'd4;
  localparam fsm_sDataHi = 4'd5;
  localparam fsm_sBlkA0 = 4'd6;
  localparam fsm_sBlkA1 = 4'd7;
  localparam fsm_sBlkA2 = 4'd8;
  localparam fsm_sBlkL0 = 4'd9;
  localparam fsm_sBlkL1 = 4'd10;
  localparam fsm_sBlkDat = 4'd11;

  wire                io_cs_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                io_wr_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                io_rd_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                io_dc_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [7:0]    io_dIn_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                csS;
  wire                wrS;
  wire                rdS;
  wire                dcS;
  wire       [7:0]    dInS;
  reg                 wrS_regNext;
  wire                wrRise;
  reg                 rdS_regNext;
  wire                rdRise;
  wire                csActive;
  reg        [14:0]   addrReg;
  reg        [15:0]   dataReg;
  reg                 regWrR;
  reg                 readReqR;
  reg                 isRead;
  reg        [22:0]   blkAddr;
  reg        [15:0]   blkLen;
  reg        [15:0]   blkLenFull;
  reg                 blkHeaderR;
  reg                 blkWrValidR;
  reg        [7:0]    blkWrDataR;
  reg                 blkOverflow;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l96;
  wire                fsm_wantExit;
  reg                 fsm_wantStart;
  wire                fsm_wantKill;
  reg                 readHi;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l188;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l189;
  reg        [3:0]    fsm_stateReg;
  reg        [3:0]    fsm_stateNext;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l127;
  wire       [7:0]    switch_I80HostInterface_l128;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l137;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l140;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l147;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l150;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l153;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l154;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l155;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l156;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l158;
  wire       [15:0]   _zz_blkLen;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l163;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l168;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l172;
  wire                fsm_onExit_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sOpcode;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sAddrLo;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sAddrHi;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sDataLo;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sDataHi;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sBlkA0;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sBlkA1;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sBlkA2;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sBlkL0;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sBlkL1;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sBlkDat;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sOpcode;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sAddrLo;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sAddrHi;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sDataLo;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sDataHi;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sBlkA0;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sBlkA1;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sBlkA2;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sBlkL0;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sBlkL1;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sBlkDat;
  wire                when_I80HostInterface_l114;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateReg_string;
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateNext_string;
  `endif


  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC io_cs_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_cs                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_cs_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .clk        (clk                      ), //i
    .reset      (reset                    )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC io_wr_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_wr                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_wr_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .clk        (clk                      ), //i
    .reset      (reset                    )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC io_rd_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_rd                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_rd_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .clk        (clk                      ), //i
    .reset      (reset                    )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 io_dc_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_dc                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_dc_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .clk        (clk                      ), //i
    .reset      (reset                    )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_dIn_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_dIn[7:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_dIn_buffercc_io_dataOut[7:0]), //o
    .clk        (clk                            ), //i
    .reset      (reset                          )  //i
  );
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateReg_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sOpcode : fsm_stateReg_string = "sOpcode";
      fsm_sAddrLo : fsm_stateReg_string = "sAddrLo";
      fsm_sAddrHi : fsm_stateReg_string = "sAddrHi";
      fsm_sDataLo : fsm_stateReg_string = "sDataLo";
      fsm_sDataHi : fsm_stateReg_string = "sDataHi";
      fsm_sBlkA0 : fsm_stateReg_string = "sBlkA0 ";
      fsm_sBlkA1 : fsm_stateReg_string = "sBlkA1 ";
      fsm_sBlkA2 : fsm_stateReg_string = "sBlkA2 ";
      fsm_sBlkL0 : fsm_stateReg_string = "sBlkL0 ";
      fsm_sBlkL1 : fsm_stateReg_string = "sBlkL1 ";
      fsm_sBlkDat : fsm_stateReg_string = "sBlkDat";
      default : fsm_stateReg_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateNext)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateNext_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sOpcode : fsm_stateNext_string = "sOpcode";
      fsm_sAddrLo : fsm_stateNext_string = "sAddrLo";
      fsm_sAddrHi : fsm_stateNext_string = "sAddrHi";
      fsm_sDataLo : fsm_stateNext_string = "sDataLo";
      fsm_sDataHi : fsm_stateNext_string = "sDataHi";
      fsm_sBlkA0 : fsm_stateNext_string = "sBlkA0 ";
      fsm_sBlkA1 : fsm_stateNext_string = "sBlkA1 ";
      fsm_sBlkA2 : fsm_stateNext_string = "sBlkA2 ";
      fsm_sBlkL0 : fsm_stateNext_string = "sBlkL0 ";
      fsm_sBlkL1 : fsm_stateNext_string = "sBlkL1 ";
      fsm_sBlkDat : fsm_stateNext_string = "sBlkDat";
      default : fsm_stateNext_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign csS = io_cs_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign wrS = io_wr_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign rdS = io_rd_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign dcS = io_dc_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign dInS = io_dIn_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign wrRise = (wrS && (! wrS_regNext));
  assign rdRise = (rdS && (! rdS_regNext));
  assign csActive = (! csS);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l96 = (blkWrValidR && (! io_blockWr_ready));
  assign fsm_wantExit = 1'b0;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_wantStart = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sOpcode : begin
      end
      fsm_sAddrLo : begin
      end
      fsm_sAddrHi : begin
      end
      fsm_sDataLo : begin
      end
      fsm_sDataHi : begin
      end
      fsm_sBlkA0 : begin
      end
      fsm_sBlkA1 : begin
      end
      fsm_sBlkA2 : begin
      end
      fsm_sBlkL0 : begin
      end
      fsm_sBlkL1 : begin
      end
      fsm_sBlkDat : begin
      end
      default : begin
        fsm_wantStart = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantKill = 1'b0;
  assign io_regBus_addr = addrReg;
  assign io_regBus_data = dataReg;
  assign io_regBus_enable = regWrR;
  assign io_readAddr = addrReg;
  assign io_readReq = readReqR;
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l188 = (! csActive);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l189 = (rdRise && dcS);
  assign io_dOut = (readHi ? io_readData[15 : 8] : io_readData[7 : 0]);
  assign io_dOutEn = ((csActive && (! rdS)) && dcS);
  assign io_blockWr_valid = blkWrValidR;
  assign io_blockWr_payload = blkWrDataR;
  assign io_blockAddr = blkAddr;
  assign io_blockLen = blkLenFull;
  assign io_blockHeaderValid = blkHeaderR;
  assign io_blockActive = (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sBlkDat);
  assign io_blockOverflow = blkOverflow;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_stateNext = fsm_stateReg;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sOpcode : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l127) begin
          case(switch_I80HostInterface_l128)
            8'h0 : begin
              fsm_stateNext = fsm_sAddrLo;
            end
            8'h01 : begin
              fsm_stateNext = fsm_sAddrLo;
            end
            8'h02 : begin
              fsm_stateNext = fsm_sBlkA0;
            end
            default : begin
            end
          endcase
        end
      end
      fsm_sAddrLo : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l137) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sAddrHi;
        end
      end
      fsm_sAddrHi : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l140) begin
          if(isRead) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sOpcode;
          end else begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sDataLo;
          end
        end
      end
      fsm_sDataLo : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l147) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sDataHi;
        end
      end
      fsm_sDataHi : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l150) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sOpcode;
        end
      end
      fsm_sBlkA0 : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l153) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sBlkA1;
        end
      end
      fsm_sBlkA1 : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l154) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sBlkA2;
        end
      end
      fsm_sBlkA2 : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l155) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sBlkL0;
        end
      end
      fsm_sBlkL0 : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l156) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sBlkL1;
        end
      end
      fsm_sBlkL1 : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l158) begin
          if(when_I80HostInterface_l163) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sOpcode;
          end else begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sBlkDat;
          end
        end
      end
      fsm_sBlkDat : begin
        if(when_I80HostInterface_l168) begin
          if(when_I80HostInterface_l172) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sOpcode;
          end
        end
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
    if(when_I80HostInterface_l114) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_sOpcode;
    end
    if(fsm_wantStart) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_sOpcode;
    end
    if(fsm_wantKill) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_BOOT;
    end
  end

  assign when_I80HostInterface_l127 = ((csActive && wrRise) && (! dcS));
  assign switch_I80HostInterface_l128 = dInS[7 : 0];
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l137 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l140 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l147 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l150 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l153 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l154 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l155 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l156 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l158 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign _zz_blkLen = {dInS[7 : 0],blkLen[7 : 0]};
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l163 = (_zz_blkLen == 16'h0);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l168 = (csActive && wrRise);
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l172 = (blkLen == 16'h0001);
  assign fsm_onExit_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onExit_sOpcode = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sOpcode) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sOpcode));
  assign fsm_onExit_sAddrLo = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sAddrLo) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sAddrLo));
  assign fsm_onExit_sAddrHi = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sAddrHi) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sAddrHi));
  assign fsm_onExit_sDataLo = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sDataLo) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sDataLo));
  assign fsm_onExit_sDataHi = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sDataHi) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sDataHi));
  assign fsm_onExit_sBlkA0 = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sBlkA0) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sBlkA0));
  assign fsm_onExit_sBlkA1 = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sBlkA1) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sBlkA1));
  assign fsm_onExit_sBlkA2 = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sBlkA2) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sBlkA2));
  assign fsm_onExit_sBlkL0 = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sBlkL0) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sBlkL0));
  assign fsm_onExit_sBlkL1 = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sBlkL1) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sBlkL1));
  assign fsm_onExit_sBlkDat = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sBlkDat) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sBlkDat));
  assign fsm_onEntry_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sOpcode = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sOpcode) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sOpcode));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sAddrLo = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sAddrLo) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sAddrLo));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sAddrHi = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sAddrHi) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sAddrHi));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sDataLo = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sDataLo) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sDataLo));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sDataHi = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sDataHi) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sDataHi));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sBlkA0 = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sBlkA0) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sBlkA0));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sBlkA1 = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sBlkA1) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sBlkA1));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sBlkA2 = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sBlkA2) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sBlkA2));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sBlkL0 = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sBlkL0) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sBlkL0));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sBlkL1 = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sBlkL1) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sBlkL1));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sBlkDat = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sBlkDat) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sBlkDat));
  assign when_I80HostInterface_l114 = (! csActive);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      wrS_regNext <= 1'b1;
      rdS_regNext <= 1'b1;
      addrReg <= 15'h0;
      dataReg <= 16'h0;
      regWrR <= 1'b0;
      readReqR <= 1'b0;
      isRead <= 1'b0;
      blkAddr <= 23'h0;
      blkLen <= 16'h0;
      blkLenFull <= 16'h0;
      blkHeaderR <= 1'b0;
      blkWrValidR <= 1'b0;
      blkWrDataR <= 8'h0;
