  input  wire          io_sdramDataReady,
  input  wire [31:0]   io_sdramDout32,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_slotIdx,
  output wire [31:0]   io_slotWord_0,
  output wire [31:0]   io_slotWord_1,
  output wire [31:0]   io_slotWord_2,
  output wire [31:0]   io_slotWord_3,
  output wire [31:0]   io_slotWord_4,
  output wire          io_rowReady,
  output wire          io_busy,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset,
  input  wire          sdram_clk,
  input  wire          sdram_reset
);
  localparam State_Idle = 2'd0;
  localparam State_Issue = 2'd1;
  localparam State_WaitData = 2'd2;
  localparam State_Done = 2'd3;

  wire                rowFifo_io_pop_ready;
  wire       [31:0]   planeMems_0_spinal_port0;
  wire       [31:0]   planeMems_1_spinal_port0;
  wire       [31:0]   planeMems_2_spinal_port0;
  wire       [31:0]   planeMems_3_spinal_port0;
  wire       [31:0]   planeMems_4_spinal_port0;
  wire                rowFifo_io_push_ready;
  wire                rowFifo_io_pop_valid;
  wire       [38:0]   rowFifo_io_pop_payload;
  wire       [7:0]    rowFifo_io_pushOccupancy;
  wire       [7:0]    rowFifo_io_popOccupancy;
  wire                startToggle_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_0_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_1_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_2_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_3_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_4_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                sdramArea_busyLevel_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  reg        [22:0]   _zz_sdramArea_addrReg;
  wire       [22:0]   _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_1;
  wire       [22:0]   _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_2;
  wire                _zz_planeMems_0_port;
  wire                _zz_planeMems_1_port;
  wire                _zz_planeMems_2_port;
  wire                _zz_planeMems_3_port;
  wire                _zz_planeMems_4_port;
  reg                 startToggle;
  wire                sdramArea_startToggleSync;
  reg                 sdramArea_startTogglePrev;
  wire                sdramArea_startEdge;
  wire       [22:0]   sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_0;
  wire       [22:0]   sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_1;
  wire       [22:0]   sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_2;
  wire       [22:0]   sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_3;
  wire       [22:0]   sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_4;
  reg        [2:0]    sdramArea_planeIdx;
  reg        [3:0]    sdramArea_readIdx;
  reg        [1:0]    sdramArea_state;
  reg                 sdramArea_rdReg;
  reg        [22:0]   sdramArea_addrReg;
  reg                 sdramArea_rowDoneToggle;
  reg        [38:0]   sdramArea_pushPayload;
  reg                 sdramArea_pushValid;
  wire                when_BitplaneRowFetch_l158;
  wire                when_BitplaneRowFetch_l171;
  wire                when_BitplaneRowFetch_l173;
  wire                sdramArea_busyLevel;
  wire       [2:0]    popPlaneIdx;
  wire       [3:0]    popReadIdx;
  wire       [31:0]   popDout32;
  wire                popFire;
  reg        [5:0]    popCounter;
  reg                 rowReadyR;
  wire                when_BitplaneRowFetch_l243;
  wire                busySdramSync;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [63:0] sdramArea_state_string;
  `endif

  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_0 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_1 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_2 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_3 [0:9];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] planeMems_4 [0:9];

  assign _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_1 = (_zz_sdramArea_addrReg_2 <<< 2);
  assign _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_2 = {19'd0, sdramArea_readIdx};
  assign _zz_planeMems_0_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b000));
  assign _zz_planeMems_1_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b001));
  assign _zz_planeMems_2_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b010));
  assign _zz_planeMems_3_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b011));
  assign _zz_planeMems_4_port = (popFire && (popPlaneIdx == 3'b100));
  assign planeMems_0_spinal_port0 = planeMems_0[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_0_port) begin
      planeMems_0[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_1_spinal_port0 = planeMems_1[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_1_port) begin
      planeMems_1[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_2_spinal_port0 = planeMems_2[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_2_port) begin
      planeMems_2[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_3_spinal_port0 = planeMems_3[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_3_port) begin
      planeMems_3[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  assign planeMems_4_spinal_port0 = planeMems_4[io_slotIdx];
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_planeMems_4_port) begin
      planeMems_4[popReadIdx] <= popDout32;
    end
  end

  StreamFifoCC rowFifo (
    .io_push_valid    (sdramArea_pushValid          ), //i
    .io_push_ready    (rowFifo_io_push_ready        ), //o
    .io_push_payload  (sdramArea_pushPayload[38:0]  ), //i
    .io_pop_valid     (rowFifo_io_pop_valid         ), //o
    .io_pop_ready     (rowFifo_io_pop_ready         ), //i
    .io_pop_payload   (rowFifo_io_pop_payload[38:0] ), //o
    .io_pushOccupancy (rowFifo_io_pushOccupancy[7:0]), //o
    .io_popOccupancy  (rowFifo_io_popOccupancy[7:0] ), //o
    .sdram_clk        (sdram_clk                    ), //i
    .sdram_reset      (sdram_reset                  ), //i
    .clk              (clk                          )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 startToggle_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (startToggle                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (startToggle_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                      ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset                    )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_0_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (io_planeBaseAddr_0[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (io_planeBaseAddr_0_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                                   ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset                                 )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_1_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (io_planeBaseAddr_1[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (io_planeBaseAddr_1_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                                   ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset                                 )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_2_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (io_planeBaseAddr_2[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (io_planeBaseAddr_2_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                                   ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset                                 )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_3_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (io_planeBaseAddr_3[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (io_planeBaseAddr_3_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                                   ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset                                 )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_4 io_planeBaseAddr_4_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (io_planeBaseAddr_4[22:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (io_planeBaseAddr_4_buffercc_io_dataOut[22:0]), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                                   ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset                                 )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_9 sdramArea_busyLevel_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (sdramArea_busyLevel                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (sdramArea_busyLevel_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .clk        (clk                                    ), //i
    .reset      (reset                                  )  //i
  );
  always @(*) begin
    case(sdramArea_planeIdx)
      3'b000 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_0;
      3'b001 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_1;
      3'b010 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_2;
      3'b011 : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_3;
      default : _zz_sdramArea_addrReg = sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_4;
    endcase
  end

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(sdramArea_state)
      State_Idle : sdramArea_state_string = "Idle    ";
      State_Issue : sdramArea_state_string = "Issue   ";
      State_WaitData : sdramArea_state_string = "WaitData";
      State_Done : sdramArea_state_string = "Done    ";
      default : sdramArea_state_string = "????????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign io_slotWord_0 = planeMems_0_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_1 = planeMems_1_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_2 = planeMems_2_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_3 = planeMems_3_spinal_port0;
  assign io_slotWord_4 = planeMems_4_spinal_port0;
  assign sdramArea_startToggleSync = startToggle_buffercc_io_dataOut;

  assign sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_3 = io_planeBaseAddr_3_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign sdramArea_planeBaseAddrSync_4 = io_planeBaseAddr_4_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l158 = (! io_sdramBusy);
  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l171 = (sdramArea_readIdx == 4'b1001);
  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l173 = (sdramArea_planeIdx == 3'b100);
  assign sdramArea_busyLevel = (sdramArea_state != State_Idle);
  assign io_sdramRd = sdramArea_rdReg;
  assign io_sdramAddr = sdramArea_addrReg;
  assign popPlaneIdx = rowFifo_io_pop_payload[38 : 36];
  assign popReadIdx = rowFifo_io_pop_payload[35 : 32];
  assign popDout32 = rowFifo_io_pop_payload[31 : 0];
  assign rowFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b1;
  assign popFire = (rowFifo_io_pop_valid && rowFifo_io_pop_ready);
  assign when_BitplaneRowFetch_l243 = (popCounter == 6'h31);
  assign io_rowReady = rowReadyR;
  assign busySdramSync = sdramArea_busyLevel_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign io_busy = ((busySdramSync || rowFifo_io_pop_valid) || (popCounter != 6'h0));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      startToggle <= 1'b0;
      popCounter <= 6'h0;
      rowReadyR <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(io_start) begin
        startToggle <= (! startToggle);
      end
      `ifndef SYNTHESIS
        `ifdef FORMAL
          assert(((! popFire) || (popPlaneIdx < 3'b101))); // BitplaneRowFetch.scala:L221
        `else
          if(!((! popFire) || (popPlaneIdx < 3'b101)) && $realtime != 0) begin
            $display("ERROR P3 Risk #2: popPlaneIdx >= planeCount (non-pow2 planeCount silent-drop)"); // BitplaneRowFetch.scala:L221
          end
        `endif
      `endif
      rowReadyR <= 1'b0;
      if(io_start) begin
        popCounter <= 6'h0;
      end
      if(popFire) begin
        if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l243) begin
          popCounter <= 6'h0;
          rowReadyR <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
          popCounter <= (popCounter + 6'h01);
        end
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge sdram_reset) begin
    if(sdram_reset) begin
      sdramArea_startTogglePrev <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
      sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
      sdramArea_state <= State_Idle;
      sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_addrReg <= 23'h0;
      sdramArea_rowDoneToggle <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_pushPayload <= 39'h0;
      sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      sdramArea_startTogglePrev <= sdramArea_startToggleSync;
      sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
      case(sdramArea_state)
        State_Idle : begin
          if(sdramArea_startEdge) begin
            sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
            sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
            sdramArea_state <= State_Issue;
          end
        end
        State_Issue : begin
          if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l158) begin
            sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramArea_addrReg <= (_zz_sdramArea_addrReg + _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_1);
            sdramArea_state <= State_WaitData;
          end
        end
        State_WaitData : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_pushPayload <= {{sdramArea_planeIdx,sdramArea_readIdx},io_sdramDout32};
            sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b1;
            if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l171) begin
              sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
              if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l173) begin
                sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
                sdramArea_state <= State_Done;
              end else begin
                sdramArea_planeIdx <= (sdramArea_planeIdx + 3'b001);
                sdramArea_state <= State_Issue;
              end
            end else begin
              sdramArea_readIdx <= (sdramArea_readIdx + 4'b0001);
              sdramArea_state <= State_Issue;
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
          sdramArea_rowDoneToggle <= (! sdramArea_rowDoneToggle);
          sdramArea_state <= State_Idle;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

  (* async_reg = "true" *) reg                 buffers_1;

      buffers_0 <= 1'b0;
      buffers_1 <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      buffers_0 <= io_dataIn;
      buffers_1 <= buffers_0;
    end
  end

module QspiDecoder (
  input  wire [7:0]    io_cmd_opcode,
  input  wire [23:0]   io_cmd_addr,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_cmd_len,
  input  wire          io_cmd_valid,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_payload_byte,
  input  wire          io_payload_valid,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_payload_word,
  input  wire          io_payload_word_valid,
  output wire [7:0]    io_tx_byte,
  output wire          io_tx_load,
  input  wire          io_tx_byte_sent,
  input  wire          io_active,
  output wire [14:0]   io_regBus_addr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_regBus_data,
  output wire          io_regBus_enable,
  output wire [7:0]    io_last_error,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_status_sticky,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_live_mode,
  input  wire [31:0]   io_debug_sdram_data,
  output wire          io_sdramHeaderValid,
  output wire [22:0]   io_sdramAddrInit,
  output wire [16:0]   io_sdramLenBytes,
  output wire [7:0]    io_sdramByteOut,
  output wire          io_sdramByteValid,
  output wire [15:0]   io_sdramWordOut,
  output wire          io_sdramWordValid,
  input  wire          io_upload_busy,
  input  wire          io_upload_done,
  input  wire          io_upload_error,
  input  wire          io_upload_overflow,
  output wire [31:0]   io_rx_word,
  output wire          io_rx_word_valid,
  input  wire          io_clk
);
  localparam RxState_Idle = 2'd0;
  localparam RxState_Load = 2'd1;
  localparam RxState_Wait_1 = 2'd2;

  reg        [7:0]    _zz_rxTxByte;
  reg        [7:0]    dataLo;
  reg                 haveLo;
  reg        [14:0]   writeAddr;
  reg        [15:0]   writeData;
  reg                 writePulse;
  reg        [7:0]    opcodeReg;
  reg        [15:0]   lenReg;
  reg        [15:0]   wordsLeft;
  reg                 activeWrite;
  reg                 activeSdramWrite;
  reg                 sdramHeaderValidReg;
  reg        [22:0]   sdramAddrInitReg;
  reg        [16:0]   sdramLenBytesReg;
  reg        [7:0]    sdramByteOutReg;
  reg                 sdramByteValidReg;
  reg        [15:0]   sdramWordOutReg;
  reg                 sdramWordValidReg;
  reg        [16:0]   sdramBytesLeft;
  reg        [7:0]    last_error;
  wire       [7:0]    _zz_activeSdramWrite;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l146;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l164;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l165;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l181;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l200;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l209;
  reg        [1:0]    rxState_1;
  reg        [1:0]    rxByteIdx;
  reg        [31:0]   rxWord;
  reg                 rxLoad;
  reg        [7:0]    rxTxByte;
  reg                 rxWordValid;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l265;
  wire       [7:0]    switch_QspiDecoder_l267;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l309;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [47:0] rxState_1_string;
  `endif


  initial begin
    dataLo = 8'h0;
    haveLo = 1'b0;
    writeAddr = 15'h0;
    writeData = 16'h0;
    writePulse = 1'b0;
    opcodeReg = 8'h0;
    lenReg = 16'h0;
    wordsLeft = 16'h0;
    activeWrite = 1'b0;
    activeSdramWrite = 1'b0;
    sdramHeaderValidReg = 1'b0;
    sdramAddrInitReg = 23'h0;
    sdramLenBytesReg = 17'h0;
    sdramByteOutReg = 8'h0;
    sdramByteValidReg = 1'b0;
    sdramWordOutReg = 16'h0;
    sdramWordValidReg = 1'b0;
    sdramBytesLeft = 17'h0;
    last_error = 8'h0;
    rxState_1 = RxState_Idle;
    rxByteIdx = 2'b00;
    rxWord = 32'h0;
    rxLoad = 1'b0;
    rxTxByte = 8'h0;
    rxWordValid = 1'b0;
  end

  always @(*) begin
    case(rxByteIdx)
      2'b00 : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[7 : 0];
      2'b01 : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[15 : 8];
      2'b10 : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[23 : 16];
      default : _zz_rxTxByte = rxWord[31 : 24];
    endcase
  end

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(rxState_1)
      RxState_Idle : rxState_1_string = "Idle  ";
      RxState_Load : rxState_1_string = "Load  ";
      RxState_Wait_1 : rxState_1_string = "Wait_1";
      default : rxState_1_string = "??????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign _zz_activeSdramWrite = 8'h02;
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l146 = (io_cmd_opcode == _zz_activeSdramWrite);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l164 = (16'h0 < wordsLeft);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l165 = (! haveLo);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l181 = (17'h0 < sdramBytesLeft);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l200 = (16'h0 < wordsLeft);
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l209 = (17'h00002 <= sdramBytesLeft);
  assign io_regBus_addr = writeAddr;
  assign io_regBus_data = writeData;
  assign io_regBus_enable = writePulse;
  assign io_last_error = last_error;
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l265 = ((io_cmd_valid && (io_cmd_opcode == 8'h04)) && (io_cmd_len == 16'h0));
  assign switch_QspiDecoder_l267 = io_cmd_addr[7 : 0];
  assign when_QspiDecoder_l309 = (rxByteIdx == 2'b11);
  assign io_tx_byte = rxTxByte;
  assign io_tx_load = rxLoad;
  assign io_rx_word = rxWord;
  assign io_rx_word_valid = rxWordValid;
  assign io_sdramHeaderValid = sdramHeaderValidReg;
  assign io_sdramAddrInit = sdramAddrInitReg;
  assign io_sdramLenBytes = sdramLenBytesReg;
  assign io_sdramByteOut = sdramByteOutReg;
  assign io_sdramByteValid = sdramByteValidReg;
  assign io_sdramWordOut = sdramWordOutReg;
  assign io_sdramWordValid = sdramWordValidReg;
  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    writePulse <= 1'b0;
    sdramHeaderValidReg <= 1'b0;
    sdramByteValidReg <= 1'b0;
    sdramWordValidReg <= 1'b0;
    if(io_cmd_valid) begin
      opcodeReg <= io_cmd_opcode;
      lenReg <= io_cmd_len;
      wordsLeft <= io_cmd_len;
      writeAddr <= io_cmd_addr[14 : 0];
      haveLo <= 1'b0;
      activeWrite <= (io_cmd_opcode == 8'h01);
      activeSdramWrite <= (io_cmd_opcode == _zz_activeSdramWrite);
      if(when_QspiDecoder_l146) begin
        sdramAddrInitReg <= io_cmd_addr[22 : 0];
        sdramLenBytesReg <= ({1'd0,io_cmd_len} <<< 1'd1);
        sdramBytesLeft <= ({1'd0,io_cmd_len} <<< 1'd1);
        sdramHeaderValidReg <= 1'b1;
      end
    end
    if(io_payload_valid) begin
      if(activeWrite) begin
        if(when_QspiDecoder_l164) begin
          if(when_QspiDecoder_l165) begin
            dataLo <= io_payload_byte;
            haveLo <= 1'b1;
          end else begin
            writeData <= {io_payload_byte,dataLo};
            writePulse <= 1'b1;
            haveLo <= 1'b0;
            wordsLeft <= (wordsLeft - 16'h0001);
          end
        end
      end else begin
        if(activeSdramWrite) begin
          if(when_QspiDecoder_l181) begin
            sdramByteOutReg <= io_payload_byte;
            sdramByteValidReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramBytesLeft <= (sdramBytesLeft - 17'h00001);
          end
        end else begin
          last_error <= opcodeReg;
        end
      end
    end
    if(io_payload_word_valid) begin
      if(activeWrite) begin
        if(when_QspiDecoder_l200) begin
          writeData <= io_payload_word;
          writePulse <= 1'b1;
          wordsLeft <= (wordsLeft - 16'h0001);
        end
      end else begin

            sdramBytesLeft <= (sdramBytesLeft - 17'h00002);
          end
        end else begin

        end
      end
    end
    if(writePulse) begin
      writeAddr <= (writeAddr + 15'h0001);
    end

    rxWordValid <= 1'b0;

        end

        end

        end
        8'h07 : begin
          rxWord <= {28'h0,io_live_mode};
        end
        8'h08 : begin
          rxWord <= io_debug_sdram_data;
        end
        default : begin
          rxWord <= 32'h0;
        end
      endcase
      rxByteIdx <= 2'b00;
      rxState_1 <= RxState_Load;
      rxWordValid <= 1'b1;
    end
    case(rxState_1)
      RxState_Idle : begin
      end
      RxState_Load : begin

        rxLoad <= 1'b1;
        rxState_1 <= RxState_Wait_1;
      end
      default : begin
        if(io_tx_byte_sent) begin

          end else begin
            rxByteIdx <= (rxByteIdx + 2'b01);
            rxState_1 <= RxState_Load;
          end
        end
      end
    endcase
  end


endmodule

    if(reset) begin
      writeBuf <= 1'b0;

      subOffsetReg <= 4'b0000;

        unpackPrio <= wordFifo_io_pop_payload[67];

module ScrollWrap (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_coord,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_scroll,
  output wire [9:0]    io_result
);

  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_1;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_2;
  wire       [10:0]   sum;
  wire       [10:0]   wrapped;

  assign _zz_wrapped = (sum - 11'h780);
  assign _zz_wrapped_1 = (sum - 11'h500);
  assign _zz_wrapped_2 = (sum - 11'h280);
  assign sum = ({1'b0,io_coord} + {1'b0,io_scroll});
  assign wrapped = ((11'h780 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped : ((11'h500 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_1 : ((11'h280 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_2 : sum)));
  assign io_result = wrapped[9:0];

endmodule

        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowRq1 : begin
          if(when_SdramTileFetch_l516) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_cmdRefresh <= 1'b1;
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0101;
            end else begin
              sdramArea_cmdRd <= 1'b1;
              sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h005000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_23);
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowWait1 : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_pushPayload <= io_sdramDout32;
            sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b1;
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sPushWord1 : begin
          if(io_push_fire) begin
            if(!when_SdramTileFetch_l542) begin
              sdramArea_tileIdx <= (sdramArea_tileIdx + 6'h01);
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sRefresh : begin
        end
        default : begin
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

  reg        [16:0]   bytesLeft;
  reg                 fifoOverflow;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l97;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l101;
  reg                 donePulse;
  reg        [15:0]   stallCnt;
  reg                 uploadError;
  wire                fsm_wantExit;
  reg                 fsm_wantStart;
  wire                fsm_wantKill;
  wire                io_wrCmd_fire;
  reg                 _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed;
  reg                 _zz_io_dbgBytePushed;
  reg        [2:0]    fsm_stateReg;
  reg        [2:0]    fsm_stateNext;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l152;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l160;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l171;
  wire                fsm_onExit_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sIdle;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sActive;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sFlush;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sDone;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sIdle;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sActive;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sFlush;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sDone;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateReg_string;
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateNext_string;
  `endif


  StreamFifo byteFifo (
    .io_push_valid   (io_byteValid                 ), //i
    .io_push_ready   (byteFifo_io_push_ready       ), //o
    .io_push_payload (io_byteIn[7:0]               ), //i
    .io_pop_valid    (byteFifo_io_pop_valid        ), //o
    .io_pop_ready    (byteFifo_io_pop_ready        ), //i
    .io_pop_payload  (byteFifo_io_pop_payload[7:0] ), //o
    .io_flush        (1'b0                         ), //i
    .io_occupancy    (byteFifo_io_occupancy[7:0]   ), //o
    .io_availability (byteFifo_io_availability[7:0]), //o
    .io_clk          (io_clk                       )  //i
  );
  StreamFifo_1 hdrFifo (
    .io_push_valid   (io_headerValid               ), //i
    .io_push_ready   (hdrFifo_io_push_ready        ), //o
    .io_push_payload (hdrFifo_io_push_payload[39:0]), //i
    .io_pop_valid    (hdrFifo_io_pop_valid         ), //o
    .io_pop_ready    (hdrFifo_io_pop_ready         ), //i
    .io_pop_payload  (hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[39:0] ), //o
    .io_flush        (1'b0                         ), //i
    .io_occupancy    (hdrFifo_io_occupancy[3:0]    ), //o
    .io_availability (hdrFifo_io_availability[3:0] ), //o
    .io_clk          (io_clk                       )  //i
  );
  initial begin
    addrReg = 23'h0;
    bytesLeft = 17'h0;
    fifoOverflow = 1'b0;
    donePulse = 1'b0;
    stallCnt = 16'h0;
    uploadError = 1'b0;
    _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed = 1'b0;
    _zz_io_dbgBytePushed = 1'b0;
    fsm_stateReg = fsm_BOOT;
  end

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateReg_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sIdle : fsm_stateReg_string = "sIdle  ";
      fsm_sActive : fsm_stateReg_string = "sActive";
      fsm_sFlush : fsm_stateReg_string = "sFlush ";
      fsm_sDone : fsm_stateReg_string = "sDone  ";
      default : fsm_stateReg_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateNext)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateNext_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sIdle : fsm_stateNext_string = "sIdle  ";
      fsm_sActive : fsm_stateNext_string = "sActive";
      fsm_sFlush : fsm_stateNext_string = "sFlush ";
      fsm_sDone : fsm_stateNext_string = "sDone  ";
      default : fsm_stateNext_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l97 = (io_byteValid && (! byteFifo_io_push_ready));
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l101 = (io_wrCmd_valid && (! io_wrCmd_ready));
  assign hdrFifo_io_push_payload = {io_addrInit,io_lenBytes};
  always @(*) begin
    hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantExit = 1'b0;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_wantStart = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
        fsm_wantStart = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantKill = 1'b0;
  assign io_wrCmd_valid = (((fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive) && byteFifo_io_pop_valid) && io_allowUpload);
  assign io_wrCmd_payload = {addrReg,byteFifo_io_pop_payload};
  assign io_wrCmd_fire = (io_wrCmd_valid && io_wrCmd_ready);
  assign byteFifo_io_pop_ready = (io_wrCmd_fire || (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sFlush));
  assign io_uploadBusy = ((! (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle)) || hdrFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign io_uploadDone = donePulse;
  assign io_uploadError = uploadError;
  assign io_fifoOverflow = fifoOverflow;
  assign io_dbgHdrPushed = _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed;
  assign io_dbgBytePushed = _zz_io_dbgBytePushed;
  assign io_dbgFsmState = {(fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle),{(fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive),(fsm_stateReg == fsm_sDone)}};
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_stateNext = fsm_stateReg;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sActive;
        end
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
        if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l152) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sDone;
          end
        end else begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l160) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sFlush;
          end
        end
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
        if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l171) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
        end
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
        fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
    if(fsm_wantStart) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
    end
    if(fsm_wantKill) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_BOOT;
    end
  end

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l152 = (bytesLeft == 17'h00001);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l160 = (stallCnt == 16'hffff);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l171 = (! byteFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign fsm_onExit_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onExit_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onExit_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive));
  assign fsm_onExit_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onExit_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sDone));
  assign fsm_onEntry_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sActive));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sDone));
  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l97) begin
      fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
    end
    if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l101) begin
      fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
    end
    donePulse <= 1'b0;
    _zz_io_dbgHdrPushed <= (io_headerValid && hdrFifo_io_push_ready);
    _zz_io_dbgBytePushed <= (io_byteValid && byteFifo_io_push_ready);
    fsm_stateReg <= fsm_stateNext;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
        stallCnt <= 16'h0;
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          addrReg <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[39 : 17];
          bytesLeft <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[16 : 0];
        end
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
        if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
          addrReg <= (addrReg + 23'h000001);
          bytesLeft <= (bytesLeft - 17'h00001);
          stallCnt <= 16'h0;
        end else begin
          stallCnt <= (stallCnt + 16'h0001);
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l160) begin
            uploadError <= 1'b1;
          end
        end
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
        donePulse <= 1'b1;
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end


endmodule

module QspiTransportCore (
  input  wire          io_clk,
  input  wire          io_sclk,
  input  wire          io_csn,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_ioIn,
  output wire [3:0]    io_ioOut,
  output wire          io_ioOe,
  output wire [14:0]   io_regBus_addr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_regBus_data,
  output wire          io_regBus_enable,
  output wire [7:0]    io_sdramByteOut,
  output wire          io_sdramByteValid,
  output wire [15:0]   io_sdramWordOut,
  output wire          io_sdramWordValid,
  output wire          io_sdramHeaderValid,
  output wire [22:0]   io_sdramAddrInit,
  output wire [16:0]   io_sdramLenBytes,
  output wire          io_overflow,
  output wire          io_malformed,
  output wire          io_hdrErr,
  input  wire [31:0]   io_debug_sdram_data,
  input  wire          io_clk_1
);

  wire                sys_dec_io_cmd_valid;
  wire       [7:0]    sys_dec_io_payload_byte;
  wire                fifo_io_push_valid;
  wire                fifo_io_pop_ready;
  wire       [3:0]    slave_io_ioOut;
  wire                slave_io_ioOe;
  wire       [7:0]    slave_io_cmdOpcode;
  wire       [23:0]   slave_io_cmdAddr;
  wire       [15:0]   slave_io_cmdLen;
  wire                slave_io_cmdValid;
  wire       [7:0]    slave_io_payloadByte;
  wire                slave_io_payloadValid;
  wire                slave_io_active;
  wire                slave_io_hdrErr;
  wire                slave_io_crcBad;
  wire       [7:0]    sys_dec_io_tx_byte;
  wire                sys_dec_io_tx_load;
  wire       [14:0]   sys_dec_io_regBus_addr;
  wire       [15:0]   sys_dec_io_regBus_data;
  wire                sys_dec_io_regBus_enable;
  wire       [7:0]    sys_dec_io_last_error;
  wire                sys_dec_io_sdramHeaderValid;
  wire       [22:0]   sys_dec_io_sdramAddrInit;
  wire       [16:0]   sys_dec_io_sdramLenBytes;
  wire       [7:0]    sys_dec_io_sdramByteOut;
  wire                sys_dec_io_sdramByteValid;
  wire       [15:0]   sys_dec_io_sdramWordOut;
  wire                sys_dec_io_sdramWordValid;
  wire       [31:0]   sys_dec_io_rx_word;
  wire                sys_dec_io_rx_word_valid;
  wire                slave_io_crcBad_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [15:0]   sys_lastRegData_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [15:0]   sys_lastRegAddr_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [31:0]   io_debug_sdram_data_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                crcCap_errSticky_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire       [15:0]   crcCap_errCount_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                fifo_io_push_ready;
  wire                fifo_io_pop_valid;
  wire                fifo_io_pop_payload_isHeader;
  wire       [7:0]    fifo_io_pop_payload_opcode;
  wire       [23:0]   fifo_io_pop_payload_addr;
  wire       [15:0]   fifo_io_pop_payload_len;
  wire       [15:0]   fifo_io_pop_payload_word;
  wire       [9:0]    fifo_io_pushOccupancy;
  wire       [9:0]    fifo_io_popOccupancy;
  wire                push_overflow_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  wire                push_malformed_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  reg        [15:0]   sys_lastRegAddr;
  reg        [15:0]   sys_lastRegData;
  wire                crcCap_badSync;
  reg                 crcCap_badPrev;
  reg                 crcCap_errSticky;
  reg        [15:0]   crcCap_errCount;
  wire                when_QspiTransportCore_l106;
  wire       [15:0]   loop_lastDataCC;
  wire       [15:0]   loop_lastAddrCC;
  wire       [31:0]   loop_dbgSdramCC;
  reg                 loop_hdrErrSticky;
  reg        [15:0]   loop_hdrErrCount;
  wire                loop_crcErrSticky;
  wire       [15:0]   loop_crcErrCount;
  reg        [7:0]    push_loByte;
  reg                 push_haveLo;
  reg                 push_malformed;
  wire                push_wordComplete;
  wire       [15:0]   push_assembled;
  wire                push_tok_isHeader;
  wire       [7:0]    push_tok_opcode;
  wire       [23:0]   push_tok_addr;
  wire       [15:0]   push_tok_len;
  wire       [15:0]   push_tok_word;
  reg                 push_overflow;
  wire                when_QspiTransportCore_l171;
  wire       [7:0]    sel;
  reg        [31:0]   rxWordSel;
  reg                 pop_hiPhase;
  wire                pop_isPayload;
  wire                pop_overflowCC;
  wire                pop_malformedCC;

  QspiSlaveSync slave (
    .io_sclk         (io_sclk                  ), //i
    .io_csn          (io_csn                   ), //i
    .io_ioIn         (io_ioIn[3:0]             ), //i
    .io_ioOut        (slave_io_ioOut[3:0]      ), //o
    .io_ioOe         (slave_io_ioOe            ), //o
    .io_cmdOpcode    (slave_io_cmdOpcode[7:0]  ), //o
    .io_cmdAddr      (slave_io_cmdAddr[23:0]   ), //o
    .io_cmdLen       (slave_io_cmdLen[15:0]    ), //o
    .io_cmdValid     (slave_io_cmdValid        ), //o
    .io_payloadByte  (slave_io_payloadByte[7:0]), //o
    .io_payloadValid (slave_io_payloadValid    ), //o
    .io_rxWord       (rxWordSel[31:0]          ), //i
    .io_active       (slave_io_active          ), //o
    .io_hdrErr       (slave_io_hdrErr          ), //o
    .io_crcBad       (slave_io_crcBad          )  //o
  );
  QspiDecoder sys_dec (
    .io_cmd_opcode         (fifo_io_pop_payload_opcode[7:0]), //i
    .io_cmd_addr           (fifo_io_pop_payload_addr[23:0] ), //i
    .io_cmd_len            (fifo_io_pop_payload_len[15:0]  ), //i
    .io_cmd_valid          (sys_dec_io_cmd_valid           ), //i
    .io_payload_byte       (sys_dec_io_payload_byte[7:0]   ), //i
    .io_payload_valid      (pop_isPayload                  ), //i
    .io_payload_word       (16'h0                          ), //i
    .io_payload_word_valid (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_tx_byte            (sys_dec_io_tx_byte[7:0]        ), //o
    .io_tx_load            (sys_dec_io_tx_load             ), //o
    .io_tx_byte_sent       (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_active             (                               ), //i
    .io_regBus_addr        (sys_dec_io_regBus_addr[14:0]   ), //o
    .io_regBus_data        (sys_dec_io_regBus_data[15:0]   ), //o
    .io_regBus_enable      (sys_dec_io_regBus_enable       ), //o
    .io_last_error         (sys_dec_io_last_error[7:0]     ), //o
    .io_status_sticky      (16'h0                          ), //i
    .io_live_mode          (4'b0000                        ), //i
    .io_debug_sdram_data   (32'h0                          ), //i
    .io_sdramHeaderValid   (sys_dec_io_sdramHeaderValid    ), //o
    .io_sdramAddrInit      (sys_dec_io_sdramAddrInit[22:0] ), //o
    .io_sdramLenBytes      (sys_dec_io_sdramLenBytes[16:0] ), //o
    .io_sdramByteOut       (sys_dec_io_sdramByteOut[7:0]   ), //o
    .io_sdramByteValid     (sys_dec_io_sdramByteValid      ), //o
    .io_sdramWordOut       (sys_dec_io_sdramWordOut[15:0]  ), //o
    .io_sdramWordValid     (sys_dec_io_sdramWordValid      ), //o
    .io_upload_busy        (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_upload_done        (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_upload_error       (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_upload_overflow    (1'b0                           ), //i
    .io_rx_word            (sys_dec_io_rx_word[31:0]       ), //o
    .io_rx_word_valid      (sys_dec_io_rx_word_valid       ), //o
    .io_clk                (io_clk_1                       )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_2 slave_io_crcBad_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (slave_io_crcBad                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (slave_io_crcBad_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_clk     (io_clk_1                           )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 sys_lastRegData_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (sys_lastRegData[15:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (sys_lastRegData_buffercc_io_dataOut[15:0]), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                                  )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 sys_lastRegAddr_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (sys_lastRegAddr[15:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (sys_lastRegAddr_buffercc_io_dataOut[15:0]), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                                  )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_5 io_debug_sdram_data_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (io_debug_sdram_data[31:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (io_debug_sdram_data_buffercc_io_dataOut[31:0]), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                                      )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_6 crcCap_errSticky_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (crcCap_errSticky                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (crcCap_errSticky_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                             )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_3 crcCap_errCount_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (crcCap_errCount[15:0]                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (crcCap_errCount_buffercc_io_dataOut[15:0]), //o
    .io_sclk    (io_sclk                                  )  //i
  );
  StreamFifoCC fifo (
    .io_push_valid            (fifo_io_push_valid             ), //i
    .io_push_ready            (fifo_io_push_ready             ), //o
    .io_push_payload_isHeader (push_tok_isHeader              ), //i
    .io_push_payload_opcode   (push_tok_opcode[7:0]           ), //i
    .io_push_payload_addr     (push_tok_addr[23:0]            ), //i
    .io_push_payload_len      (push_tok_len[15:0]             ), //i
    .io_push_payload_word     (push_tok_word[15:0]            ), //i
    .io_pop_valid             (fifo_io_pop_valid              ), //o
    .io_pop_ready             (fifo_io_pop_ready              ), //i
    .io_pop_payload_isHeader  (fifo_io_pop_payload_isHeader   ), //o
    .io_pop_payload_opcode    (fifo_io_pop_payload_opcode[7:0]), //o
    .io_pop_payload_addr      (fifo_io_pop_payload_addr[23:0] ), //o
    .io_pop_payload_len       (fifo_io_pop_payload_len[15:0]  ), //o
    .io_pop_payload_word      (fifo_io_pop_payload_word[15:0] ), //o
    .io_pushOccupancy         (fifo_io_pushOccupancy[9:0]     ), //o
    .io_popOccupancy          (fifo_io_popOccupancy[9:0]      ), //o
    .io_sclk                  (io_sclk                        ), //i
    .io_clk                   (io_clk_1                       )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_2 push_overflow_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (push_overflow                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (push_overflow_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_clk     (io_clk_1                         )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_2 push_malformed_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn  (push_malformed                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut (push_malformed_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .io_clk     (io_clk_1                          )  //i
  );
  initial begin
    sys_lastRegAddr = 16'h0;
    sys_lastRegData = 16'h0;
    crcCap_badPrev = 1'b0;
    crcCap_errSticky = 1'b0;
    crcCap_errCount = 16'h0;
    loop_hdrErrSticky = 1'b0;
    loop_hdrErrCount = 16'h0;
    push_loByte = 8'h0;
    push_haveLo = 1'b0;
    push_malformed = 1'b0;
    push_overflow = 1'b0;
    pop_hiPhase = 1'b0;
  end

  assign io_ioOut = slave_io_ioOut;
  assign io_ioOe = slave_io_ioOe;
  assign crcCap_badSync = slave_io_crcBad_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign when_QspiTransportCore_l106 = (crcCap_badSync && (! crcCap_badPrev));
  assign loop_lastDataCC = sys_lastRegData_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_lastAddrCC = sys_lastRegAddr_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_dbgSdramCC = io_debug_sdram_data_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_crcErrSticky = crcCap_errSticky_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign loop_crcErrCount = crcCap_errCount_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign push_wordComplete = (slave_io_payloadValid && push_haveLo);
  assign push_assembled = {slave_io_payloadByte,push_loByte};
  assign push_tok_isHeader = slave_io_cmdValid;
  assign push_tok_opcode = slave_io_cmdOpcode;
  assign push_tok_addr = slave_io_cmdAddr;
  assign push_tok_len = slave_io_cmdLen;
  assign push_tok_word = push_assembled;
  assign fifo_io_push_valid = (slave_io_cmdValid || push_wordComplete);
  assign when_QspiTransportCore_l171 = (fifo_io_push_valid && (! fifo_io_push_ready));
  assign sel = slave_io_cmdAddr[7 : 0];
  always @(*) begin
    rxWordSel = 32'h0;
    case(sel)
      8'h0 : begin
        rxWordSel = 32'h51560002;
      end
      8'h07 : begin
        rxWordSel = {{15'h0,loop_hdrErrSticky},loop_hdrErrCount};
      end
      8'h08 : begin
        rxWordSel = loop_dbgSdramCC;
      end
      8'h09 : begin
        rxWordSel = {loop_lastDataCC,loop_lastAddrCC};
      end
      8'h0a : begin
        rxWordSel = {{30'h0,push_malformed},push_overflow};
      end
      8'h0b : begin
        rxWordSel = {{15'h0,loop_crcErrSticky},loop_crcErrCount};
      end
      default : begin
        rxWordSel = 32'h0;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign pop_isPayload = (fifo_io_pop_valid && (! fifo_io_pop_payload_isHeader));
  assign fifo_io_pop_ready = (pop_isPayload ? pop_hiPhase : fifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign sys_dec_io_cmd_valid = (fifo_io_pop_valid && fifo_io_pop_payload_isHeader);
  assign sys_dec_io_payload_byte = (pop_hiPhase ? fifo_io_pop_payload_word[15 : 8] : fifo_io_pop_payload_word[7 : 0]);
  assign pop_overflowCC = push_overflow_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign pop_malformedCC = push_malformed_buffercc_io_dataOut;
  assign io_regBus_addr = sys_dec_io_regBus_addr;
  assign io_regBus_data = sys_dec_io_regBus_data;
  assign io_regBus_enable = sys_dec_io_regBus_enable;
  assign io_sdramByteOut = sys_dec_io_sdramByteOut;
  assign io_sdramByteValid = sys_dec_io_sdramByteValid;
  assign io_sdramWordOut = sys_dec_io_sdramWordOut;
  assign io_sdramWordValid = sys_dec_io_sdramWordValid;
  assign io_sdramHeaderValid = sys_dec_io_sdramHeaderValid;
  assign io_sdramAddrInit = sys_dec_io_sdramAddrInit;
  assign io_sdramLenBytes = sys_dec_io_sdramLenBytes;
  assign io_overflow = pop_overflowCC;
  assign io_malformed = pop_malformedCC;
  assign io_hdrErr = loop_hdrErrSticky;
  always @(posedge io_clk_1) begin
    if(sys_dec_io_regBus_enable) begin
      sys_lastRegAddr <= {1'd0, sys_dec_io_regBus_addr};
      sys_lastRegData <= sys_dec_io_regBus_data;
    end
    crcCap_badPrev <= crcCap_badSync;
    if(when_QspiTransportCore_l106) begin
      crcCap_errSticky <= 1'b1;
      crcCap_errCount <= (crcCap_errCount + 16'h0001);
    end
    if(pop_isPayload) begin
      pop_hiPhase <= (! pop_hiPhase);
    end
  end

  always @(posedge io_sclk) begin
    if(slave_io_hdrErr) begin
      loop_hdrErrSticky <= 1'b1;
      loop_hdrErrCount <= (loop_hdrErrCount + 16'h0001);
    end
    if(slave_io_cmdValid) begin
      if(push_haveLo) begin
        push_malformed <= 1'b1;
      end
      push_haveLo <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(slave_io_payloadValid) begin
        if(push_haveLo) begin
          push_haveLo <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
          push_loByte <= slave_io_payloadByte;
          push_haveLo <= 1'b1;
        end
      end
    end
    if(when_QspiTransportCore_l171) begin
      push_overflow <= 1'b1;
    end
  end


endmodule

module StreamFifo_1 (
  input  wire          io_push_valid,
  output wire          io_push_ready,
  input  wire [39:0]   io_push_payload,
  output wire          io_pop_valid,
  input  wire          io_pop_ready,
  output wire [39:0]   io_pop_payload,
  input  wire          io_flush,
  output wire [3:0]    io_occupancy,
  output wire [3:0]    io_availability,
  input  wire          io_clk
);

  reg        [39:0]   logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPush;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPop;
  wire                logic_ptr_full;
  wire                logic_ptr_empty;
  reg        [3:0]    logic_ptr_push;
  reg        [3:0]    logic_ptr_pop;
  wire       [3:0]    logic_ptr_occupancy;
  wire       [3:0]    logic_ptr_popOnIo;
  wire                when_Stream_l1455;
  reg                 logic_ptr_wentUp;
  wire                io_push_fire;
  wire                logic_push_onRam_write_valid;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address;
  wire       [39:0]   logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_ready;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  reg        [2:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  wire                when_Stream_l477;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload;
  wire       [39:0]   logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  wire       [2:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  wire       [39:0]   logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire;
  reg        [3:0]    logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  reg [39:0] logic_ram [0:7];

  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      logic_ram[logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address] <= logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid) begin
      logic_ram_spinal_port1 <= logic_ram[logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload];
    end
  end

  initial begin
    logic_ptr_push = 4'b0000;
    logic_ptr_pop = 4'b0000;
    logic_ptr_wentUp = 1'b0;
    logic_pop_addressGen_rValid = 1'b0;
    logic_pop_sync_popReg = 4'b0000;
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(logic_push_onRam_write_valid) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l1455 = (logic_ptr_doPush != logic_ptr_doPop);
  assign logic_ptr_full = (((logic_ptr_push ^ logic_ptr_popOnIo) ^ 4'b1000) == 4'b0000);
  assign logic_ptr_empty = (logic_ptr_push == logic_ptr_pop);
  assign logic_ptr_occupancy = (logic_ptr_push - logic_ptr_popOnIo);
  assign io_push_ready = (! logic_ptr_full);
  assign io_push_fire = (io_push_valid && io_push_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPush = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_valid = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address = logic_ptr_push[2:0];
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data = io_push_payload;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_valid = (! logic_ptr_empty);
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_payload = logic_ptr_pop[2:0];
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_fire = (logic_pop_addressGen_valid && logic_pop_addressGen_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPop = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  always @(*) begin
    logic_pop_addressGen_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
    if(when_Stream_l477) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_ready = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l477 = (! logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid);
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp = logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload = logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  assign io_pop_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready = io_pop_ready;
  assign io_pop_payload = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire = (logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid && logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_popOnIo = logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  assign io_occupancy = logic_ptr_occupancy;
  assign io_availability = (4'b1000 - logic_ptr_occupancy);
  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    if(when_Stream_l1455) begin
      logic_ptr_wentUp <= logic_ptr_doPush;
    end
    if(io_flush) begin
      logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
    end
    if(logic_ptr_doPush) begin
      logic_ptr_push <= (logic_ptr_push + 4'b0001);
    end
    if(logic_ptr_doPop) begin
      logic_ptr_pop <= (logic_ptr_pop + 4'b0001);
    end
    if(io_flush) begin
      logic_ptr_push <= 4'b0000;
      logic_ptr_pop <= 4'b0000;
    end
    if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
    end
    if(io_flush) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
    end
    if(logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire) begin
      logic_pop_sync_popReg <= logic_ptr_pop;
    end
    if(io_flush) begin
      logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 4'b0000;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge io_clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_rData <= logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
    end
  end


endmodule

module QspiDecoder (

  wire       [7:0]    switch_QspiDecoder_l267;
  wire                when_QspiDecoder_l309;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [47:0] rxState_1_string;
  `endif


  initial begin
    dataLo = 8'h0;
    haveLo = 1'b0;
    writeAddr = 15'h0;
    writeData = 16'h0;
    writePulse = 1'b0;
    opcodeReg = 8'h0;
    lenReg = 16'h0;
    wordsLeft = 16'h0;

      RxState_Load : rxState_1_string = "Load  ";

    sdramHeaderValidReg <= 1'b0;
    sdramByteValidReg <= 1'b0;
    sdramWordValidReg <= 1'b0;
    if(io_cmd_valid) begin
      opcodeReg <= io_cmd_opcode;
      lenReg <= io_cmd_len;
      wordsLeft <= io_cmd_len;
      writeAddr <= io_cmd_addr[14 : 0];

            sdramByteValidReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramBytesLeft <= (sdramBytesLeft - 17'h00001);
          end
        end else begin
          last_error <= opcodeReg;
        end
      end
    end
    if(io_payload_word_valid) begin
      if(activeWrite) begin
        if(when_QspiDecoder_l200) begin
          writeData <= io_payload_word;
          writePulse <= 1'b1;
          wordsLeft <= (wordsLeft - 16'h0001);
        end
      end else begin
        if(activeSdramWrite) begin
          if(when_QspiDecoder_l209) begin
            sdramWordOutReg <= io_payload_word;
            sdramWordValidReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramBytesLeft <= (sdramBytesLeft - 17'h00002);
          end
        end else begin

        end
      end
    end
    if(writePulse) begin
      writeAddr <= (writeAddr + 15'h0001);
    end
    rxLoad <= 1'b0;
    rxWordValid <= 1'b0;
    if(when_QspiDecoder_l265) begin
      case(switch_QspiDecoder_l267)
        8'h0 : begin
          rxWord <= 32'h51560002;

        end

        end

        end

  wire       [22:0]   sdramArea_upAddr;
  wire       [7:0]    sdramArea_upDin;

  QspiSdramBridge bridge (
    .io_headerValid   (io_headerValid               ), //i
    .io_addrInit      (io_addrInit[22:0]            ), //i
    .io_lenBytes      (io_lenBytes[16:0]            ), //i

    .io_uploadBusy    (bridge_io_uploadBusy         ), //o

    .io_fifoOverflow  (bridge_io_fifoOverflow       ), //o

  );
  StreamFifoCC_1 uploadCc (
    .io_push_valid    (bridge_io_wrCmd_valid         ), //i
    .io_push_ready    (uploadCc_io_push_ready        ), //o
    .io_push_payload  (bridge_io_wrCmd_payload[30:0] ), //i

    .clk              (clk                           ), //i
    .reset            (reset                         ), //i
    .sdram_clk        (sdram_clk                     )  //i
  );
  SdramTileAttributeFetch fetch (
    .io_sdramAddr        (fetch_io_sdramAddr[22:0]      ), //o
    .io_sdramDin         (fetch_io_sdramDin[7:0]        ), //o
    .io_sdramRd          (fetch_io_sdramRd              ), //o
    .io_sdramWr          (fetch_io_sdramWr              ), //o

    .io_sdramRdNext      (fetch_io_sdramRdNext          ), //o
    .io_sdramWrNext      (fetch_io_sdramWrNext          ), //o
    .io_sdramRefreshNext (fetch_io_sdramRefreshNext     ), //o
    .io_sdramDout        (io_ctrlDout[7:0]              ), //i
    .io_sdramDout32      (io_ctrlDout32[31:0]           ), //i
    .io_sdramDataReady   (io_ctrlDataReady              ), //i
    .io_sdramBusy        (io_ctrlBusy                   ), //i
    .io_fetchGrant       (io_fetchGrant                 ), //i
    .io_fetchSlotValid   (1'b1                          ), //i
    .io_fetchPreAnnounce (1'b0                          ), //i
    .io_fetchLine        (io_fetchLine[9:0]             ), //i
    .io_fetchScrollX     (10'h0                         ), //i
    .io_fetchScrollY     (10'h0                         ), //i
    .io_pixelAddr        (10'h0                         ), //i
    .io_pixelIndex       (fetch_io_pixelIndex[3:0]      ), //o
    .io_pixelPaletteBank (fetch_io_pixelPaletteBank[2:0]), //o
    .io_pixelPriority    (fetch_io_pixelPriority        ), //o
    .io_tileDecodeMode   (2'b00                         ), //i
    .io_attributeMode    (1'b0                          ), //i
    .io_bootDone         (fetch_io_bootDone             ), //o
    .io_memtestPass      (fetch_io_memtestPass          ), //o
    .io_memtestFail      (fetch_io_memtestFail          ), //o
    .io_underrun         (fetch_io_underrun             ), //o
    .io_debugWriteBuf    (fetch_io_debugWriteBuf        ), //o
    .io_debugAttrTL      (fetch_io_debugAttrTL[2:0]     ), //o
    .io_debugAttrBR      (fetch_io_debugAttrBR[2:0]     ), //o
    .clk                 (clk                           ), //i
    .reset               (reset                         ), //i
    .sdram_clk           (sdram_clk                     ), //i
    .sdram_reset         (sdram_reset                   )  //i
  );
  SdramArbiter sdramArea_arbiter (
    .io_grantClientId     (3'b000                                 ), //i
    .io_slotValid         (1'b1                                   ), //i
    .io_grant             (io_fetchGrant_buffercc_io_dataOut      ), //i
    .io_clientRd_0        (fetch_io_sdramRd                       ), //i
    .io_clientRd_1        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientRd_2        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientRd_3        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientRd_4        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientWr_0        (fetch_io_sdramWr                       ), //i
    .io_clientWr_1        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientWr_2        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientWr_3        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientWr_4        (1'b0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientAddr_0      (fetch_io_sdramAddr[22:0]               ), //i
    .io_clientAddr_1      (23'h0                                  ), //i
    .io_clientAddr_2      (23'h0                                  ), //i
    .io_clientAddr_3      (23'h0                                  ), //i
    .io_clientAddr_4      (23'h0                                  ), //i
    .io_clientDin_0       (fetch_io_sdramDin[7:0]                 ), //i
    .io_clientDin_1       (8'h0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientDin_2       (8'h0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientDin_3       (8'h0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientDin_4       (8'h0                                   ), //i
    .io_clientBurstLen_0  (4'b0001                                ), //i
    .io_clientBurstLen_1  (4'b0001                                ), //i
    .io_clientBurstLen_2  (4'b0001                                ), //i
    .io_clientBurstLen_3  (4'b0001                                ), //i
    .io_clientBurstLen_4  (4'b0001                                ), //i
    .io_clientGrant_0     (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientGrant_0     ), //o
    .io_clientGrant_1     (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientGrant_1     ), //o
    .io_clientGrant_2     (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientGrant_2     ), //o
    .io_clientGrant_3     (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientGrant_3     ), //o
    .io_clientGrant_4     (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientGrant_4     ), //o
    .io_clientSlotValid_0 (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientSlotValid_0 ), //o
    .io_clientSlotValid_1 (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientSlotValid_1 ), //o
    .io_clientSlotValid_2 (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientSlotValid_2 ), //o
    .io_clientSlotValid_3 (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientSlotValid_3 ), //o
    .io_clientSlotValid_4 (sdramArea_arbiter_io_clientSlotValid_4 ), //o

    .io_sdramWr           (sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramWr           ), //o

    .io_sdramDin          (sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramDin[7:0]     ), //o
    .io_sdramBurstLen     (sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramBurstLen[3:0]), //o
    .io_refreshDue        (sdramArea_arbiter_io_refreshDue        ), //o
    .io_vblankActive      (                                       ), //i
    .sdram_clk            (sdram_clk                              ), //i
    .sdram_reset          (sdram_reset                            )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_11 io_fetchGrant_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (io_fetchGrant                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (io_fetchGrant_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                        ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset                      )  //i
  );
  (* keep_hierarchy = "TRUE" *) BufferCC_11 io_de_buffercc (
    .io_dataIn   (io_de                    ), //i
    .io_dataOut  (io_de_buffercc_io_dataOut), //o
    .sdram_clk   (sdram_clk                ), //i
    .sdram_reset (sdram_reset              )  //i

  assign sdramArea_canAccept = (((((! io_ctrlBusy) && (! sdramArea_deSync)) && (! sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramRd)) && (! sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramWr)) && (! fetch_io_sdramRefresh));
  assign sdramArea_fire = (uploadCc_io_pop_valid && sdramArea_canAccept);
  assign sdramArea_upAddr = uploadCc_io_pop_payload[30 : 8];
  assign sdramArea_upDin = uploadCc_io_pop_payload[7 : 0];
  assign io_ctrlRd = sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramRd;
  assign io_ctrlWr = (sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramWr || sdramArea_fire);
  assign io_ctrlAddr = (sdramArea_fire ? sdramArea_upAddr : sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramAddr);
  assign io_ctrlDin = (sdramArea_fire ? sdramArea_upDin : sdramArea_arbiter_io_sdramDin);
  assign io_ctrlRefresh = fetch_io_sdramRefresh;
  assign io_uploadFire = sdramArea_fire;

module SdramArbiter (
  input  wire [2:0]    io_grantClientId,
  input  wire          io_slotValid,
  input  wire          io_grant,
  input  wire          io_clientRd_0,
  input  wire          io_clientRd_1,
  input  wire          io_clientRd_2,
  input  wire          io_clientRd_3,
  input  wire          io_clientRd_4,
  input  wire          io_clientWr_0,
  input  wire          io_clientWr_1,
  input  wire          io_clientWr_2,
  input  wire          io_clientWr_3,
  input  wire          io_clientWr_4,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_clientAddr_0,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_clientAddr_1,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_clientAddr_2,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_clientAddr_3,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_clientAddr_4,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_clientDin_0,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_clientDin_1,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_clientDin_2,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_clientDin_3,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_clientDin_4,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_clientBurstLen_0,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_clientBurstLen_1,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_clientBurstLen_2,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_clientBurstLen_3,
  input  wire [3:0]    io_clientBurstLen_4,
  output wire          io_clientGrant_0,
  output wire          io_clientGrant_1,
  output wire          io_clientGrant_2,
  output wire          io_clientGrant_3,
  output wire          io_clientGrant_4,
  output wire          io_clientSlotValid_0,
  output wire          io_clientSlotValid_1,
  output wire          io_clientSlotValid_2,
  output wire          io_clientSlotValid_3,
  output wire          io_clientSlotValid_4,
  output wire          io_sdramRd,
  output wire          io_sdramWr,
  output wire [22:0]   io_sdramAddr,
  output wire [7:0]    io_sdramDin,
  output wire [3:0]    io_sdramBurstLen,
  output wire          io_refreshDue,
  input  wire          io_vblankActive,
  input  wire          sdram_clk,
  input  wire          sdram_reset
);

  reg                 _zz_io_sdramRd;
  reg                 _zz_io_sdramWr;
  reg        [22:0]   _zz_io_sdramAddr;
  reg        [7:0]    _zz_io_sdramDin;
  reg        [3:0]    _zz_io_sdramBurstLen;
  reg        [9:0]    _zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86;
  reg                 _zz_io_refreshDue;
  wire                when_SdramArbiter_l86;
  wire                _zz_io_clientGrant_0;
  wire                _zz_io_clientGrant_1;
  wire                _zz_io_clientGrant_2;
  wire                _zz_io_clientGrant_3;
  wire                _zz_io_clientGrant_4;

  always @(*) begin
    case(io_grantClientId)
      3'b000 : begin
        _zz_io_sdramRd = io_clientRd_0;
        _zz_io_sdramWr = io_clientWr_0;
        _zz_io_sdramAddr = io_clientAddr_0;
        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_0;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_0;
      end
      3'b001 : begin
        _zz_io_sdramRd = io_clientRd_1;
        _zz_io_sdramWr = io_clientWr_1;
        _zz_io_sdramAddr = io_clientAddr_1;
        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_1;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_1;
      end
      3'b010 : begin
        _zz_io_sdramRd = io_clientRd_2;
        _zz_io_sdramWr = io_clientWr_2;
        _zz_io_sdramAddr = io_clientAddr_2;
        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_2;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_2;
      end
      3'b011 : begin
        _zz_io_sdramRd = io_clientRd_3;
        _zz_io_sdramWr = io_clientWr_3;
        _zz_io_sdramAddr = io_clientAddr_3;
        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_3;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_3;
      end
      default : begin
        _zz_io_sdramRd = io_clientRd_4;
        _zz_io_sdramWr = io_clientWr_4;
        _zz_io_sdramAddr = io_clientAddr_4;
        _zz_io_sdramDin = io_clientDin_4;
        _zz_io_sdramBurstLen = io_clientBurstLen_4;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_SdramArbiter_l86 = (_zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 == 10'h250);
  assign io_refreshDue = _zz_io_refreshDue;
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_0 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b000);
  assign io_clientGrant_0 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_0);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_0 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_0);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_1 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b001);
  assign io_clientGrant_1 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_1);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_1 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_1);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_2 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b010);
  assign io_clientGrant_2 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_2);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_2 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_2);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_3 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b011);
  assign io_clientGrant_3 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_3);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_3 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_3);
  assign _zz_io_clientGrant_4 = (io_grantClientId == 3'b100);
  assign io_clientGrant_4 = (io_grant && _zz_io_clientGrant_4);
  assign io_clientSlotValid_4 = (io_slotValid && _zz_io_clientGrant_4);
  assign io_sdramRd = _zz_io_sdramRd;
  assign io_sdramWr = _zz_io_sdramWr;
  assign io_sdramAddr = _zz_io_sdramAddr;
  assign io_sdramDin = _zz_io_sdramDin;
  assign io_sdramBurstLen = _zz_io_sdramBurstLen;
  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge sdram_reset) begin
    if(sdram_reset) begin
      _zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 <= 10'h0;
      _zz_io_refreshDue <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      _zz_io_refreshDue <= 1'b0;
      if(when_SdramArbiter_l86) begin
        _zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 <= 10'h0;
        _zz_io_refreshDue <= 1'b1;
      end else begin
        _zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 <= (_zz_when_SdramArbiter_l86 + 10'h001);
      end
    end
  end


endmodule
