  assign sdramArea_fsm_onEntry_sFetchRowWait1 = ((sdramArea_fsm_stateNext == sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowWait1) && (sdramArea_fsm_stateReg != sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowWait1));
  assign sdramArea_fsm_onEntry_sPushTile = ((sdramArea_fsm_stateNext == sdramArea_fsm_sPushTile) && (sdramArea_fsm_stateReg != sdramArea_fsm_sPushTile));
  assign sdramArea_fsm_onEntry_sRefresh = ((sdramArea_fsm_stateNext == sdramArea_fsm_sRefresh) && (sdramArea_fsm_stateReg != sdramArea_fsm_sRefresh));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      writeBuf <= 1'b0;
      tileCountReg <= 6'h0;
      subOffsetReg <= 4'b0000;
      unpackIdx <= 4'b0000;
      unpackRow <= 64'h0;
      unpackBank <= 3'b000;
      unpackPrio <= 1'b0;
      emitting <= 1'b0;
      underrunR <= 1'b0;
      fetchStartPixD <= 1'b0;
      pendingFlip <= 1'b0;
      writeBufPrev <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      fetchStartPixD <= io_fetchGrant;
      if(io_fetchGrant) begin
        tileCountReg <= 6'h0;
        subOffsetReg <= io_fetchScrollX[3 : 0];
        unpackIdx <= 4'b0000;
        emitting <= 1'b0;
        underrunR <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(fetchStartRise) begin
        pendingFlip <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(doFlip) begin
        writeBuf <= (! writeBuf);
        pendingFlip <= 1'b0;
      end
      writeBufPrev <= writeBuf;
      `ifndef SYNTHESIS
        `ifdef FORMAL
          assert(((! emitting) || (writeBuf == writeBufPrev))); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L255
        `else
          if(!((! emitting) || (writeBuf == writeBufPrev)) && $realtime != 0) begin
            $display("ERROR P3 Risk #3 (post-fix): writeBuf changed while emitting=True (drain-complete gate broken)"); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L255
          end
        `endif
      `endif
      if(wordFifo_io_pop_fire) begin
        unpackRow <= wordFifo_io_pop_payload[63 : 0];
        unpackBank <= wordFifo_io_pop_payload[66 : 64];
        unpackPrio <= wordFifo_io_pop_payload[67];
        unpackIdx <= 4'b0000;
        emitting <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(emitting) begin
        if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l296) begin
          emitting <= 1'b0;
          tileCountReg <= (tileCountReg + 6'h01);
        end
        unpackIdx <= (unpackIdx + 4'b0001);
      end
      if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l303) begin
        underrunR <= 1'b1;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge sdram_reset) begin
    if(sdram_reset) begin
      sdramArea_refreshTimer <= 10'h0;
      sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_fetchGrantD <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_curLine <= 10'h0;
      sdramArea_curScrollX <= 10'h0;
      sdramArea_curScrollY <= 10'h0;
      sdramArea_cmdRd <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_cmdWr <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_cmdRefresh <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_cmdAddr <= 23'h0;
      sdramArea_cmdDin <= 8'h0;
      sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_pushPayload <= 68'h0;
      sdramArea_bootDoneR <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_memtestPassR <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_bootCounter <= 12'h0;
      sdramArea_tileIdx <= 6'h0;
      sdramArea_tileIndexReg <= 2'b00;
      sdramArea_attrByteReg <= 8'h0;
      sdramArea_bankReg <= 3'b000;
      sdramArea_priorityReg <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_rowWord0Reg <= 32'h0;
      sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0000;
      sdramArea_fsm_bootDoneRPrev <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_fsm_memtestPassRPrev <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_fsm_stateReg <= sdramArea_fsm_BOOT;
    end else begin
      if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l320) begin
        sdramArea_refreshTimer <= 10'h0;
        sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b1;
      end else begin
        sdramArea_refreshTimer <= (sdramArea_refreshTimer + 10'h001);
      end
      sdramArea_fetchGrantD <= sdramArea_fetchGrantSync;
      if(wordFifo_io_push_fire) begin
        sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
      end
      sdramArea_fsm_bootDoneRPrev <= sdramArea_bootDoneR;
      `ifndef SYNTHESIS
        `ifdef FORMAL
          assert(((! sdramArea_fsm_bootDoneRPrev) || sdramArea_bootDoneR)); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L706
        `else
          if(!((! sdramArea_fsm_bootDoneRPrev) || sdramArea_bootDoneR) && $realtime != 0) begin
            $display("ERROR P3 Risk #5: bootDoneR cleared after being set"); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L706
          end
        `endif
      `endif
      sdramArea_fsm_memtestPassRPrev <= sdramArea_memtestPassR;
      `ifndef SYNTHESIS
        `ifdef FORMAL
          assert(((! sdramArea_fetchGrantEdge) || (sdramArea_memtestPassR == sdramArea_fsm_memtestPassRPrev))); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L718
        `else
          if(!((! sdramArea_fetchGrantEdge) || (sdramArea_memtestPassR == sdramArea_fsm_memtestPassRPrev)) && $realtime != 0) begin
            $display("ERROR P3 Risk #6: fetchGrantEdge fired in same cycle memtestPassR changed"); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L718
          end
        `endif
      `endif
      sdramArea_fsm_stateReg <= sdramArea_fsm_stateNext;
      case(sdramArea_fsm_stateReg)
        sdramArea_fsm_sPowerWait : begin
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sBootTileMap : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l553) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0000;
            end else begin
              if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l555) begin
                sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h006000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_7);
                sdramArea_cmdDin <= sdramArea_tileMapRom_spinal_port0;
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= (sdramArea_bootCounter + 12'h001);
              end else begin
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= 12'h0;
              end
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sBootAttrMap : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l570) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b1000;
            end else begin
              if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l572) begin
                sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h007000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_8);
                sdramArea_cmdDin <= sdramArea_attrMapRom_spinal_port0;
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= (sdramArea_bootCounter + 12'h001);
              end else begin
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= 12'h0;
              end
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sBootTileRows : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l584) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0001;
            end else begin
              if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l586) begin
                sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h008000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_9);
                sdramArea_cmdDin <= sdramArea_tileRowRom_spinal_port0;
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= (sdramArea_bootCounter + 12'h001);
              end else begin
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= 12'h0;
              end
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sBootPlanar : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l615) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b1010;
            end else begin
              if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l617) begin
                sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h00a000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_10);
                sdramArea_cmdDin <= sdramArea_planarRowRom_spinal_port0;
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= (sdramArea_bootCounter + 12'h001);
              end else begin
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= 12'h0;
              end
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sBootPlane1 : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l633) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b1011;
            end else begin
              if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l635) begin
                sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h00b000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_11);
                sdramArea_cmdDin <= sdramArea_plane1RowRom_spinal_port0;
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= (sdramArea_bootCounter + 12'h001);
              end else begin
                sdramArea_bootCounter <= 12'h0;
                sdramArea_bootDoneR <= 1'b1;
                sdramArea_memtestPassR <= 1'b1;
              end
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sMemtestWrite : begin
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sMemtestReadRq : begin
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sMemtestCheck : begin
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sIdle : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l725) begin
            sdramArea_curLine <= sdramArea_fetchLineSync;
            sdramArea_curScrollX <= sdramArea_fetchScrollXSync;
            sdramArea_curScrollY <= sdramArea_fetchScrollYSync;
            sdramArea_tileIdx <= 6'h0;
          end else begin
            if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l731) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0010;
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchMapRq : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l739) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0011;
            end else begin
              sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h006000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_12);
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchMapWait : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_tileIndexReg <= _zz_sdramArea_tileIndexReg;
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchAttrRq : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l764) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b1001;
            end else begin
              sdramArea_cmdAddr <= (23'h007000 + _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_21);
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchAttrWait : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_attrByteReg <= io_sdramDout;
            if(sdramArea_attributeModeSync) begin
              sdramArea_bankReg <= {1'd0, _zz_sdramArea_bankReg};
              sdramArea_priorityReg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
              sdramArea_bankReg <= io_sdramDout[2 : 0];
              sdramArea_priorityReg <= io_sdramDout[3];
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowRq0 : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l810) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0100;
            end else begin
              `ifndef SYNTHESIS
                `ifdef FORMAL
                  assert(((! (sdramArea_shuffledSync || (sdramArea_tileRowBaseSelSync == 23'h00a000))) || (_zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_3 < 23'h000200))); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L491
                `else
                  if(!((! (sdramArea_shuffledSync || (sdramArea_tileRowBaseSelSync == 23'h00a000))) || (_zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_3 < 23'h000200)) && $realtime != 0) begin
                    $display("ERROR P3 Risk #1: planar tileRowByteAddr effOffset exceeds TotalBytes"); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L491
                  end
                `endif
              `endif
              sdramArea_cmdAddr <= ((sdramArea_shuffledSync && _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_1[0]) ? _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_35 : _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_36);
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowWait0 : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_rowWord0Reg <= io_sdramDout32;
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowRq1 : begin
          if(when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l828) begin
            if(sdramArea_refreshPending) begin
              sdramArea_refreshPending <= 1'b0;
              sdramArea_fsm_refreshReturn <= 4'b0101;
            end else begin
              `ifndef SYNTHESIS
                `ifdef FORMAL
                  assert(((! (sdramArea_shuffledSync || (sdramArea_tileRowBaseSelSync == 23'h00a000))) || (_zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_6 < 23'h000200))); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L491
                `else
                  if(!((! (sdramArea_shuffledSync || (sdramArea_tileRowBaseSelSync == 23'h00a000))) || (_zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_6 < 23'h000200)) && $realtime != 0) begin
                    $display("ERROR P3 Risk #1: planar tileRowByteAddr effOffset exceeds TotalBytes"); // SdramTileAttributeFetch.scala:L491
                  end
                `endif
              `endif
              sdramArea_cmdAddr <= ((sdramArea_shuffledSync && _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_4[0]) ? _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_37 : _zz_sdramArea_cmdAddr_38);
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sFetchRowWait1 : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_pushPayload <= {{{sdramArea_priorityReg,sdramArea_bankReg},io_sdramDout32},sdramArea_rowWord0Reg};
            sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b1;
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sPushTile : begin
          if(wordFifo_io_push_fire) begin
            if(!when_SdramTileAttributeFetch_l848) begin
              sdramArea_tileIdx <= (sdramArea_tileIdx + 6'h01);
            end
          end
        end
        sdramArea_fsm_sRefresh : begin
        end
        default : begin
        end
      endcase
      sdramArea_cmdRd <= sdramArea_cmdRd_aheadValue;
      sdramArea_cmdWr <= sdramArea_cmdWr_aheadValue;
      sdramArea_cmdRefresh <= sdramArea_cmdRefresh_aheadValue;
    end
  end


endmodule

  assign when_Stream_l477 = (! popCC_readArbitation_valid);
  assign popCC_readArbitation_valid = popCC_addressGen_rValid;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_payload = popCC_addressGen_rData;
  assign popCC_readPort_rsp = ram_spinal_port1;
  assign popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid = popCC_addressGen_fire;
  assign popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload = popCC_addressGen_payload;
  assign popCC_readPort_cmd_valid = popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  assign popCC_readPort_cmd_payload = popCC_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_translated_valid = popCC_readArbitation_valid;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_ready = popCC_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_translated_payload = popCC_readPort_rsp;
  assign io_pop_valid = popCC_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_translated_ready = io_pop_ready;
  assign io_pop_payload = popCC_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  assign popCC_readArbitation_fire = (popCC_readArbitation_valid && popCC_readArbitation_ready);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy = (popCC_pushPtrGray[1] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_1);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_1 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[2] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_2);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_2 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[3] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_3);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_3 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[4] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_4);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_4 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[5] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_5);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_5 = (popCC_pushPtrGray[6] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy_6);
  assign _zz_io_popOccupancy_6 = popCC_pushPtrGray[7];
  assign io_popOccupancy = ({_zz_io_popOccupancy_6,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_5,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_4,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_3,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_2,{_zz_io_popOccupancy_1,{_zz_io_popOccupancy,(popCC_pushPtrGray[0] ^ _zz_io_popOccupancy)}}}}}}} - popCC_ptrToOccupancy);
  assign pushToPopGray = pushCC_pushPtrGray;
  assign popToPushGray = popCC_ptrToPush;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      pushCC_pushPtr <= 8'h0;
      pushCC_pushPtrGray <= 8'h0;
    end else begin
      if(io_push_fire) begin
        pushCC_pushPtrGray <= (_zz_pushCC_pushPtrGray ^ pushCC_pushPtrPlus);
      end
      if(io_push_fire) begin
        pushCC_pushPtr <= pushCC_pushPtrPlus;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge sdram_clk or posedge reset_synchronized) begin
    if(reset_synchronized) begin
      popCC_popPtr <= 8'h0;
      popCC_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      popCC_ptrToPush <= 8'h0;
      popCC_ptrToOccupancy <= 8'h0;
    end else begin
      if(popCC_addressGen_fire) begin
        popCC_popPtr <= popCC_popPtrPlus;
      end
      if(popCC_addressGen_ready) begin
        popCC_addressGen_rValid <= popCC_addressGen_valid;
      end
      if(popCC_readArbitation_fire) begin
        popCC_ptrToPush <= popCC_popPtrGray;
      end
      if(popCC_readArbitation_fire) begin
        popCC_ptrToOccupancy <= popCC_popPtr;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge sdram_clk) begin
    if(popCC_addressGen_ready) begin
      popCC_addressGen_rData <= popCC_addressGen_payload;
    end
  end


endmodule

module QspiSdramBridge (
  input  wire          io_headerValid,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_addrInit,
  input  wire [16:0]   io_lenBytes,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_byteIn,
  input  wire          io_byteValid,
  input  wire          io_allowUpload,
  output wire          io_wrCmd_valid,
  input  wire          io_wrCmd_ready,
  output wire [30:0]   io_wrCmd_payload,
  output wire          io_uploadBusy,
  output wire          io_uploadDone,
  output wire          io_uploadError,
  output wire          io_fifoOverflow,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);
  localparam fsm_BOOT = 3'd0;
  localparam fsm_sIdle = 3'd1;
  localparam fsm_sActive = 3'd2;
  localparam fsm_sFlush = 3'd3;
  localparam fsm_sDone = 3'd4;

  wire                byteFifo_io_pop_ready;
  wire       [39:0]   hdrFifo_io_push_payload;
  reg                 hdrFifo_io_pop_ready;
  wire                byteFifo_io_push_ready;
  wire                byteFifo_io_pop_valid;
  wire       [7:0]    byteFifo_io_pop_payload;
  wire       [7:0]    byteFifo_io_occupancy;
  wire       [7:0]    byteFifo_io_availability;
  wire                hdrFifo_io_push_ready;
  wire                hdrFifo_io_pop_valid;
  wire       [39:0]   hdrFifo_io_pop_payload;
  wire       [3:0]    hdrFifo_io_occupancy;
  wire       [3:0]    hdrFifo_io_availability;
  reg        [22:0]   addrReg;
  reg        [16:0]   bytesLeft;
  reg                 fifoOverflow;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l93;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l97;
  reg                 donePulse;
  reg        [15:0]   stallCnt;
  reg                 uploadError;
  wire                fsm_wantExit;
  reg                 fsm_wantStart;
  wire                fsm_wantKill;
  wire                io_wrCmd_fire;
  reg        [2:0]    fsm_stateReg;
  reg        [2:0]    fsm_stateNext;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l148;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l156;
  wire                when_QspiSdramBridge_l167;
  wire                fsm_onExit_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sIdle;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sActive;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sFlush;
  wire                fsm_onExit_sDone;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_BOOT;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sIdle;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sActive;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sFlush;
  wire                fsm_onEntry_sDone;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateReg_string;
  reg [55:0] fsm_stateNext_string;
  `endif


  StreamFifo byteFifo (
    .io_push_valid   (io_byteValid                 ), //i
    .io_push_ready   (byteFifo_io_push_ready       ), //o
    .io_push_payload (io_byteIn[7:0]               ), //i
    .io_pop_valid    (byteFifo_io_pop_valid        ), //o
    .io_pop_ready    (byteFifo_io_pop_ready        ), //i
    .io_pop_payload  (byteFifo_io_pop_payload[7:0] ), //o
    .io_flush        (1'b0                         ), //i
    .io_occupancy    (byteFifo_io_occupancy[7:0]   ), //o
    .io_availability (byteFifo_io_availability[7:0]), //o
    .clk             (clk                          ), //i
    .reset           (reset                        )  //i
  );
  StreamFifo_1 hdrFifo (
    .io_push_valid   (io_headerValid               ), //i
    .io_push_ready   (hdrFifo_io_push_ready        ), //o
    .io_push_payload (hdrFifo_io_push_payload[39:0]), //i
    .io_pop_valid    (hdrFifo_io_pop_valid         ), //o
    .io_pop_ready    (hdrFifo_io_pop_ready         ), //i
    .io_pop_payload  (hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[39:0] ), //o
    .io_flush        (1'b0                         ), //i
    .io_occupancy    (hdrFifo_io_occupancy[3:0]    ), //o
    .io_availability (hdrFifo_io_availability[3:0] ), //o
    .clk             (clk                          ), //i
    .reset           (reset                        )  //i
  );
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateReg_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sIdle : fsm_stateReg_string = "sIdle  ";
      fsm_sActive : fsm_stateReg_string = "sActive";
      fsm_sFlush : fsm_stateReg_string = "sFlush ";
      fsm_sDone : fsm_stateReg_string = "sDone  ";
      default : fsm_stateReg_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_stateNext)
      fsm_BOOT : fsm_stateNext_string = "BOOT   ";
      fsm_sIdle : fsm_stateNext_string = "sIdle  ";
      fsm_sActive : fsm_stateNext_string = "sActive";
      fsm_sFlush : fsm_stateNext_string = "sFlush ";
      fsm_sDone : fsm_stateNext_string = "sDone  ";
      default : fsm_stateNext_string = "???????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l93 = (io_byteValid && (! byteFifo_io_push_ready));
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l97 = (io_wrCmd_valid && (! io_wrCmd_ready));
  assign hdrFifo_io_push_payload = {io_addrInit,io_lenBytes};
  always @(*) begin
    hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          hdrFifo_io_pop_ready = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantExit = 1'b0;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_wantStart = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
      end
      default : begin
        fsm_wantStart = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_wantKill = 1'b0;
  assign io_wrCmd_valid = (((fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive) && byteFifo_io_pop_valid) && io_allowUpload);
  assign io_wrCmd_payload = {addrReg,byteFifo_io_pop_payload};
  assign io_wrCmd_fire = (io_wrCmd_valid && io_wrCmd_ready);
  assign byteFifo_io_pop_ready = (io_wrCmd_fire || (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sFlush));
  assign io_uploadBusy = ((! (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle)) || hdrFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign io_uploadDone = donePulse;
  assign io_uploadError = uploadError;
  assign io_fifoOverflow = fifoOverflow;
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_stateNext = fsm_stateReg;
    case(fsm_stateReg)
      fsm_sIdle : begin
        if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sActive;
        end
      end
      fsm_sActive : begin
        if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l148) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sDone;
          end
        end else begin
          if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l156) begin
            fsm_stateNext = fsm_sFlush;
          end
        end
      end
      fsm_sFlush : begin
        if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l167) begin
          fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
        end
      end
      fsm_sDone : begin
        fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
    if(fsm_wantStart) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_sIdle;
    end
    if(fsm_wantKill) begin
      fsm_stateNext = fsm_BOOT;
    end
  end

  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l148 = (bytesLeft == 17'h00001);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l156 = (stallCnt == 16'hffff);
  assign when_QspiSdramBridge_l167 = (! byteFifo_io_pop_valid);
  assign fsm_onExit_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onExit_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onExit_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sActive));
  assign fsm_onExit_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onExit_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sDone));
  assign fsm_onEntry_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sIdle = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sIdle) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sIdle));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sActive = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sActive) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sActive));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sFlush = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sFlush) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sFlush));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sDone = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sDone) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sDone));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      addrReg <= 23'h0;
      bytesLeft <= 17'h0;
      fifoOverflow <= 1'b0;
      donePulse <= 1'b0;
      stallCnt <= 16'h0;
      uploadError <= 1'b0;
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_BOOT;
    end else begin
      if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l93) begin
        fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l97) begin
        fifoOverflow <= 1'b1;
      end
      donePulse <= 1'b0;
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_stateNext;
      case(fsm_stateReg)
        fsm_sIdle : begin
          stallCnt <= 16'h0;
          if(hdrFifo_io_pop_valid) begin
            addrReg <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[39 : 17];
            bytesLeft <= hdrFifo_io_pop_payload[16 : 0];
          end
        end
        fsm_sActive : begin
          if(io_wrCmd_fire) begin
            addrReg <= (addrReg + 23'h000001);
            bytesLeft <= (bytesLeft - 17'h00001);
            stallCnt <= 16'h0;
          end else begin
            stallCnt <= (stallCnt + 16'h0001);
            if(when_QspiSdramBridge_l156) begin
              uploadError <= 1'b1;
            end
          end
        end
        fsm_sFlush : begin
        end
        fsm_sDone : begin
          donePulse <= 1'b1;
        end
        default : begin
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module ScrollWrap (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_coord,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_scroll,
  output wire [9:0]    io_result
);

  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_1;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_wrapped_2;
  wire       [10:0]   sum;
  wire       [10:0]   wrapped;

  assign _zz_wrapped = (sum - 11'h780);
  assign _zz_wrapped_1 = (sum - 11'h500);
  assign _zz_wrapped_2 = (sum - 11'h280);
  assign sum = ({1'b0,io_coord} + {1'b0,io_scroll});
  assign wrapped = ((11'h780 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped : ((11'h500 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_1 : ((11'h280 <= sum) ? _zz_wrapped_2 : sum)));
  assign io_result = wrapped[9:0];

endmodule

module ColorMath (
  input  wire [23:0]   io_rgbIn,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_op,
  input  wire [7:0]    io_constant,
  input  wire          io_enable,
  output reg  [23:0]   io_rgbOut
);

  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_1;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_1_1;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_1_2;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_2;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz__zz_addRgb_2_1;
  wire       [7:0]    r;
  wire       [7:0]    g;
  wire       [7:0]    b;
  wire       [6:0]    rShadow;
  wire       [6:0]    gShadow;
  wire       [6:0]    bShadow;
  wire       [23:0]   shadowRgb;
  wire       [23:0]   highlightRgb;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_addRgb;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_addRgb_1;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_addRgb_2;
  wire       [23:0]   addRgb;

  assign _zz__zz_addRgb = {1'd0, r};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_1 = {1'd0, io_constant};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_1_1 = {1'd0, g};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_1_2 = {1'd0, io_constant};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_2 = {1'd0, b};
  assign _zz__zz_addRgb_2_1 = {1'd0, io_constant};
  assign r = io_rgbIn[23 : 16];
  assign g = io_rgbIn[15 : 8];
  assign b = io_rgbIn[7 : 0];
  assign rShadow = io_rgbIn[23 : 17];
  assign gShadow = io_rgbIn[15 : 9];
  assign bShadow = io_rgbIn[7 : 1];
  assign shadowRgb = {{{{{1'b0,rShadow},1'b0},gShadow},1'b0},bShadow};
  assign highlightRgb = {{(r[7] ? 8'hff : {r[6 : 0],1'b0}),(g[7] ? 8'hff : {g[6 : 0],1'b0})},(b[7] ? 8'hff : {b[6 : 0],1'b0})};
  assign _zz_addRgb = (_zz__zz_addRgb + _zz__zz_addRgb_1);
  assign _zz_addRgb_1 = (_zz__zz_addRgb_1_1 + _zz__zz_addRgb_1_2);
  assign _zz_addRgb_2 = (_zz__zz_addRgb_2 + _zz__zz_addRgb_2_1);
  assign addRgb = {{(_zz_addRgb[8] ? 8'hff : _zz_addRgb[7 : 0]),(_zz_addRgb_1[8] ? 8'hff : _zz_addRgb_1[7 : 0])},(_zz_addRgb_2[8] ? 8'hff : _zz_addRgb_2[7 : 0])};
  always @(*) begin
    io_rgbOut = io_rgbIn;
    if(io_enable) begin
      case(io_op)
        2'b01 : begin
          io_rgbOut = shadowRgb;
        end
        2'b10 : begin
          io_rgbOut = highlightRgb;
        end
        2'b11 : begin
          io_rgbOut = addRgb;
        end
        default : begin
          io_rgbOut = io_rgbIn;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

//WindowUnit_1 replaced by WindowUnit

module WindowUnit (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_hCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_vCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winX0,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winX1,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winY0,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_winY1,
  input  wire          io_invert,
  output wire          io_inside,
  output wire          io_effect
);


  assign io_inside = ((((io_winX0 <= io_hCounter) && (io_hCounter < io_winX1)) && (io_winY0 <= io_vCounter)) && (io_vCounter < io_winY1));
  assign io_effect = (io_inside ^ io_invert);

endmodule

module RasterTriggerUnit (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_vCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_hCounter,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_triggerLine,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_triggerPixel,
  input  wire          io_pixelCmpEnable,
  input  wire          io_enable,
  input  wire          io_clear,
  output wire          io_triggerPulse,
  output wire          io_pending,
  output wire          io_irq,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  wire                lineMatch;
  wire                pixelMatch;
  wire                match_;
  reg                 matchPrev;
  wire                matchRise;
  reg                 pendingReg;

  assign lineMatch = (io_vCounter == io_triggerLine);
  assign pixelMatch = (io_pixelCmpEnable ? (io_hCounter == io_triggerPixel) : (io_hCounter == 10'h0));
  assign match_ = ((io_enable && lineMatch) && pixelMatch);
  assign matchRise = (match_ && (! matchPrev));
  assign io_triggerPulse = matchRise;
  assign io_pending = pendingReg;
  assign io_irq = pendingReg;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      matchPrev <= 1'b0;
      pendingReg <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      matchPrev <= match_;
      if(matchRise) begin
        pendingReg <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(io_clear) begin
        pendingReg <= 1'b0;
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign lineBase = 11'h280;
  assign zeroBase = 11'h0;
  assign writeSelNext = (io_swap ? (! writeSel) : writeSel);
  assign readBase = (writeSelNext ? zeroBase : lineBase);
  assign _zz_io_readData = (readBase + _zz__zz_io_readData);
  assign io_readData = buf_1_spinal_port1;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      writeSel <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(io_swap) begin
        writeSel <= (! writeSel);
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module LineBuffer (
  input  wire          io_writeEnable,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_writeAddr,
  input  wire [12:0]   io_writeData,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_readAddr,
  output wire [12:0]   io_readData,
  input  wire          io_swap,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  reg        [12:0]   buf_1_spinal_port1;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_buf_1_port;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_buf_1_port_1;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz__zz_io_readData;
  wire                _zz_buf_1_port_2;
  wire                _zz_io_readData_1;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  wire       [10:0]   lineBase;
  wire       [10:0]   zeroBase;
  reg                 writeSel;
  wire                writeSelNext;
  wire       [10:0]   readBase;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_io_readData;
  reg [12:0] buf_1 [0:1279];

  assign _zz_buf_1_port = ((writeSel ? lineBase : zeroBase) + _zz_buf_1_port_1);
  assign _zz_buf_1_port_1 = {1'd0, io_writeAddr};
  assign _zz__zz_io_readData = {1'd0, io_readAddr};
  assign _zz_io_readData_1 = 1'b1;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      buf_1[_zz_buf_1_port] <= io_writeData;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_io_readData_1) begin
      buf_1_spinal_port1 <= buf_1[_zz_io_readData];
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(io_writeEnable) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign lineBase = 11'h280;
  assign zeroBase = 11'h0;
  assign writeSelNext = (io_swap ? (! writeSel) : writeSel);
  assign readBase = (writeSelNext ? zeroBase : lineBase);
  assign _zz_io_readData = (readBase + _zz__zz_io_readData);
  assign io_readData = buf_1_spinal_port1;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      writeSel <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(io_swap) begin
        writeSel <= (! writeSel);
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

          affEnR <= slotAffEnR;
          affOnR <= affOn;
          writeXR <= (slotXR + _zz_writeXR);
          if(when_SpriteRasterizer_l515) begin
            rState <= ST_IDLE;
          end else begin
            pixCnt <= (pixCnt + 7'h01);
            if(slotAffEnR) begin
              uState <= ($signed(uState) + $signed(_zz_uState_10));
              vState <= ($signed(vState) + $signed(_zz_vState_9));
            end
          end
      end
      if(io_lineRenderStart) begin
        rState <= ST_IDLE;
        pixCnt <= 7'h0;
        slotZeroDone <= 1'b0;
        if(when_SpriteRasterizer_l535) begin
          sfState <= SF_DONE;
          slotIdx <= 3'b000;
        end else begin
          sfState <= SF_FIND;
          slotIdx <= _zz_slotIdx[2:0];
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

  assign _zz_uAcc_3 = ($signed(bS) * $signed(yS));
  assign _zz_vAcc_1 = ($signed(_zz_vAcc_2) + $signed(_zz_vAcc_3));
  assign _zz_vAcc = _zz_vAcc_1[31:0];
  assign _zz_vAcc_2 = ($signed(cS) * $signed(xS));
  assign _zz_vAcc_3 = ($signed(dS) * $signed(yS));
  assign _zz_io_uInt = uAcc[14 : 8];
  assign _zz_io_vInt = vAcc[14 : 8];
  assign aS = {{16{_zz_aS[15]}}, _zz_aS};
  assign bS = {{16{_zz_bS[15]}}, _zz_bS};
  assign cS = {{16{_zz_cS[15]}}, _zz_cS};
  assign dS = {{16{_zz_dS[15]}}, _zz_dS};
  assign xT = (_zz_xT <<< 2);
  assign yT = (_zz_yT <<< 2);
  assign xS = {{22{_zz_xS[9]}}, _zz_xS};
  assign yS = {{22{_zz_yS[9]}}, _zz_yS};
  assign uAcc = ($signed(_zz_uAcc) + $signed(xT));
  assign vAcc = ($signed(_zz_vAcc) + $signed(yT));
  assign io_uFrac = uAcc;
  assign io_vFrac = vAcc;
  assign io_uInt = _zz_io_uInt;
  assign io_vInt = _zz_io_vInt;

endmodule

  wire       [8:0]    yWrap_io_result;

  wire       [5:0]    tileX;

  end

  );

  );

      4'b1101 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[41 : 39];

  assign rowData = tileRows_spinal_port0;

module FetchSlotScheduler (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_hCounter,
  input  wire          io_lineStart,
  input  wire          io_schedule_0_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_0_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_0_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_0_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_1_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_1_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_1_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_1_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_2_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_2_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_2_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_2_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_3_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_3_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_3_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_3_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_4_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_4_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_4_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_4_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_5_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_5_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_5_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_5_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_6_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_6_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_6_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_6_endH,
  input  wire          io_schedule_7_enabled,
  input  wire [1:0]    io_schedule_7_clientId,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_7_startH,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_schedule_7_endH,
  output wire [2:0]    io_currentSlot,
  output wire          io_slotValid,
  output wire          io_preAnnounce,
  output wire          io_grant,
  output wire [1:0]    io_grantClientId,
  output wire [3:0]    io_lineGrantCount,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_0;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_1;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_2;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_3;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_4;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_5;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_6;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_preEnter_7;
  reg        [1:0]    _zz_io_grantClientId;
  wire                inWindow_0;
  wire                inWindow_1;
  wire                inWindow_2;
  wire                inWindow_3;
  wire                inWindow_4;
  wire                inWindow_5;
  wire                inWindow_6;
  wire                inWindow_7;
  wire                entering_0;
  wire                entering_1;
  wire                entering_2;
  wire                entering_3;
  wire                entering_4;
  wire                entering_5;
  wire                entering_6;
  wire                entering_7;
  wire                preEnter_0;
  wire                preEnter_1;
  wire                preEnter_2;
  wire                preEnter_3;
  wire                preEnter_4;
  wire                preEnter_5;
  wire                preEnter_6;
  wire                preEnter_7;
  reg        [2:0]    curSlot;
  reg        [2:0]    grantSlot;
  reg        [2:0]    grantSlotHeld;
  reg        [2:0]    grantSlotNow;
  reg        [3:0]    count;

  assign _zz_preEnter_0 = (io_schedule_0_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_1 = (io_schedule_1_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_2 = (io_schedule_2_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_3 = (io_schedule_3_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_4 = (io_schedule_4_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_5 = (io_schedule_5_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_6 = (io_schedule_6_startH - 10'h001);
  assign _zz_preEnter_7 = (io_schedule_7_startH - 10'h001);
  always @(*) begin
    case(grantSlotNow)
      3'b000 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_0_clientId;
      3'b001 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_1_clientId;
      3'b010 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_2_clientId;
      3'b011 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_3_clientId;
      3'b100 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_4_clientId;
      3'b101 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_5_clientId;
      3'b110 : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_6_clientId;
      default : _zz_io_grantClientId = io_schedule_7_clientId;
    endcase
  end

  assign inWindow_0 = ((io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_schedule_0_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_0_endH));
  assign entering_0 = (io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_0_startH));
  assign preEnter_0 = ((io_schedule_0_enabled && (io_schedule_0_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_0));
  assign inWindow_1 = ((io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_schedule_1_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_1_endH));
  assign entering_1 = (io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_1_startH));
  assign preEnter_1 = ((io_schedule_1_enabled && (io_schedule_1_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_1));
  assign inWindow_2 = ((io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_schedule_2_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_2_endH));
  assign entering_2 = (io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_2_startH));
  assign preEnter_2 = ((io_schedule_2_enabled && (io_schedule_2_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_2));
  assign inWindow_3 = ((io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_schedule_3_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_3_endH));
  assign entering_3 = (io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_3_startH));
  assign preEnter_3 = ((io_schedule_3_enabled && (io_schedule_3_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_3));
  assign inWindow_4 = ((io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_schedule_4_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_4_endH));
  assign entering_4 = (io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_4_startH));
  assign preEnter_4 = ((io_schedule_4_enabled && (io_schedule_4_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_4));
  assign inWindow_5 = ((io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_schedule_5_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_5_endH));
  assign entering_5 = (io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_5_startH));
  assign preEnter_5 = ((io_schedule_5_enabled && (io_schedule_5_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_5));
  assign inWindow_6 = ((io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_schedule_6_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_6_endH));
  assign entering_6 = (io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_6_startH));
  assign preEnter_6 = ((io_schedule_6_enabled && (io_schedule_6_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_6));
  assign inWindow_7 = ((io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_schedule_7_startH <= io_hCounter)) && (io_hCounter <= io_schedule_7_endH));
  assign entering_7 = (io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_hCounter == io_schedule_7_startH));
  assign preEnter_7 = ((io_schedule_7_enabled && (io_schedule_7_startH != 10'h0)) && (io_hCounter == _zz_preEnter_7));
  always @(*) begin
    curSlot = 3'b000;
    if(inWindow_7) begin
      curSlot = 3'b111;
    end
    if(inWindow_6) begin
      curSlot = 3'b110;
    end
    if(inWindow_5) begin
      curSlot = 3'b101;
    end
    if(inWindow_4) begin
      curSlot = 3'b100;
    end
    if(inWindow_3) begin
      curSlot = 3'b011;
    end
    if(inWindow_2) begin
      curSlot = 3'b010;
    end
    if(inWindow_1) begin
      curSlot = 3'b001;
    end
    if(inWindow_0) begin
      curSlot = 3'b000;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    grantSlot = 3'b000;
    if(entering_7) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b111;
    end
    if(entering_6) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b110;
    end
    if(entering_5) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b101;
    end
    if(entering_4) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b100;
    end
    if(entering_3) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b011;
    end
    if(entering_2) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b010;
    end
    if(entering_1) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b001;
    end
    if(entering_0) begin
      grantSlot = 3'b000;
    end
  end

  assign io_currentSlot = curSlot;
  assign io_slotValid = (|{inWindow_7,{inWindow_6,{inWindow_5,{inWindow_4,{inWindow_3,{inWindow_2,{inWindow_1,inWindow_0}}}}}}});
  assign io_grant = (|{entering_7,{entering_6,{entering_5,{entering_4,{entering_3,{entering_2,{entering_1,entering_0}}}}}}});
  assign io_preAnnounce = (|{preEnter_7,{preEnter_6,{preEnter_5,{preEnter_4,{preEnter_3,{preEnter_2,{preEnter_1,preEnter_0}}}}}}});
  always @(*) begin
    grantSlotNow = grantSlotHeld;
    if(entering_0) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b000;
    end
    if(entering_1) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b001;
    end
    if(entering_2) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b010;
    end
    if(entering_3) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b011;
    end
    if(entering_4) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b100;
    end
    if(entering_5) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b101;
    end
    if(entering_6) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b110;
    end
    if(entering_7) begin
      grantSlotNow = 3'b111;
    end
  end

  assign io_grantClientId = _zz_io_grantClientId;
  assign io_lineGrantCount = count;
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      grantSlotHeld <= 3'b000;
      count <= 4'b0000;
    end else begin
      grantSlotHeld <= grantSlotNow;
      if(io_lineStart) begin
        count <= 4'b0000;
      end else begin
        if(io_grant) begin
          count <= (count + 4'b0001);
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module PlanarLineFetch (
  input  wire          io_start,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_0,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_1,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_2,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_3,
  input  wire [22:0]   io_planeBaseAddr_4,
  output wire          io_sdramRd,
  output wire [22:0]   io_sdramAddr,
  input  wire          io_sdramBusy,
  input  wire          io_sdramDataReady,
  input  wire [31:0]   io_sdramDout32,
  input  wire [8:0]    io_pixelIdx,
  output wire [4:0]    io_pixel,
  output wire          io_rowReady,
  output wire          io_busy,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  wire                rowFetch_io_sdramRd;
  wire       [22:0]   rowFetch_io_sdramAddr;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_0;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_1;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_2;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_3;
  wire       [31:0]   rowFetch_io_slotWord_4;
  wire                rowFetch_io_rowReady;
  wire                rowFetch_io_busy;
  wire       [4:0]    recon_io_pixel;
  wire       [3:0]    slot;
  wire       [4:0]    subIdx;
  reg                 hasRow;

  BitplaneRowFetch rowFetch (
    .io_start           (io_start                    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_0 (io_planeBaseAddr_0[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_1 (io_planeBaseAddr_1[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_2 (io_planeBaseAddr_2[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_3 (io_planeBaseAddr_3[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_planeBaseAddr_4 (io_planeBaseAddr_4[22:0]    ), //i
    .io_sdramRd         (rowFetch_io_sdramRd         ), //o
    .io_sdramAddr       (rowFetch_io_sdramAddr[22:0] ), //o
    .io_sdramBusy       (io_sdramBusy                ), //i
    .io_sdramDataReady  (io_sdramDataReady           ), //i
    .io_sdramDout32     (io_sdramDout32[31:0]        ), //i
    .io_slotIdx         (slot[3:0]                   ), //i
    .io_slotWord_0      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_0[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_1      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_1[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_2      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_2[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_3      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_3[31:0]), //o
    .io_slotWord_4      (rowFetch_io_slotWord_4[31:0]), //o
    .io_rowReady        (rowFetch_io_rowReady        ), //o
    .io_busy            (rowFetch_io_busy            ), //o
    .clk                (clk                         ), //i
    .reset              (reset                       )  //i
  );
  BitplaneReconstruct recon (
    .io_planes_0 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_0[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_1 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_1[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_2 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_2[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_3 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_3[31:0]), //i
    .io_planes_4 (rowFetch_io_slotWord_4[31:0]), //i
    .io_bitIdx   (subIdx[4:0]                 ), //i
    .io_pixel    (recon_io_pixel[4:0]         )  //o
  );
  assign io_sdramRd = rowFetch_io_sdramRd;
  assign io_sdramAddr = rowFetch_io_sdramAddr;
  assign io_rowReady = rowFetch_io_rowReady;
  assign io_busy = rowFetch_io_busy;
  assign slot = io_pixelIdx[8 : 5];
  assign subIdx = io_pixelIdx[4 : 0];
  assign io_pixel = (hasRow ? recon_io_pixel : 5'h0);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      hasRow <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(rowFetch_io_rowReady) begin
        hasRow <= 1'b1;
      end
    end
  end


endmodule

module TestPatternSource (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_x,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_y,
  input  wire [2:0]    io_patternSelect,
  output wire [3:0]    io_pixelIndex,
  output wire [2:0]    io_paletteBank
);

  wire       [2:0]    _zz_idx;
  wire       [2:0]    _zz_idx_1;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_idx_2;
  wire       [0:0]    _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76;
  wire       [0:0]    _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76_1;
  reg        [3:0]    idx;
  reg        [2:0]    bank;
  wire                when_TestPatternSource_l76;
  wire                when_TestPatternSource_l88;
  wire                when_TestPatternSource_l98;

  assign _zz_idx = _zz_idx_1;
  assign _zz_idx_2 = (io_x / 10'h050);
  assign _zz_idx_1 = _zz_idx_2[2:0];
  assign _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76 = io_x[4 : 4];
  assign _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76_1 = io_y[4 : 4];
  always @(*) begin
    idx = 4'b0000;
    case(io_patternSelect)
      3'b000 : begin
        idx = {1'd0, _zz_idx};
      end
      3'b001 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b010 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b011 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b100 : begin
        idx = 4'b1111;
      end
      3'b101 : begin
        if(when_TestPatternSource_l76) begin
          idx = 4'b1111;
        end else begin
          idx = 4'b0000;
        end
      end
      3'b110 : begin
        if(when_TestPatternSource_l88) begin
          idx = 4'b1111;
        end else begin
          idx = 4'b0000;
        end
      end
      default : begin
        if(when_TestPatternSource_l98) begin
          idx = 4'b1111;
        end else begin
          idx = 4'b0000;
        end
      end
    endcase
  end

  always @(*) begin
    bank = 3'b000;
    case(io_patternSelect)
      3'b000 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      3'b001 : begin
        bank = 3'b001;
      end
      3'b010 : begin
        bank = 3'b010;
      end
      3'b011 : begin
        bank = 3'b011;
      end
      3'b100 : begin
        bank = 3'b100;
      end
      3'b101 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      3'b110 : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
      default : begin
        bank = 3'b000;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_TestPatternSource_l76 = (_zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76[0] ^ _zz_when_TestPatternSource_l76_1[0]);
  assign when_TestPatternSource_l88 = ((io_x[5 : 0] == 6'h0) || (io_y[5 : 0] == 6'h0));
  assign when_TestPatternSource_l98 = (io_x[0 : 0] == 1'b1);
  assign io_pixelIndex = idx;
  assign io_paletteBank = bank;

endmodule

module BasicPatternSource (
  input  wire [9:0]    io_x,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_y,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_scrollX,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_scrollY,
  output wire [2:0]    io_pixelIndex
);

  wire       [2:0]    tileMap_spinal_port0;
  wire       [47:0]   tileRows_spinal_port0;
  wire       [9:0]    xWrap_io_result;
  wire       [8:0]    yWrap_io_result;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_tileAddress;
  wire       [10:0]   _zz_tileAddress_1;
  reg        [2:0]    _zz_io_pixelIndex;
  wire       [5:0]    tileX;
  wire       [4:0]    tileY;
  wire       [3:0]    pixelX;
  wire       [3:0]    pixelY;
  wire       [10:0]   tileAddress;
  wire       [2:0]    tileIndex;
  wire       [6:0]    rowAddress;
  wire       [47:0]   rowData;
  reg [2:0] tileMap [0:2047];
  reg [47:0] tileRows [0:127];

  assign _zz_tileAddress = (tileY * 6'h28);
  assign _zz_tileAddress_1 = {5'd0, tileX};
  initial begin
    $readmemb("/home/itadmin/github/spinalhdlVDP/./simWorkspace/tmp/job_1/VdpTop.v_toplevel_layer0_tileMap.bin",tileMap);
  end
  assign tileMap_spinal_port0 = tileMap[tileAddress];
  initial begin
    $readmemb("/home/itadmin/github/spinalhdlVDP/./simWorkspace/tmp/job_1/VdpTop.v_toplevel_layer0_tileRows.bin",tileRows);
  end
  assign tileRows_spinal_port0 = tileRows[rowAddress];
  ScrollWrap xWrap (
    .io_coord  (io_x[9:0]           ), //i
    .io_scroll (io_scrollX[9:0]     ), //i
    .io_result (xWrap_io_result[9:0])  //o
  );
  ScrollWrap_1 yWrap (
    .io_coord  (io_y[9:0]           ), //i
    .io_scroll (io_scrollY[9:0]     ), //i
    .io_result (yWrap_io_result[8:0])  //o
  );
  always @(*) begin
    case(pixelX)
      4'b0000 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[2 : 0];
      4'b0001 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[5 : 3];
      4'b0010 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[8 : 6];
      4'b0011 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[11 : 9];
      4'b0100 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[14 : 12];
      4'b0101 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[17 : 15];
      4'b0110 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[20 : 18];
      4'b0111 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[23 : 21];
      4'b1000 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[26 : 24];
      4'b1001 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[29 : 27];
      4'b1010 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[32 : 30];
      4'b1011 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[35 : 33];
      4'b1100 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[38 : 36];
      4'b1101 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[41 : 39];
      4'b1110 : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[44 : 42];
      default : _zz_io_pixelIndex = rowData[47 : 45];
    endcase
  end

  assign tileX = xWrap_io_result[9 : 4];
  assign tileY = yWrap_io_result[8 : 4];
  assign pixelX = xWrap_io_result[3 : 0];
  assign pixelY = yWrap_io_result[3 : 0];
  assign tileAddress = (_zz_tileAddress + _zz_tileAddress_1);
  assign tileIndex = tileMap_spinal_port0;
  assign rowAddress = {tileIndex,pixelY};
  assign rowData = tileRows_spinal_port0;
  assign io_pixelIndex = _zz_io_pixelIndex;

endmodule

module ScrollTable (
  input  wire [6:0]    io_rdAddr,
  output wire [9:0]    io_rdData,
  input  wire [6:0]    io_wrAddr,
  input  wire [9:0]    io_wrData,
  input  wire          io_wr,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  wire       [9:0]    mem_spinal_port1;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_mem_port;
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [9:0] mem [0:127];

  assign _zz_mem_port = io_wrData;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(io_wr) begin
      mem[io_wrAddr] <= _zz_mem_port;
    end
  end

  assign mem_spinal_port1 = mem[io_rdAddr];
  assign io_rdData = mem_spinal_port1;

endmodule

module BlitterEngine (
  input  wire [14:0]   io_busAddr,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_busData,
  input  wire          io_busWr,
  input  wire          io_busBusy,
  output wire [14:0]   io_blitAddr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_blitData,
  output reg           io_blitWr,
  output wire          io_busy,
  output reg           io_done,
  input  wire          io_softClear,
  input  wire [13:0]   io_softClearAddr,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);
  localparam State_IDLE = 2'd0;
  localparam State_RUN = 2'd1;
  localparam State_DONE = 2'd2;

  reg        [15:0]   srcRam_spinal_port1;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_ctrlIdx;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_srcRamWrAddr;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_srcRam_port;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_srcRam_port_1;
  wire       [15:0]   _zz_srcRam_port_2;
  wire                _zz_srcRam_port_3;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_fsm_dstCur;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_fsm_srcCur;
  wire                _zz_srcRam_port_4;
  wire                _zz_fsm_srcRead;
  wire       [8:0]    _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr;
  wire       [9:0]    _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr_1;
  wire       [1:0]    MODE_RECT_FILL;
  wire       [1:0]    MODE_RECT_COPY;
  wire       [1:0]    MODE_LINE_FILL;
  reg        [9:0]    widthReg;
  reg        [9:0]    heightReg;
  reg        [14:0]   dstAddrReg;
  reg        [14:0]   dstStrideReg;
  reg        [8:0]    srcAddrReg;
  reg        [8:0]    srcStrideReg;
  reg        [15:0]   fillReg;
  reg                 goReg;
  reg        [1:0]    modeReg;
  wire                ctrlHit;
  wire                srcRamHit;
  wire       [2:0]    ctrlIdx;
  wire       [8:0]    srcRamWrAddr;
  wire                srcRamClearWr;
  reg        [1:0]    fsm_state;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_colCounter;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_rowCounter;
  reg        [14:0]   fsm_dstRowBase;
  reg        [8:0]    fsm_srcRowBase;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_effHeight;
  reg                 fsm_isCopy;
  wire       [14:0]   fsm_dstCur;
  wire       [8:0]    fsm_srcCur;
  reg        [8:0]    fsm_srcReadAddr;
  wire       [15:0]   fsm_srcRead;
  wire                when_BlitterEngine_l198;
  wire                when_BlitterEngine_l200;
  wire                when_BlitterEngine_l203;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [31:0] fsm_state_string;
  `endif

  (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [15:0] srcRam [0:511];

  assign _zz_ctrlIdx = (io_busAddr - 15'h0c00);
  assign _zz_srcRamWrAddr = (io_busAddr - 15'h0c10);
  assign _zz_srcRam_port_1 = io_softClearAddr[8:0];
  assign _zz_fsm_dstCur = {5'd0, fsm_colCounter};
  assign _zz_fsm_srcCur = fsm_colCounter[8:0];
  assign _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr_1 = (fsm_colCounter + 10'h001);
  assign _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr = _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr_1[8:0];
  assign _zz_srcRam_port = (io_softClear ? _zz_srcRam_port_1 : srcRamWrAddr);
  assign _zz_srcRam_port_2 = (io_softClear ? 16'h0 : io_busData);
  assign _zz_srcRam_port_3 = (srcRamHit || srcRamClearWr);
  assign _zz_fsm_srcRead = 1'b1;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_srcRam_port_3) begin
      srcRam[_zz_srcRam_port] <= _zz_srcRam_port_2;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_fsm_srcRead) begin
      srcRam_spinal_port1 <= srcRam[fsm_srcReadAddr];
    end
  end

  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : fsm_state_string = "IDLE";
      State_RUN : fsm_state_string = "RUN ";
      State_DONE : fsm_state_string = "DONE";
      default : fsm_state_string = "????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign MODE_RECT_FILL = 2'b00;
  assign MODE_RECT_COPY = 2'b01;
  assign MODE_LINE_FILL = 2'b10;
  assign ctrlHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0c00 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0c08));
  assign srcRamHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0c10 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0e10));
  assign ctrlIdx = _zz_ctrlIdx[2 : 0];
  assign srcRamWrAddr = _zz_srcRamWrAddr[8 : 0];
  assign srcRamClearWr = (io_softClear && (io_softClearAddr < 14'h0200));
  assign fsm_dstCur = (fsm_dstRowBase + _zz_fsm_dstCur);
  assign fsm_srcCur = (fsm_srcRowBase + _zz_fsm_srcCur);
  always @(*) begin
    fsm_srcReadAddr = fsm_srcCur;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
        if(goReg) begin
          fsm_srcReadAddr = srcAddrReg;
        end
      end
      State_RUN : begin
        if(when_BlitterEngine_l198) begin
          if(when_BlitterEngine_l200) begin
            if(!when_BlitterEngine_l203) begin
              fsm_srcReadAddr = (fsm_srcRowBase + srcStrideReg);
            end
          end else begin
            fsm_srcReadAddr = (fsm_srcRowBase + _zz_fsm_srcReadAddr);
          end
        end
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign fsm_srcRead = srcRam_spinal_port1;
  always @(*) begin
    io_blitWr = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
        if(when_BlitterEngine_l198) begin
          io_blitWr = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign io_blitAddr = fsm_dstCur;
  assign io_blitData = (fsm_isCopy ? fsm_srcRead : fillReg);
  assign io_busy = (fsm_state == State_RUN);
  always @(*) begin
    io_done = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
      end
      default : begin
        io_done = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_BlitterEngine_l198 = (! io_busBusy);
  assign when_BlitterEngine_l200 = (fsm_colCounter == widthReg);
  assign when_BlitterEngine_l203 = (fsm_rowCounter == fsm_effHeight);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      widthReg <= 10'h0;
      heightReg <= 10'h0;
      dstAddrReg <= 15'h0;
      dstStrideReg <= 15'h0;
      srcAddrReg <= 9'h0;
      srcStrideReg <= 9'h0;
      fillReg <= 16'h0;
      goReg <= 1'b0;
      modeReg <= 2'b00;
      fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
      fsm_colCounter <= 10'h0;
      fsm_rowCounter <= 10'h0;
      fsm_dstRowBase <= 15'h0;
      fsm_srcRowBase <= 9'h0;
      fsm_effHeight <= 10'h0;
      fsm_isCopy <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(ctrlHit) begin
        case(ctrlIdx)
          3'b000 : begin
            goReg <= io_busData[0];
            modeReg <= io_busData[2 : 1];
          end
          3'b001 : begin
            widthReg <= io_busData[9 : 0];
          end
          3'b010 : begin
            heightReg <= io_busData[9 : 0];
          end
          3'b011 : begin
            dstAddrReg <= io_busData[14 : 0];
          end
          3'b100 : begin
            dstStrideReg <= io_busData[14 : 0];
          end
          3'b101 : begin
            srcAddrReg <= io_busData[8 : 0];
          end
          3'b110 : begin
            srcStrideReg <= io_busData[8 : 0];
          end
          default : begin
            fillReg <= io_busData;
          end
        endcase
      end
      case(fsm_state)
        State_IDLE : begin
          fsm_colCounter <= 10'h0;
          fsm_rowCounter <= 10'h0;
          if(goReg) begin
            goReg <= 1'b0;
            fsm_state <= State_RUN;
            fsm_dstRowBase <= dstAddrReg;
            fsm_srcRowBase <= srcAddrReg;
            fsm_effHeight <= ((modeReg == MODE_LINE_FILL) ? 10'h0 : heightReg);
            fsm_isCopy <= (modeReg == MODE_RECT_COPY);
          end
        end
        State_RUN : begin
          if(when_BlitterEngine_l198) begin
            if(when_BlitterEngine_l200) begin
              fsm_colCounter <= 10'h0;
              if(when_BlitterEngine_l203) begin
                fsm_state <= State_DONE;
              end else begin
                fsm_rowCounter <= (fsm_rowCounter + 10'h001);
                fsm_dstRowBase <= (fsm_dstRowBase + dstStrideReg);
                fsm_srcRowBase <= (fsm_srcRowBase + srcStrideReg);
              end
            end else begin
              fsm_colCounter <= (fsm_colCounter + 10'h001);
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
          fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module DmaEngine (
  input  wire [14:0]   io_busAddr,
  input  wire [15:0]   io_busData,
  input  wire          io_busWr,
  input  wire          io_busBusy,
  output wire [14:0]   io_dmaAddr,
  output wire [15:0]   io_dmaData,
  output reg           io_dmaWr,
  output wire          io_busy,
  output reg           io_done,
  input  wire          io_softClear,
  input  wire [13:0]   io_softClearAddr,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);
  localparam State_IDLE = 2'd0;
  localparam State_RUN = 2'd1;
  localparam State_DONE = 2'd2;

  wire       [15:0]   staging_spinal_port1;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_ctrlIdx;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_stagingWrAddr;
  wire       [5:0]    _zz_staging_port;
  wire       [5:0]    _zz_staging_port_1;
  wire       [15:0]   _zz_staging_port_2;
  wire                _zz_staging_port_3;
  wire       [14:0]   _zz_io_dmaAddr;
  reg        [14:0]   dstReg;
  reg        [9:0]    lenReg;
  reg        [15:0]   fillReg;
  reg                 goReg;
  reg                 modeReg;
  wire                ctrlHit;
  wire                stagingHit;
  wire       [1:0]    ctrlIdx;
  wire       [5:0]    stagingWrAddr;
  wire                stagingClearWr;
  reg        [1:0]    fsm_state;
  reg        [9:0]    fsm_counter;
  wire       [5:0]    _zz_fsm_stagingRead;
  wire       [15:0]   fsm_stagingRead;
  wire                when_DmaEngine_l156;
  wire                when_DmaEngine_l158;
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  reg [31:0] fsm_state_string;
  `endif

  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [15:0] staging [0:63];

  assign _zz_ctrlIdx = (io_busAddr - 15'h0b00);
  assign _zz_stagingWrAddr = (io_busAddr - 15'h0b10);
  assign _zz_staging_port_1 = io_softClearAddr[5:0];
  assign _zz_io_dmaAddr = {5'd0, fsm_counter};
  assign _zz_staging_port = (io_softClear ? _zz_staging_port_1 : stagingWrAddr);
  assign _zz_staging_port_2 = (io_softClear ? 16'h0 : io_busData);
  assign _zz_staging_port_3 = (stagingHit || stagingClearWr);
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_staging_port_3) begin
      staging[_zz_staging_port] <= _zz_staging_port_2;
    end
  end

  assign staging_spinal_port1 = staging[_zz_fsm_stagingRead];
  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  always @(*) begin
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : fsm_state_string = "IDLE";
      State_RUN : fsm_state_string = "RUN ";
      State_DONE : fsm_state_string = "DONE";
      default : fsm_state_string = "????";
    endcase
  end
  `endif

  assign ctrlHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0b00 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0b04));
  assign stagingHit = ((io_busWr && (15'h0b10 <= io_busAddr)) && (io_busAddr < 15'h0b50));
  assign ctrlIdx = _zz_ctrlIdx[1 : 0];
  assign stagingWrAddr = _zz_stagingWrAddr[5 : 0];
  assign stagingClearWr = (io_softClear && (io_softClearAddr < 14'h0040));
  assign _zz_fsm_stagingRead = fsm_counter[5 : 0];
  assign fsm_stagingRead = staging_spinal_port1;
  always @(*) begin
    io_dmaWr = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
        if(when_DmaEngine_l156) begin
          io_dmaWr = 1'b1;
        end
      end
      default : begin
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign io_dmaAddr = (dstReg + _zz_io_dmaAddr);
  assign io_dmaData = (modeReg ? fsm_stagingRead : fillReg);
  assign io_busy = (fsm_state == State_RUN);
  always @(*) begin
    io_done = 1'b0;
    case(fsm_state)
      State_IDLE : begin
      end
      State_RUN : begin
      end
      default : begin
        io_done = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_DmaEngine_l156 = (! io_busBusy);
  assign when_DmaEngine_l158 = (fsm_counter == lenReg);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      dstReg <= 15'h0;
      lenReg <= 10'h0;
      fillReg <= 16'h0;
      goReg <= 1'b0;
      modeReg <= 1'b0;
      fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
      fsm_counter <= 10'h0;
    end else begin
      if(ctrlHit) begin
        case(ctrlIdx)
          2'b00 : begin
            dstReg <= io_busData[14 : 0];
          end
          2'b01 : begin
            lenReg <= io_busData[9 : 0];
          end
          2'b10 : begin
            fillReg <= io_busData;
          end
          default : begin
            goReg <= io_busData[0];
            modeReg <= io_busData[1];
          end
        endcase
      end
      case(fsm_state)
        State_IDLE : begin
          fsm_counter <= 10'h0;
          if(goReg) begin
            goReg <= 1'b0;
            fsm_state <= State_RUN;
          end
        end
        State_RUN : begin
          if(when_DmaEngine_l156) begin
            if(when_DmaEngine_l158) begin
              fsm_state <= State_DONE;
            end else begin
              fsm_counter <= (fsm_counter + 10'h001);
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
          fsm_state <= State_IDLE;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end


endmodule

module StreamFifo (
  input  wire          io_push_valid,
  output wire          io_push_ready,
  input  wire [30:0]   io_push_payload,
  output wire          io_pop_valid,
  input  wire          io_pop_ready,
  output wire [30:0]   io_pop_payload,
  input  wire          io_flush,
  output wire [6:0]    io_occupancy,
  output wire [6:0]    io_availability,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  reg        [30:0]   logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPush;
  wire                logic_ptr_doPop;
  wire                logic_ptr_full;
  wire                logic_ptr_empty;
  reg        [6:0]    logic_ptr_push;
  reg        [6:0]    logic_ptr_pop;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_ptr_occupancy;
  wire       [6:0]    logic_ptr_popOnIo;
  wire                when_Stream_l1455;
  reg                 logic_ptr_wentUp;
  wire                io_push_fire;
  wire                logic_push_onRam_write_valid;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address;
  wire       [30:0]   logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_ready;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload;
  reg                 logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  reg        [5:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  wire                when_Stream_l477;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload;
  wire       [30:0]   logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  wire                logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  wire       [5:0]    logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  wire       [30:0]   logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  wire                logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire;
  reg        [6:0]    logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  reg [30:0] logic_ram [0:63];

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      logic_ram[logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address] <= logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid) begin
      logic_ram_spinal_port1 <= logic_ram[logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload];
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(logic_push_onRam_write_valid) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l1455 = (logic_ptr_doPush != logic_ptr_doPop);
  assign logic_ptr_full = (((logic_ptr_push ^ logic_ptr_popOnIo) ^ 7'h40) == 7'h0);
  assign logic_ptr_empty = (logic_ptr_push == logic_ptr_pop);
  assign logic_ptr_occupancy = (logic_ptr_push - logic_ptr_popOnIo);
  assign io_push_ready = (! logic_ptr_full);
  assign io_push_fire = (io_push_valid && io_push_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPush = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_valid = io_push_fire;
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_address = logic_ptr_push[5:0];
  assign logic_push_onRam_write_payload_data = io_push_payload;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_valid = (! logic_ptr_empty);
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_payload = logic_ptr_pop[5:0];
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_fire = (logic_pop_addressGen_valid && logic_pop_addressGen_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_doPop = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  always @(*) begin
    logic_pop_addressGen_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready;
    if(when_Stream_l477) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_ready = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign when_Stream_l477 = (! logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid);
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_rValid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_rData;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp = logic_ram_spinal_port1;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_fire;
  assign logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_valid = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readPort_cmd_payload = logic_pop_addressGen_toFlowFire_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload = logic_pop_sync_readPort_rsp;
  assign io_pop_valid = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_valid;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_ready = io_pop_ready;
  assign io_pop_payload = logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_translated_payload;
  assign logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire = (logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_valid && logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_ready);
  assign logic_ptr_popOnIo = logic_pop_sync_popReg;
  assign io_occupancy = logic_ptr_occupancy;
  assign io_availability = (7'h40 - logic_ptr_occupancy);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      logic_ptr_push <= 7'h0;
      logic_ptr_pop <= 7'h0;
      logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 7'h0;
    end else begin
      if(when_Stream_l1455) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= logic_ptr_doPush;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_wentUp <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= (logic_ptr_push + 7'h01);
      end
      if(logic_ptr_doPop) begin
        logic_ptr_pop <= (logic_ptr_pop + 7'h01);
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_ptr_push <= 7'h0;
        logic_ptr_pop <= 7'h0;
      end
      if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= logic_pop_addressGen_valid;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_addressGen_rValid <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(logic_pop_sync_readArbitation_fire) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= logic_ptr_pop;
      end
      if(io_flush) begin
        logic_pop_sync_popReg <= 7'h0;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(logic_pop_addressGen_ready) begin
      logic_pop_addressGen_rData <= logic_pop_addressGen_payload;
    end
  end


endmodule
