      end
      default : begin
        when_Copper_l244 = 1'b0;
      end
    endcase
  end

  assign when_Copper_l196 = (! io_enabled);
  assign when_Copper_l268 = ((io_vCounter == fetchWord[9 : 0]) && (opWaitIsPx ? (io_hCounter == opXLatch) : (io_hCounter == 10'h0)));
  assign when_Copper_l260 = (! io_enabled);
  assign when_Copper_l279 = (! io_enabled);
  assign when_Copper_l309 = (seqCount == 3'b000);
  assign when_Copper_l304 = (! io_enabled);
  assign fsm_onExit_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onExit_sHalt = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sHalt) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sHalt));
  assign fsm_onExit_sFetch = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sFetch) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sFetch));
  assign fsm_onExit_sWaitStall = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sWaitStall) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sWaitStall));
  assign fsm_onExit_sWriteData = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sWriteData) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sWriteData));
  assign fsm_onExit_sSeqData = ((fsm_stateNext != fsm_sSeqData) && (fsm_stateReg == fsm_sSeqData));
  assign fsm_onEntry_BOOT = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_BOOT) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_BOOT));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sHalt = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sHalt) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sHalt));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sFetch = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sFetch) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sFetch));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sWaitStall = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sWaitStall) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sWaitStall));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sWriteData = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sWriteData) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sWriteData));
  assign fsm_onEntry_sSeqData = ((fsm_stateNext == fsm_sSeqData) && (fsm_stateReg != fsm_sSeqData));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      activeBank <= 1'b0;
      pc <= 9'h0;
      opAddr <= 15'h0;
      seqCount <= 3'b000;
      opXLatch <= 10'h0;
      opWaitIsPx <= 1'b0;
      regAddrR <= 15'h0;
      regDataR <= 16'h0;
      regWrR <= 1'b0;
      hdmaEnable <= 1'b0;
      hdmaChMask <= 4'b0000;
      hdmaDoneSt <= 1'b0;
      hdmaIndirect <= 1'b0;
      chAddr0 <= 15'h0;
      chAddr1 <= 15'h0;
      chAddr2 <= 15'h0;
      chAddr3 <= 15'h0;
      hdmaDataPtr <= 8'h0;
      sweepActive <= 1'b0;
      sweepCh <= 3'b000;
      sweepEnt <= 3'b000;
      hzeroPrev <= 1'b0;
      hdmaRegAddr <= 15'h0;
      hdmaRegData <= 16'h0;
      hdmaRegWr <= 1'b0;
      hdmaHitR <= 1'b0;
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_BOOT;
    end else begin
      activeBank <= activeBankNext;
      pc <= pcNext;
      regWrR <= 1'b0;
      if(io_bankSwapNow) begin
        seqCount <= 3'b000;
      end
      if(io_hdmaWr) begin
        case(io_hdmaCtrlAddr)
          7'h0 : begin
            hdmaEnable <= io_hdmaData[0];
            hdmaChMask <= io_hdmaData[4 : 1];
            hdmaIndirect <= io_hdmaData[5];
          end
          7'h01 : begin
            if(when_Copper_l352) begin
              hdmaDoneSt <= 1'b0;
            end
          end
          7'h02 : begin
            chAddr0 <= io_hdmaData[14 : 0];
          end
          7'h04 : begin
            chAddr1 <= io_hdmaData[14 : 0];
          end
          7'h06 : begin
            chAddr2 <= io_hdmaData[14 : 0];
          end
          7'h08 : begin
            chAddr3 <= io_hdmaData[14 : 0];
          end
          7'h50 : begin
            hdmaDataPtr <= io_hdmaData[7 : 0];
          end
          default : begin
          end
        endcase
      end
      if(hdmaDataWriteHit) begin
        hdmaDataPtr <= (hdmaDataPtr + 8'h01);
      end
      hzeroPrev <= hzero;
      hdmaRegWr <= 1'b0;
      if(when_Copper_l462) begin
        hdmaDoneSt <= 1'b0;
      end
      if(when_Copper_l463) begin
        sweepActive <= 1'b1;
        sweepCh <= 3'b000;
        sweepEnt <= 3'b000;
      end
      hdmaHitR <= ((sweepActive && masked) && hit);
      if(hdmaHitR) begin
        hdmaRegAddr <= _zz_hdmaRegAddr;
        hdmaRegData <= (hdmaIndirR ? hdmaIndirectVal : hdmaEntDataR);
        hdmaRegWr <= 1'b1;
      end
      if(sweepActive) begin
        if(when_Copper_l515) begin
          sweepEnt <= 3'b000;
          if(when_Copper_l517) begin
            sweepActive <= 1'b0;
            sweepCh <= 3'b000;
            hdmaDoneSt <= 1'b1;
          end else begin
            sweepCh <= (sweepCh + 3'b001);
          end
        end else begin
          sweepEnt <= (sweepEnt + 3'b001);
        end
      end
      fsm_stateReg <= fsm_stateNext;
      case(fsm_stateReg)
        fsm_sHalt : begin
        end
        fsm_sFetch : begin
          if(!io_bankSwapNow) begin
            if(!when_Copper_l196) begin
              case(opcode)
                2'b00 : begin
                  if(when_Copper_l200) begin
                    opXLatch <= fetchWord[9 : 0];
                    opWaitIsPx <= 1'b1;
                  end else begin
                    opWaitIsPx <= 1'b0;
                  end
                end
                2'b01 : begin
                  opAddr <= _zz_opAddr;
                end
                2'b10 : begin
                  seqCount <= fetchWord[13 : 11];
                  opAddr <= _zz_opAddr_2;
                end
                default : begin
                end
              endcase
            end
          end
        end
        fsm_sWaitStall : begin
        end
        fsm_sWriteData : begin
          if(!io_bankSwapNow) begin
            if(!when_Copper_l279) begin
              regAddrR <= opAddr;
              regDataR <= fetchWord;
              regWrR <= 1'b1;
            end
          end
        end
        fsm_sSeqData : begin
          if(io_bankSwapNow) begin
            regAddrR <= opAddr;
            regDataR <= fetchWord;
            regWrR <= 1'b1;
          end else begin
            if(!when_Copper_l304) begin
              regAddrR <= opAddr;
              regDataR <= fetchWord;
              regWrR <= 1'b1;
              opAddr <= (opAddr + 15'h0001);
              if(!when_Copper_l309) begin
                seqCount <= (seqCount - 3'b001);
              end
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    hdmaIndirR <= hdmaIndirect;
    hdmaEntDataR <= entData;
    hdmaChiR <= chi;
  end


endmodule

module LinestateStore (
  input  wire [8:0]    io_writeAddr,
  input  wire [11:0]   io_writeData,
  input  wire          io_writeEnable,
  input  wire [8:0]    io_commitLine,
  input  wire          io_commitStrobe,
  input  wire [8:0]    io_readAddr,
  output wire          io_layer0Enable,
  output wire          io_layer1Enable,
  output wire [9:0]    io_layer0ScrollX,
  input  wire          clk,
  input  wire          reset
);

  reg        [11:0]   prepare_spinal_port1;
  wire       [11:0]   commit_spinal_port1;
  wire                _zz_prepare_port;
  wire                _zz_prepareSync;
  reg                 _zz_1;
  reg                 _zz_2;
  wire                commitCollide;
  reg                 commitStrobeD1;
  reg        [8:0]    commitLineD1;
  reg                 commitCollideD1;
  reg        [11:0]   commitWriteDataD1;
  wire       [11:0]   prepareSync;
  wire       [11:0]   commitData;
  wire       [11:0]   record_1;
  (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [11:0] prepare [0:511];
  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [11:0] commit [0:511];

  assign _zz_prepareSync = 1'b1;
  initial begin
    $readmemb("/home/itadmin/github/spinalhdlVDP/./simWorkspace/tmp/job_1/VdpTop.v_toplevel_linestate_prepare.bin",prepare);
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_2) begin
      prepare[io_writeAddr] <= io_writeData;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_prepareSync) begin
      prepare_spinal_port1 <= prepare[io_commitLine];
    end
  end

  initial begin
    $readmemb("/home/itadmin/github/spinalhdlVDP/./simWorkspace/tmp/job_1/VdpTop.v_toplevel_linestate_commit.bin",commit);
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if(_zz_1) begin
      commit[commitLineD1] <= commitData;
    end
  end

  assign commit_spinal_port1 = commit[io_readAddr];
  always @(*) begin
    _zz_1 = 1'b0;
    if(commitStrobeD1) begin
      _zz_1 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    _zz_2 = 1'b0;
    if(io_writeEnable) begin
      _zz_2 = 1'b1;
    end
  end

  assign commitCollide = ((io_commitStrobe && io_writeEnable) && (io_writeAddr == io_commitLine));
  assign prepareSync = prepare_spinal_port1;
  assign commitData = (commitCollideD1 ? commitWriteDataD1 : prepareSync);
  assign record_1 = commit_spinal_port1;
  assign io_layer0Enable = record_1[11];
  assign io_layer1Enable = record_1[10];
  assign io_layer0ScrollX = record_1[9 : 0];
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      commitStrobeD1 <= 1'b0;
      commitLineD1 <= 9'h0;
      commitCollideD1 <= 1'b0;
      commitWriteDataD1 <= 12'h0;
    end else begin
      commitStrobeD1 <= io_commitStrobe;
      commitLineD1 <= io_commitLine;
      commitCollideD1 <= commitCollide;
      commitWriteDataD1 <= io_writeData;
    end
  end


endmodule

  assign io_busy = ((busySdramSync || rowFifo_io_pop_valid) || (popCounter != 6'h0));
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if(reset) begin
      startToggle <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_startTogglePrev <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
      sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
      sdramArea_state <= State_1_Idle;
      sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_addrReg <= 23'h0;
      sdramArea_rowDoneToggle <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_pushPayload <= 39'h0;
      sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
      popCounter <= 6'h0;
      rowReadyR <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if(io_start) begin
        startToggle <= (! startToggle);
      end
      sdramArea_startTogglePrev <= sdramArea_startToggleSync;
      sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b0;
      sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b0;
      case(sdramArea_state)
        State_1_Idle : begin
          if(sdramArea_startEdge) begin
            sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
            sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
            sdramArea_state <= State_1_Issue;
          end
        end
        State_1_Issue : begin
          if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l158) begin
            sdramArea_rdReg <= 1'b1;
            sdramArea_addrReg <= (_zz_sdramArea_addrReg + _zz_sdramArea_addrReg_1);
            sdramArea_state <= State_1_WaitData;
          end
        end
        State_1_WaitData : begin
          if(io_sdramDataReady) begin
            sdramArea_pushPayload <= {{sdramArea_planeIdx,sdramArea_readIdx},io_sdramDout32};
            sdramArea_pushValid <= 1'b1;
            if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l171) begin
              sdramArea_readIdx <= 4'b0000;
              if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l173) begin
                sdramArea_planeIdx <= 3'b000;
                sdramArea_state <= State_1_Done;
              end else begin
                sdramArea_planeIdx <= (sdramArea_planeIdx + 3'b001);
                sdramArea_state <= State_1_Issue;
              end
            end else begin
              sdramArea_readIdx <= (sdramArea_readIdx + 4'b0001);
              sdramArea_state <= State_1_Issue;
            end
          end
        end
        default : begin
          sdramArea_rowDoneToggle <= (! sdramArea_rowDoneToggle);
          sdramArea_state <= State_1_Idle;
        end
      endcase
      `ifndef SYNTHESIS
        `ifdef FORMAL
          assert(((! popFire) || (popPlaneIdx < 3'b101))); // BitplaneRowFetch.scala:L221
        `else
          if(!((! popFire) || (popPlaneIdx < 3'b101)) && $realtime != 0) begin
            $display("ERROR P3 Risk #2: popPlaneIdx >= planeCount (non-pow2 planeCount silent-drop)"); // BitplaneRowFetch.scala:L221
          end
        `endif
      `endif
      rowReadyR <= 1'b0;
      if(io_start) begin
        popCounter <= 6'h0;
      end
      if(popFire) begin
        if(when_BitplaneRowFetch_l243) begin
          popCounter <= 6'h0;
          rowReadyR <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
          popCounter <= (popCounter + 6'h01);
        end
      end
    end
  end


endmodule
